text: Base ini sa “2024 World Happiness Report” nga gin-edit ni Professor Jan-Emmanuel De Neve, isa ka expert sang economics kag behavioral science sa University of Oxford kun sa diin ang resulta ang ginbalhag sang nagligad nga Marso 20.
english: This is based on the “2024 World Happiness Report” edited by Professor Jan-Emmanuel De Neve, an expert in economics and behavioral science at the University of Oxford whose results were published on March 20.

text: Sa amo nga report, ang Singapore ang nakakuha sang pinakamataas nga puwesto sa Southeast Asia region.
english: In the report, Singapore ranked highest in the Southeast Asia region.

text: Nagapang-53 naman ang Pilipinas sa bilog nga kalibutan nga mas mataas ipaanggid sa ika-76 nga nakuha sang nagligad nga 2023.
english: The Philippines is ranked 53rd in the world, up from 76th in 2023.

text: ‘Generally happy’ ang paglaragway sang mga Pinoy sang ginhingyo nga i-rate ang ila kabuhi sa scale sang 1-10.
english: Filipinos described themselves as 'generally happy' when asked to rate their lives on a scale of 1-10.

text: Ang average score sang kada pungsod ang na-calculate base sa ratings sa sulod sang nagligad nga tatlo ka tuig.
english: Each country’s average score was calculated based on ratings over the past three years.

text: Ginbase ang report sa self-reported data halin sa mga tawo nga na-survey sa kada pungsod.
english: The report is based on self-reported data from people surveyed in each country.

text: Yari naman ang ranking sa iban nga pungsod sa Southeast Asia: Vietnam (54th); Thailand (58th); Malaysia (59th); Indonesia (80th); Laos (94th); Myanmar (118th); kag Cambodia (119th).
english: Here are the rankings in other Southeast Asian countries: Vietnam (54th); Thailand (58th); Malaysia (59th); Indonesia (80th); Laos (94th); Myanmar (118th); and Cambodia (119th).

text: Nagpang-60 naman ang China, pang-51 ang Japan, kag pang-52 ang South Korea.
english: China ranked 60th, Japan ranked 51st, and South Korea ranked 52nd.

text: Yari naman ang Top 10: Finland, Denmark, Iceland, Sweden, Israel, The Netherlands, Norway, Luxembourg, Switzerland, kag Australia.Ang Finland nga puluy-an sang 5.5 million nga mga tawo amo ang gina-report nga “happiest” country sa nagligad pa nga pito ka tuig.
english: Here are the Top 10: Finland, Denmark, Iceland, Sweden, Israel, The Netherlands, Norway, Luxembourg, Switzerland, and Australia. Finland, home to 5.5 million people, has been reportedly the “happiest” country for the past seven years.

text:
Sandig pa sa amo nga report, ang 10 ka mga pungsod sa pinakaidalom sang ranking amo ang: Yemen, Zambia, Eswatini, Malawi, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Congo, Sierra Leone, Lebanon kag Afghanistan.#

(Photo: We the Pvblic)
english:
According to the report, the 10 countries at the bottom of the ranking are: Yemen, Zambia, Eswatini, Malawi, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Congo, Sierra Leone, Lebanon and Afghanistan.

(Photo: We the Pvblic)

text: Ginpirmahan ni United States President Donald Trump ang executive order nga naga-establisar sang White House Task Force nga amo ang magatutok sa preparasyon sang pungsod sa pag-host sa prestiyoso nga FIFA World Cup sa 2026.
english: United States President Donald Trump has signed an executive order establishing a White House Task Force that will focus on the country’s preparations to host the prestigious FIFA World Cup in 2026.

text: Si Trump mismo ang mangin chairman sa task force, samtang magaserbe naman bilang vice chair si Vice President JD Vance.
english: Trump himself will chair the task force, while Vice President JD Vance will serve as vice chair.

text: May magapungko man nga executive director apang wala pa nahingadlan kun sin-o ini.
english: There will also be an executive director but who has not been named.

text: Ini nga opisyal amo ang maga-oversee sang adlaw-adlaw nga operasyon.
english: This officer will oversee day-to-day operations.

text: Masobra walo ka milyon nga international visitors ang ginalantaw nga magaabot sa US para sa isa ka bulan nga tournament nga maga-umpisa sa Hunyo 2026.
english: More than eight million international visitors are expected to arrive in the US for the month-long tournament that begins in June 2026.

text: Mangin host man sa hinampang ang Canada kag Mexico, mga pungsod kun sa diin may isyu subong ang United States bangud sa taripa nga ginalantaw magaresulta sa trade war kag economic downturn.
english: The game will also be hosted by Canada and Mexico, countries where the United States currently has issues over tariffs that are expected to result in a trade war and economic downturn.

text: Sa 2026, yara sa 48 ka mga team ang magahampang sa 104 matches sa tatlo ka mga pungsod nga amo ang una nga tion sa maragtas nga tatlo ka mga nasyon ang maga-host.
english: In 2026, a total of 48 teams will play in 104 matches across the three countries which will be the first time in history that three countries will host.

text: Katapusan nga ginpatigayon ang FIFA World Cup sa Qatar sang Disyembre 2022 kun sa diin nangin kampyon ang Argentina sa pagpanguna ni Lionel Messi.
english: The FIFA World Cup was last held in Qatar in December 2022 where Argentina led by Lionel Messi became champions.

text: Naka-rekord sang 73 ka bomb threats ang Police Regional Office sa bulan lang sang Nobyembre sa bug-os nga Western Visayas.
english: The Police Regional Office recorded 73 bomb threats in the month of November alone across Western Visayas.

text: Sa press release sang PRO 6, ginpahayag ni Regional Director PBGEN.
english: In a press release, PRO 6 said Regional Director PBGEN.

text: Joselito Ligan nga wala man sang confirmed devices nga nagluntad sa mga bomb threats sa rehiyon, apang siguraduhon man sagihapon nga mapasakaan sang kaso ang mga suspek sa likod sang nasambit nga mga pagpamahog.
english: Joselito Ligan said there are no confirmed devices involved in the bomb threats in the region, but he will ensure that the suspects behind the threats are prosecuted.

text: Pahayag man niya nga duha na ka indibidwal ang napasakaan sang kaso kag amo ang sa likod ang bomb threats sang Oton National Highschool kag Ramon Avanceña National Highschool.
english: He also said that two individuals have already been charged and are behind the bomb threats of Oton National High School and Ramon Avanceña National High School.

text: Dugang man niya nga kalabanan sa mga pagpamahog amo ang tripping lang kag ginsunod ang ila nga mga nakit-an sa social media.
english: He added that most of the threats were just tripping and following what they saw on social media.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga may yara lamang ka 61 ka mga personnel ang Explosive Ordnance Disposal team sa bug-os nga rehiyon apang capable man ang mga ini agud magresponde sa mga lugar nga may bomb threat.
english: He also explained that the Explosive Ordnance Disposal team has only 61 personnel in the entire region but they are also capable of responding to areas with bomb threats.

text: Sa subong padayun ang pag-imbestigar sang grupo sang Anti-Cybercrime group apang namalibad ini nga mag-idisclose sang proseso sang imbestigasyon.
english: The Anti-Cybercrime group is currently investigating the incident but declined to disclose the investigation process.

text: Suno man sa iya nga pagasiguraduhon sang mga awtoridad nga mangin hilway ang pagselebrar sang paalabuton nga Holiday Season agud wala sang matabo nga bomb threat.
english: He also said that the authorities will ensure that the celebration of the upcoming holiday season will be safe so that there will be no bomb threat.

text: Subong nga World Radio Day, ginapadayaw sang Bombo Radyo Philippines ang anom ka dekada nga indi matupungan nga performance sa patag sang public service kag broadcasting sa pungsod.
english: This World Radio Day, Bombo Radyo Philippines celebrates six decades of unparalleled performance in the field of public service and broadcasting in the country.

text: Suno kay Miss Margaret Ruth Florete, President and CEO sang Bombo Radyo Philippines, nagpabilin nga mapag-on ang pagsalig sang publiko sa network bangud nga gintungdan sang Bombo ang matuod-tuod nga papel bilang manugdul-ong sang balita kag impormasyon.
english: According to Miss Margaret Ruth Florete, President and CEO of Bombo Radyo Philippines, the public's trust in the network remained strong because Bombo played its true role as a carrier of news and information.

text: Pahayag niya, padayon ang network sa misyon sini nga magpangalagad, mag-edukar, kag maghatag sang gahum sa komunidad.
english: He said the network continues its mission to serve, educate, and empower the community.

text: Dugang niya, panindugan gihapon sang kumpanya ang ethical broadcasting, public accountability, kag responsible innovation samtang nagapadayon ini bilang go-to media organization.
english: He added that the company will continue to stand for ethical broadcasting, public accountability, and responsible innovation as it continues to be the go-to media organization.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman ini sang pagpasalamat sa tanan nga mga ka-Bombo kag ka-Starnation nga maukod nga tagpalamati kag tumalan-aw sang mga programa sang 32 ka mga fully digitalized radio stations sang Bombo Radyo sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: He also expressed his gratitude to all Bombo and Starnation members who are diligent listeners and viewers of the programs of Bombo Radyo's 32 fully digitalized radio stations nationwide.

text: Ginpabakod pa sang House Committee on Justice sa boto nga 39 nga nagpabor, apat ang nagpamatok, kag zero ang nag-abstain, nga ibasura ang impeachment complaint batok kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The House Committee on Justice affirmed by a vote of 39 in favor, four against, and zero abstentions, to dismiss the impeachment complaint against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Nagakahulugan ini nga kadam-an sang myembro sang komitiba ang nagsuporta sa pagbasura sang reklamo.
english: This means that the majority of the committee members supported the dismissal of the complaint.

text: Suno sa komitiba, kulang sa substance ang mga alegasyon sa impeachment complaints.
english: According to the committee, the allegations in the impeachment complaints lack substance.

text: Apisar pa nga gin-acknowledge nila nga insakto ang reklamo, ila napamaud-an nga wala sang nagakaigo ang ebidensya kag basehan agud magpadayon sa impeachment proceedings.
english: Although they acknowledged that the complaint was correct, they found that there was not enough evidence and basis to proceed with the impeachment proceedings.

text: Nahibaluan nga may duha ka impeachment complaints nga ginpasaka batok sa Presidente, lakip ang ginfile sang isa ka pribado nga abogado kag sang mga miyembro sang Makabayan bloc.
english: Two impeachment complaints have been filed against the President, including those filed by a private lawyer and members of the Makabayan bloc.

text: Samtang, liwat nga ginpasakaan sang impeachment complaint si Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Meanwhile, an impeachment complaint was filed against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga reklamo batok sa iya matapos mag-file ang pila ka mga religious groups kag mga abogado bangud sa gina-alegar nga betrayal of public trust, graft and corruption kag iban pa.
english: This is the third complaint against him after several religious groups and lawyers filed for alleged betrayal of public trust, graft and corruption and others.

text: May kaangtanan man ini sa ginapatihan nga paggamit sang indi magnubo nga P612 milyon nga confidential funds.
english: It is also related to the alleged use of at least P612 million in confidential funds.

text: Suno kay Atty. Amando Virgil Ligutan, abogado sang mga nagreklamo, iya ginpahayag nga ila ginabase ang ikatatlo nga impeachment complaint sa mga natukiban sang House committee on good government and public accountability nahanungod sa paggamit sang confidential funds sang Office of the Vice President (OVP) kag sang Department of Education sa idalom ni Duterte.
english: According to Atty. Amando Virgil Ligutan, lawyer for the complainants, said they are basing the third impeachment complaint on the findings of the House committee on good government and public accountability regarding the use of confidential funds by the Office of the Vice President (OVP) and the Department of Education under Duterte.

text: ADMITIDO sang aton gobyerno nga may kakulangan kita sang mga testing equipment, facilities kag competent manpower agud lubos maaway ang COVID-19.
english: Our government has admitted that we lack testing equipment, facilities and competent manpower to fully fight COVID-19.

text: In fact, ang pila sang aton health specialists gina-training pa kag ang kakulangan naton sa iban nga health workers ginapangita pa sa mga aplikante nga may baganihan nga balatyagon.
english: In fact, some of our health specialists are still being trained and our shortage of other health workers is still being sought in applicants with heroic spirit.

text: Tungod sini, targeted lang sang mass testing naton ang mga priority sector kag indi ang tanan sa populasyon.
english: Because of this, our mass testing targeted only the priority sectors and not the entire population.

text: Nagapanguna diri ang health specialists kag workers nga nagapatigayon sang mass testing kag ang yara sa mga ospital kag sa quarantine kag isolation facilities nga nagatatap sang aton pasyente kontra COVID-19.
english: This includes health specialists and workers who conduct mass testing and those in hospitals and quarantine and isolation facilities who take care of our patients against COVID-19.

text: Subong man ang mga opisyales, mga sibilyan nga empleyado sa gobyerno, kag ang iban pa, lakip na ang men in uniform, nga na-assign sa frontlines kag kon diin pa sa pagpaseguro nga mapatuman ang mga health protocol agud amligan ang ikaayong lawas sang tanan.
english: Likewise, officials, civilian government employees, and others, including men in uniform, assigned to the frontlines and elsewhere to ensure the implementation of health protocols to protect the health of all.

text: Samtang pwede naman mapasugtan sang gobyerno ang pila sa private sector sa ila negosyo kag employment basta ginasunod lang nila ang health protocols sa ila mga establicimiento kag mga worker.
english: Meanwhile, the government can allow some in the private sector to do business and employment as long as they follow the health protocols in their establishments and workers.

text: Ang publiko gina-requirer man sa paggamit sang face mask kag sa pagpatuman sang physical distancing kag sang handwashing sa kon diin man sila mauyong nga mga lugar nga dapat  ma-disinfect.
english: The public is also required to wear face masks and to observe physical distancing and handwashing in areas that should be disinfected.

text: Wala man ginadilian ang mga buluhaton sa diin maamligan ang ikaayong lawas sang aton mga pumuluyo sunu sa ginapatuman sang mga health protocol.
english: Activities that protect the health of our residents are not prohibited in accordance with the health protocols.

text:
***

Isa sa sining mga buluhaton nga luyag pasugtan nga hiwaton sang aton mga pumuluyo amo ang hampang sang basketbol sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA), nga popular gid sa aton pumuluyo bisan dira lang makita sa television (TV).
english:
***

One of these activities that our people want to be allowed to hold is the basketball game of the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA), which is very popular among our people even if it is seen on television.

text: In fact, gaplano na subong ang PBA agud magsugod sang training  sang mga player sa masunod nga game season.
english: In fact, the PBA is now planning to start training players for the next game season.

text: Wala ta ugaling matul-id gid ang ining plano kag kon bala mapasugtan  man ini sang Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF).
english: However, we are not sure whether this plan will be approved by the Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF).

text: Sa isa sang mga kolum naton diri, medyo nagdiskarte man gani kita sang  isa ka suhestyon.
english: In one of our columns here, we even made a suggestion.

text: Daw lahog lang ugaling yadto nga luyag naton ligwaton sa karon.
english: But that seems like a joke that we want to repeat now.

text:
***

Kinahanglan man lang ang physical distancing, ukon ang mag-antad sa iban sang at least isa ka metro, agud mapahilayo sa infection sang COVID-19 ang mga tawo.
english:
***

Physical distancing, or keeping a distance of at least one meter from others, is also required to keep people away from the infection of COVID-19.

text: Indi man airborne, ukon dala sang hangin ang COVID-19 virus, gani wala man sing dapat kahangaw-an dira.
english: The COVID-19 virus is not airborne, so there is nothing to worry about.

text: Ang mga droplet kag aerosol sang pag-ubo, pangatsi kag panupla, sunu sa health authorities, mahulog man lang ini sa mga butang sa idalom kag sa duta.
english: Droplets and aerosols from coughing, sneezing and sneezing, according to health authorities, will fall on objects below and on the ground.

text: Gani, kon pulos man lang negative kag clear kita tanan sa COVID-19, syempre wala kinahanglan ang physical distancing sa tunga naton, Indi bala?
english: So, if we are all negative and clear of COVID-19, of course there is no need for physical distancing between us, right?

text: In other words, pwede na kita makig-upod sa iban sing malapitan.
english: In other words, we can interact with others more closely.

text: Angot diri, aton suhestyon sa subong amo nga i-subject sa COVID-19 testing ang mga player kag ang iban sa  basketball court, kag ang pahampangon lang ang mga negative kag clear sa COVID-19 virus nga wala na kinahanglan sing face mask ukon ano pa nga sablag sa ila paghampang.
english: In this regard, our suggestion is to subject the players and others on the basketball court to COVID-19 testing, and to allow only those who are negative and clear of the COVID-19 virus to play without the need for face masks or any other obstacle to their play.

text: Tutal, sa siling na naton, indi naman kinahanglan ini kon negative kag clear sila sa COVID-19.
english: After all, as we said, it is not necessary if they are negative and clear of COVID-19.

text: Kon may pagpangamlig, katulad sang face mask, ina lang i-require sa audience nga nagasunod man sa physical distancing sa mga pulungkuan kag kon diin pa nahamtang, kag kon ano pa nga health protocol nga bagay.
english: If there is protection, such as a face mask, that will be required of the audience who also follow physical distancing in the seats and wherever they are located, and whatever other health protocols are appropriate.

text: Of course, dapat may go-signal gid ang Department of Health kag IATF para sa opisyal nga pagpahanugot sini.
english: Of course, the Department of Health and IATF must have a go-signal for its official approval.

text: Ayos, indi bala?
english: Fine, right?

text: Maka-tan-aw na kita liwat seguro sini sing PBA games bisan yara pa ang COVID-19!
english: We can probably watch PBA games again despite COVID-19!

text:
***

Nanotran gali sang isa ka doktor nga Italyano nga basi madula na gid lang ang COVID-19, ukon SARS-CoV-2, bisan wala pa sing mahatag nga vaccine sa mga pumuluyo.
english:
***

An Italian doctor has predicted that COVID-19, or SARS-CoV-2, may disappear even if there is no vaccine available to the population.

text: Ini siya si Dr. Matteo Basseti, head sang Infectious Disease Clinic sa San Martino Hospital sa Italya.
english: This is Dr. Matteo Basseti, head of the Infectious Disease Clinic at San Martino Hospital in Italy.

text: Gapati siya nga amat-amat na gahuyang ang COVID-19 tungod sa pag-mutate, ukon pagbaylo sang forma, sa indi na gawa mapintas nga kapinasahi tungod sa padayon nga pagpatuman sang physical distancing, lockdown, quarantine kag isolation.
english: He believes that COVID-19 is gradually weakening due to its mutation, or change of form, to a less violent form due to the continued implementation of physical distancing, lockdown, quarantine and isolation.

text: Aba, salamat kon matuod!
english: Well, thank you if it's true!

text: Pero, that means dapat sigehon ta gid ang aton mabungahon na nga pagpatuman sang aton health protocols!/PN
english: But, that means we must continue our fruitful implementation of our health protocols!/PN

text: Ginklaro kag nagpasalig ang Iloilo City Budget Officer nga wala sang pagsaka sa Real Property Tax (RPT) kag wala man sang direkta nga epekto ang pagloan sang city government sa Development Bank of the Philippines para sa expansion budget sang Iloilo City Community College.
english: The Iloilo City Budget Officer clarified and assured that there will be no increase in the Real Property Tax (RPT) and no direct impact of the city government's loan to the Development Bank of the Philippines for the expansion budget of the Iloilo City Community College.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Viminale Capulso, City Budget Officer, iya gin-athag nga may ginasunod nga standard ang mga balayran sa syudad kag indi ini maapektuhan sang mga loan sang local government.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Viminale Capulso, City Budget Officer, explained that the city's fees are standardized and will not be affected by local government loans.

text: Sa bahin sang RPT, may ara sang ginpapanaog nga executive order ni Mayor Raisa Treñas sa pag-extend sang 40% deduction sang RPT sa siudad nga magalawig pa tubtob 2028 kun sa diin wala man sang patigayunon nga pagtaas bangud sa utang nga 300 Million pesos.
english: On the RPT, there is an executive order issued by Mayor Raisa Treñas to extend the 40% deduction of RPT in the city which will last until 2028 where there will be no increase due to the debt of 300 million pesos.

text: Nahibaluan nga may ara pa sang P2.4 Billion nga debt capacity ang siudad, kun sa diin sa subong, 300 Million pesos pa lang ang ginhulam sang city government nga kinahanglanun para sa Iloilo City Community College.
english: It is known that the city still has a debt capacity of P2.4 billion, where at present, the city government has only borrowed 300 million pesos needed for the Iloilo City Community College.

text: TUNGOD bag-o nga balatian ang COVID-19, puro pakot-pakot lang anay sa una ang ihibalo sini sang mga health authorities tubtub amat-amat nga naathagan ini.
english: BECAUSE COVID-19 is a new disease, the health authorities were initially aware of it until it was gradually clarified.

text: Una nga ginbuyagyag ini ni Dr. Li sang Wuhan, China sadtong Disyembre 2019, nga nagtawag sini nga isa ka misteryoso nga balatian.
english: This was first revealed by Dr. Li of Wuhan, China in December 2019, calling it a mysterious disease.

text: May pagpati ugaling nga nahibal-an na ini sang gobyerno sang China sadtong Oktubre 2019 pa nga ginhinagu lang sini.
english: However, it is believed that the Chinese government knew about it as early as October 2019 and kept it secret.

text: Nagsugod nga natublag ang gobyerno sang China sang madasig na maglapta kag may napatay na tubtub gin-lockdown na sini sadtong Enero 23, 2020 ang bug-os nga siyudad sang Wuhan.
english: The Chinese government began to worry about the rapid spread of the virus and the death toll until it locked down the entire city of Wuhan on January 23, 2020.

text: Ining delayed action sang gobyerno sang China nag-resulta ugaling sa paglapta na sini sa iban nga mga pungsod sa kalibutan.
english: This delayed action by the Chinese government has resulted in the spread of the disease to other countries in the world.

text: Ginbasol sini ang China kag bisan ang World Health Organization (WHO) tungod ginpadugay sini ang pag-anunsyar nga isa na ini ka pandemic, nga nagpadugay man sang pagpangamlig sang iban nga pungsod.
english: He blamed China and even the World Health Organization (WHO) for delaying the announcement of a pandemic, which also delayed the protection of other countries.

text: Ano gid bala ang pagtratar naton sa COVID-19?
english: How are we really treating COVID-19?

text: Diin gid bala nagsugod ini?
english: Where exactly did it start?

text: Ano ukon sin-o ang pwede sini ma-infect?
english: What or who can it infect?

text: Ano ini ka makatalagam?
english: How dangerous is it?

text: Paano kita ma-infect sini?
english: How do we get infected with it?

text: Paano kita malatnan ukon makalikaw nga malatnan sini?
english: How can we become infected or avoid becoming infected with it?

text: Kon ma-infect na, paano naton ini bulngon ukon ma-treat?
english: Once infected, how do we treat it?

text: Ano bala ang kapinasahi (characteristics) sini?
english: What are its characteristics?

text: Nagtuhaw ang COVID-19 sa animal market sang Wuhan, China.
english: COVID-19 originated in an animal market in Wuhan, China.

text: Mayor nga suspetso ang mga kabog nga nauyunan kan-on sang mga Intsik.
english: The main suspect is the dust that the Chinese like to eat.

text: Halin sa kabog, ang virus nagsaylo sa tawo nga nagsaylo man sa kapareho nga  tawo (human-to-human transmission).
english: From dust, the virus spreads to a person who in turn spreads it to the same person (human-to-human transmission).

text: Suno sa World Health Organization (WHO) madasig ini manglaton kag mga 80 ka porsyento (80%) sini ang maiguan sing “mild”, 15% sang “moderate” kag “severe” kag 5% sang “critical”.
english: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), it is highly contagious and about 80 percent of cases are mild, 15% moderate and severe and 5% critical.

text: Makuha ang COVID-19 virus sa droplets kag aerosol (finu nga partikulo) halin sa pag-ubo, pangatsi kag bisan sa pagpanupla sang infected nga sa masami tubtub sa kalayuon nga isa tubtub duha ka metro.
english: The COVID-19 virus can be transmitted in droplets and aerosols from coughing, sneezing and even sneezing from an infected person, usually up to a distance of one to two meters.

text: Pwede man makuha ini sa mga butang nga matup-an sini, katulad sang doorknob, nga makuha sa pagtandug sang mahigko nga kamot sa mata, ilong kag baba.
english: It can also be caught from things it comes into contact with, such as doorknobs, which can be caught by touching the eyes, nose and mouth with dirty hands.

text: Pwede man gani madala ini sang sapatos nga nakalapak sa duta.
english: It can even be carried by shoes that are stuck on the ground.

text: Kon wala sing host nga masudlan, amat-amat na ini nga ma-inactivate.
english: If there is no host to enter, it will gradually be inactivated.

text: Ang tanan pwede matapikan sang COVID-19, labi na gid ang mga tigulang (60 anyos pa-ibabaw) nga may pre-existing nga mga ginabatyag katulad sang diabetes, asthma, heart failure kag iban pa.
english: Everyone can be infected with COVID-19, especially the elderly (60 years old and above) with pre-existing conditions such as diabetes, asthma, heart failure and others.

text: Ang mga kabataan less likely nga iguon, kag kon iguon “mild” lang nga mga 1% sang 1,000 sang mga pasyente.
english: Children are less likely to be affected, and if affected it is only “mild” which is about 1% of 1,000 patients.

text: Ginatudlo ini sang mga health authorities sa natural nga panagang (inhibitor) sang mga kabataan.
english: Health authorities point to this as a natural inhibitor for children.

text: Ang iban ng rason amo ang cross-resistance sa bakuna (vaccine) sang mga kabataan sa measles.
english: Other reasons are cross-resistance to the measles vaccine in children.

text: Ano ang mga bulong sa COVID-19 ukon therapeutic strategies (treatment) ang pwede makapaayo sang pasyente?
english: What are the COVID-19 drugs or therapeutic strategies (treatment) that can cure the patient?

text: Mabudlay patyon ang COVID-19 virus tungod may protective coat ini nga mabudlay ma-penenetrate.
english: The COVID-19 virus is difficult to kill because it has a protective coat that is difficult to penetrate.

text: Mapatay lang ang COVID-19 virus sa sulod sang lawas sang biktima paagi sa bakuna.
english: The COVID-19 virus can only be killed inside the victim's body by the vaccine.

text: Posible mahimo man ini sang mabaskug nga immune system sang isa ka tawo, rason nga may naka-survive sang pag-igu sang kasubong nga pandemic nga wala vaccine.
english: It is possible that a person's strong immune system can also do this, which is why some have survived the onslaught of such a pandemic without a vaccine.

text: Sa gwa sng lawas, mapatay man ini paagi sa insakto nga hand washing gamit ang habon (soap) ukon paghugas sang alcohol nga 60-70% nga makakakas sang protective coat sini tubtub mapatay.
english: Outside the body, it can also be killed by proper hand washing with soap or washing with alcohol 60-70% which can remove its protective coat until it dies.

text: In fact, ang handwashing ang “best defense” kontra COVID-19 tungod sini.
english: In fact, handwashing is the “best defense” against COVID-19 because of this.

text: May mga anti-viral drugs nga makapugong sang pagmuad sang virus (replication) sa host cell sini kag paglapta sini (shedding) sa lawas sang biktima agud mapaayo ang pasyente.
english: There are anti-viral drugs that can prevent the virus from replicating in its host cell and shedding in the victim's body to improve the patient's health.

text: Isa sining anti-viral ang Remdesivir.
english: One such anti-viral is Remdesivir.

text: Gina-rekomendar man ang blood plasma sa pagpaayo sang critically ill.
english: Blood plasma is also recommended to treat the critically ill.

text: Ano pa ang himuon nga pangamlig sa kabug-usan?
english: What else to do to protect the whole?

text: Ang lockdown, ukon pagsara sang borders sang isa ka lugar.
english: A lockdown, or closing the borders of an area.

text: Ang quarantine, ukon paglikaw sang mga pumuluyo nga malatnan sang pangayaw.
english: Quarantine, or the prevention of residents from being infected by foreigners.

text: Pwede lang makagwa kon “essential” ang hilimuon nga may husto nga pagpangamlig.
english: You can only go out if the activity is “essential” with proper protection.

text: Ang isa pa amo ang pag-isolate sang ma-confirm nga may COVID-19 virus tubtub ma-clear ukon mag-alayo.
english: Another is to isolate those who are confirmed to have the COVID-19 virus until they are cleared or recovered.

text: Hibaluon man nga ang sintoma sang pagka-infect indi magasugod dayon, kundi 2-14 pa ka adlaw despues.
english: Also know that the symptom of infection will not start immediately, but 2-14 days later.

text: Gani indi dayon ma-release ang isa ka tawo bisan negative sa testing.
english: So a person cannot be released immediately even if he tests negative.

text: Ano kadugay ang immunity sang isa ka nag-ayo paagi sa therapeutics kag indi sa bakuna?
english: How long does immunity last for someone who recovered with therapeutics and not the vaccine?

text: Katulad lang sa passive immunity nga pila lang seguro ka semana ukon binulan.
english: It's like passive immunity that lasts only a few weeks or months.

text: Gani ginpanugyan ang ila gihapon pagpangamlig kay pwede pa sila ma-reinfect./PN
english: Therefore, they are advised to take precautions as they can still be reinfected./PN

text: Madamo sang sintomas agud nga mahibaluan kun ang isa ka tawo ang bitukon.
english: There are many symptoms to determine if a person is bitukon.

text: Ini ang kaangot sang ginahiwat sang Department of Health (DOH) nga National Deworming Campaign.
english: This is in connection with the National Deworming Campaign conducted by the Department of Health (DOH).

text: Target sang kampanya sang DOH nga mapurga ang 19 ka milyon nga school-aged children kag 23 ka milyon nga pre-school kag school-aged children nga out of school youth.
english: The DOH's campaign targets to purge 19 million school-aged children and 23 million pre-school and school-aged children who are out of school youth.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Elvin Tiangha, iya ginpahayag nga ang pagpurga ukon deworming amo ang pagkuha sang mga bitok sa intestine sang isa ka tawo pinaagi sa pag-inom sang bulong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Elvin Tiangha, he said that deworming is the removal of worms from a person's intestine by taking medicine.

text: Suno kay Tiangha, ang mga bitok ang nagakuha sang nutrisyon sang tawo.
english: According to Tiangha, the ants are the source of human nutrition.

text: Ang bitok amo ang ginatunaan sang pagpalanakit sang tiyan kag masami nga pagsuka nga magaresulta sa malnutrition.
english: Diarrhea is the cause of abdominal pain and frequent vomiting that results in malnutrition.

text: Lakip man sa sintomas suno kay Tiangha kun ang isa ka tawo bitokon, amo ang pagkatol ukon pagsakit sa palibot sang alatrasan, manubo nga intelligence quotient (IQ), anemia kag gilayon nga pagniwang ukon pagtambok.
english: Tiangha said symptoms of bitokon include itching or pain around the back, low intelligence quotient (IQ), anemia and immediate weight loss or weight gain.

text: Agud malikawan ang pag-angkon sang parasite sa tiyan ukon bitok, naghatag sang pila ka panugyan ang doktor.
english: To avoid getting a parasite in the stomach or intestines, the doctor gave some advice.

english: Her name is aligned with international celebrities like Jisoo and Rosé of Blackpink, Kim Kardashian, Cha Eun-woo and Kendall Jenner.

text: Ini man ang ginhimo sang tatlo ka teenagers nga napaidalom sa pagtatap sang Municipal Social Welfare Development (MSWD) sa Alfonso, Cavite kun sa diin inoras matapos nakapalagyo sa talatapan, mato-mato man sila nga nagbalik.
english: This was also done by three teenagers under the care of the Municipal Social Welfare Development (MSWD) in Alfonso, Cavite where hours after escaping from the office, they also returned.

text: Suno sa hepe sang Alfonso Municipal Police Station nga si P/Major Raymond Balbuena, naga-edad sang 15,16, kag 17-anyos ang tatlo, lunsay mga lalaki, kag ginakabig nga Children in Conflict with the Law.
english: Alfonso Municipal Police Station chief P/Major Raymond Balbuena said the three, aged 15, 16, and 17, are all males and are considered Children in Conflict with the Law.

text: Lunsay man sila na-involve sa kaso nga carnapping nga natabo sang nagligad nga Marso 10 sa amo man nga banwa.
english: They were also involved in a carnapping case that occurred on March 10 in the same town.

text: Sandig sa imbestigasyon sang pulis, nakakita ang kabataan sang buho sa building sang social welfare office kag didto sila nangita sang paagi agud nga makalusot kag makapalagyo halin sa Bahay Kalinga.
english: According to police investigation, the children found a hole in the building of the social welfare office and there they looked for a way to escape from Bahay Kalinga.

text: Nag-report naman sa pulis ang iloy sang isa sa mga bata nga ‘las tres y medya sa kaagahon sang may nagpanuktok sa ila nga balay.
english: The mother of one of the children reported to the police at 3:30 am when someone knocked on her door.

text: Amo na lang ang iya kakibot nga yara sa atubang sang puwertahan ang iya bata kag ang duha sini ka kaupdanan.
english: To her surprise, her son and his two companions were at the door.

text: Wala sini ginpaathag sa iya iloy kun paano sila nakahalin sa pasilidad, apang ginkuha sini ang iya nga cellphone, nagkuha man sang P2,000 sa kahita sang iya nga iloy, kag naglakat man sila gilayon.
english: He did not explain to his mother how they left the facility, but he took his cellphone, also took P2,000 from his mother's wallet, and they left immediately.

text: Pahayag naman sang hepe, posible nga may ginkadtuan lang ang tatlo ukon may ginlagawan.
english: The chief said it is possible that the three were just going somewhere or going for a walk.

text: Sandig sa report, 12:00 sa kagab-ihon sila nakahalin sa talatapan kag 10:00 sa aga sang nagbalik liwat.
english: According to the report, they left the office at 12:00 pm and returned at 10:00 am.

text: Agud indi na masulit ang hitabo, ginlantaw sang MSWDO kun ano ang kinahanglan nga kay-uhon sa ila nga building kag ginsiradhan na ang tanan nga buho nga posible lutsan sang Children In Conflict of the Law.#
english: In order to prevent the incident from happening again, the MSWDO has looked into what needs to be repaired in their building and has closed all the holes that Children In Conflict of the Law could escape.

text: Gin-anunsyo nga maga-updanay sa panibag-o nga Netflix romantic comedy film sanday Maris Racal kag Anthony Jennings.
english: Maris Racal and Anthony Jennings have been announced to star in a new Netflix romantic comedy film.

text: Ang upcoming film ang may tig-ulo nga ‘Sosyal Climbers’ kag natalana nga ipaguwa sa Pebrero 27, 2025.
english: The upcoming film is titled ‘Sosyal Climbers’ and is scheduled to release on February 27, 2025.

text: Dal-on sang duha ang papel sang magkarelasyon nga involved sa pagpang-scam sa manggaranon nga mga tawo.
english: The two will play the role of a couple involved in scamming rich people.

text: Base sa trailer nga gin-release Enero 30, nagpakuno-kuno sila nga manggaranon agud nga maka-upod sa social circles sang ila manggaranon nga mga kasilingan, nagtambong sa tuman ka mahal nga mga party, kag gingamit ang amo nga mga kahigayunan agud makapangwarta.
english: Based on the trailer released Jan. 30, they pretended to be rich in order to blend into the social circles of their wealthy neighbors, attended extremely expensive parties, and used such opportunities to make money.

text: Isa ini sa duha ka proyekto nanday Maris kag Anthony matapos ginbuyagyag sang ex-girlfriend ni Anthony nga si Jam Villanueva sang Disyembre 2024 ang ila ginhimo nga ginaalegar nga pagpangluib.
english: This is one of two projects of Maris and Anthony after Anthony’s ex-girlfriend Jam Villanueva revealed in December 2024 their alleged infidelity.

text: Pareho na nga nakahimo sang statement ang aktres kag ang actor kasunod sang amo nga isyu.
english: Both the actress and the actor have already made statements following the issue.

text: Makit-an man subong ang duha bilang sanday Gab kag Tom sa action series nga Incognito.
english: The two can also be seen as Gab and Tom in the action series Incognito.

text: Sa tunga sang mga kontrobersiya, may kanta man nga gin-release si Maris nga may tig-ulo nga “Perpektong Tao” nga nahanungod sa iya healing journey.
english: Amidst the controversies, Maris also released a song titled “Perpektong Tao” which is about her healing journey.

text: Una nga nakilala ang “MaThon” bilang sanday Snoop kag Irene sa Netflix series nga Can’t Buy Me Love kaupod ang loveteam nga DonBelle nga ginabug-usan nanday Donny Pangilinan kag Belle Mariano.#
english: “MaThon” first became known as Snoop and Irene in the Netflix series Can’t Buy Me Love with the loveteam DonBelle consisting of Donny Pangilinan and Belle Mariano.

text: Ginasundan na sang Iloilo City Police Station 3 ang mga CCTV sa nagluntad nga motornapping incident sang Pebrero 11 sa bahin sang Quintin Salas sa Distrito sang Jaro.
english: Iloilo City Police Station 3 is following the CCTV footage of the motornapping incident that occurred on February 11 in Quintin Salas in Jaro District.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCPT.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCPT.

text: Mavin Laraño, hepe sang ICPS 3, iya ginpahayag nga ginalantaw nga pareho lang ang suspek sang motornapping incident sang Pebrero 11 kag sang Pebrero 3 sa atubang sang Land Transporation Office sa bahin man sang Quintin Salas.
english: Mavin Laraño, chief of ICPS 3, said the suspect in the motornapping incident on February 11 and February 3 in front of the Land Transporation Office in Quintin Salas is believed to be the same.

text: Ini matapos nga nakit-an sa CCTV footages nga pareho ang panglawasun sang suspek sang duha ka insidente.
english: This was after CCTV footages showed that the suspect in the two incidents was in the same body.

text: Suno pa kay Laraño, padayon ang ila nga imbestigasyon agud nga mahibaluan kun isa lang ang persona sa likod sang motornapping.
english: Laraño said they are continuing their investigation to determine if there is only one person behind the motornapping.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ini sa publiko nga isekyar ang ila nga mga propiedad ilabi na ang motorsiklo agud malikawan ang kaangay nga mga insidente.
english: He also reminded the public to check their properties especially motorcycles to avoid similar incidents.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang ikalima nga insidente sang motornapping nga narekord sa syudad subong nga tuig.
english: This is the fifth incident of motornapping recorded in the city this year.

text: May isa na naman ka buhi nga pamatuod nga masarangan mo gid malab-ot ang imo handum bisan ano man ang imo itsura kag kondisyon — basta bastante lang ikaw sa determinasyon!
english: There is yet another living proof that you can definitely achieve your dream no matter what your looks and condition — as long as you have enough determination!

text: Ini amo ang 23-anyos nga si Ganesh Baraiya, tumandok sang India, nga nagataas lamang sang tatlo ka tapak… apang naga-trabaho bilang isa ka doktor!
english: This is 23-year-old Ganesh Baraiya, a native of India, who stands just three feet tall… but works as a doctor!

text: Halin sang apat ka tuig pa lamang ang iya edad tubtub natubuan sang buot, nagpangatubang si Ganesh kag ang iya nga pamilya sang diskriminasyon halin sa mga tawo sa palibot.
english: From the age of four until he grew up, Ganesh and his family faced discrimination from the people around them.

text: May ara pa gani sang tion nga gintanyagan ang iya amay sang kuwarta agud nga mapa-trabaho si Ganesh bilang isa ka clown rason nga naglalain gid sila kag gin-updan na lang ang bata bisan diin ini magkadto bangud sa kakulba nga ikidnap ini sang iban kag pwersahon nga mag-trabaho kag himuon nga kalingawan.
english: There was even a time when his father was offered money to get Ganesh to work as a clown, which made them very angry and accompanied the boy wherever he went for fear that he would be kidnapped by others and forced to work and be used as entertainment.

text: Bisan sa eskwelahan, indi madula ang pagpakanubo—bisan ano pa ka ambisyoso kag ano pa ka taas ang grades sang bata.
english: Even in school, humiliation does not go away—no matter how ambitious a child is and how good his grades are.

text: Nag-apply ini sa Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery degree apang wala ginbaton bangud sa dwarfism.
english: He applied for the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery degree but was rejected due to dwarfism.

text: Maayo ang resulta sang iya test apang ginbasura sang Medical Council of India ang iya aplikasyon bangud nagapati sila nga indi sini masarangan ang iya trabaho pananglitan may mga emerhensya sa ospital.
english: He tested positive but the Medical Council of India rejected his application because they believed he would not be able to do his job in case of emergencies in the hospital.

text: Sa bulig sang school principal, nagkadto pa gid siya sa District Collector nga amo anay ang state Education Minister kag ginpasaka pa gid ang reklamo sa Gujarat High Court.
english: With the help of the school principal, he went to the District Collector who was then the state Education Minister and filed a complaint in the Gujarat High Court.

text: Wala nagmadinalag-on ang iya mga gusto, tubtub nga nakalab-ot sa Supreme Court sang India ang iya kaso, kag finally, nahatagan siya sang hustisya!
english: His wishes did not succeed, until his case reached the Supreme Court of India, and finally, he was served justice!

text: Nag-desisyon ang korte nga may kinamatarong si Ganesh nga mag-enrol sa Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery degree — butang nga wala na sini ginpalampas, nagtutom sa pag-eskwela sa Government Medical College sa Bhavnagar, kag subong isa na ka intern sa Sir-T Hospital sa Bhavnagar.
english: The court ruled that Ganesh was entitled to enroll in the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery degree — something he never missed, pursuing his studies at the Government Medical College in Bhavnagar, and is now an intern at Sir-T Hospital in Bhavnagar.

text: Bisan sa trabaho, may mga pasyente nga nagapakanubo sa estado ni Ganesh apang wala ini nagapaapekto kag ginahimo na lamang sang maayo ang iya nga obligasyon.
english: Even at work, there are patients who look down on Ganesh's state but it doesn't affect him and he just does his obligation well.

text: Wala pa ginkilala sang Guinness Book of Records si Ganesh, apang ginabansagan ini sang iban nga ‘world’s shortest doctor’ — butang nga wala sini ginakahuya bangud isa ini ka representasyon kun ano ka budlay ang iya gin-agyan agud lamang malab-ot ang iya mga handum.
english: The Guinness Book of Records has not yet recognized Ganesh, but some call him the 'world's shortest doctor' — something he is not ashamed of because it is a representation of how hard he went through just to achieve his dreams.

text: SUNU sa World Health Organization (WHO), wala pa sing nakuha nga  ebidensya nga ang isa ka pasyente nga naka-recover sa COVID-19 indi ma-re-infect, ukon liwat malatnan sang virus sini.
english: SUNU sa World Health Organization (WHO), wala pa sing nakuha nga  ebidensya nga ang isa ka pasyente nga naka-recover sa COVID-19 indi ma-re-infect, ukon liwat malatnan sang virus sini.

text: Tungod sini, kinahanglan nga mag-undergo sing counselling ang naka-recover nga pasyente bag-o siya ma-release sa ospital.
english: Because of this, the recovered patient must undergo counseling before being released from the hospital.

text: Nagpaandam man gani ang WHO sa mga gobyerno nga indi pa maghatag sang “immunity passport” sa sining naka-recover nga mga pasyente.
english: The WHO has even warned governments not to issue immunity passports to these recovered patients.

text: In fact, ang Brunei nag-report sadtong Abril 14 sang 11 ka naka-recover nga mga pasyente nga liwat na-infect.
english: In fact, Brunei reported on April 14 11 recovered patients who were reinfected.

text: Gani, ang Brunei Government nag-require sa ila sang re-swab testing agud maseguro gid nga wala sila liwat na-infect.
english: Therefore, the Brunei Government required them to undergo re-swab testing to ensure that they were not reinfected.

text: Kon  husto ang report nga nabaton naton, isa sang mga naka-recover sa COVID-19 si Senador Sonny Angara.
english: If the report we received is correct, one of those who recovered from COVID-19 is Senator Sonny Angara.

text: Ugaling, nag-report man siya nga liwat siya natapikan sang COVID-19 virus kag liwat nagpa-health care.
english: However, he also reported that he was reinfected with the COVID-19 virus and again sought health care.

text: Tungod sini, ginapa-practice gihapon ining mga pasyente nga naka-recover sa COVID-19 sing “utmost hygiene” agud malikawan ang “second infection”.
english: Therefore, these patients who have recovered from COVID-19 are still practicing “utmost hygiene” to prevent “second infection”.

text: Isa sang gina-require man sa ila ang paggamit gihapon sang face mask sa publiko, samtang sige pa ang pagduging sang COVID-19, nga ginapangamuyo naton matapna na sa indi na madugay.
english: One of the requirements is to continue wearing face masks in public, while the spread of COVID-19 continues, which we pray will be stopped soon.

text: Tani madiskubrihan na ang bakuna (vaccine) nga bagay diri, ukon indi gani mag-untat na gid lang ini tungod wala na sing host nga masudlan sila tungod sa husto nga pag-amlig sang aton mga pumuluyo.
english: Hopefully a vaccine will be discovered that is suitable for this, or else it will stop because there is no host for them to enter because of the proper protection of our people.

text:
***

Sunu mismo sa mga health authorities, ang isa ka tawo malatnan lang sang balatian nga COVID-19 kon mahaklo niya ang talsik sang droplets halin sa pag-ubo ukon pangatsi ukon pagdupla man sang infected nga kaatubang sing malapitan.
english:
***

According to the health authorities, a person can only be infected with COVID-19 if he inhales droplets from coughing or sneezing or spitting on an infected person.

text: In other words, kon wala man lang sing tawo sa malapitan nga naga-ubo ukon nagapangatsi, ukon gapanupla lapit sa imo, wala man sing masaylo nga COVID-19 virus sa imo kag, natural, indi man ka ma-infect sining dala niya nga balatian.
english: In other words, if no one nearby is coughing or sneezing, or sneezing near you, no COVID-19 virus will be transmitted to you and, naturally, you will not be infected with the disease it carries.

text: It appears nga kasubong man ang matabo – nga indi ka malatnan – bisan naga-ubo pa ukon gapangatsi, ukon gapanupla pa – ang sa imo atubangan sa imo malapit nga palibut, basta indi lang ka malab-ut sang droplets ukon laway sang malapit sa imo.
english: It appears that the same will happen – that you will not be infected – even if someone in front of you in your immediate environment is coughing or sneezing, or sneezing – as long as the droplets or saliva of someone close to you does not reach you.

text: Ini ang rason kon ngaa, finally, ginpasugtan man sang IATF ang pangabay ni Iloilo Gov Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: This is why, finally, the IATF also approved the request of Iloilo Gov. Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: ang angkasanay sa motorsiklo sang duha nga nagasakay nga may nagakaigu man nga proteksyon.
english: the motorcycle rider of the two riders with proper protection.

text: Si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang nagbalita sini sa Panay News sadtong pagsugilanon nila ni Secretary Carlito Galvez Jr., ang chief implementor sang national action plan sa coronavirus disease 19 (COVID-19).
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas made the announcement to Panay News during an interview with Secretary Carlito Galvez Jr., the chief implementer of the national action plan on coronavirus disease 19 (COVID-19).

text: Ang motorcycle design nga ginpresentar ni Gov.
english: The motorcycle design presented by Gov.

text: Defensor nagaseguro nga wala sing physical contact sa tunga sang drayber kag sang backrider, sa dugang pa nga sugid ni meyor.
english: Defensor ensured that there was no physical contact between the driver and the backrider, the mayor added.

text: Sa nahibl-an na, ginadumilian sang task force ang backriding tungod sa requirement sang physical distancing, nga at least isa ka metro.
english: As already known, the task force prohibits backriding due to the requirement of physical distancing, which is at least one meter.

text: Sa design ni gob may plastic divider sa tunga sa drayber kag backrider.
english: In gob's design there is a plastic divider between the driver and backrider.

text: Ining divider himo sa “non-porous, transparent material”.
english: This divider is made of “non-porous, transparent material”.

text: Ang divider naangtan man sing isa ka handle bar sa diin makapangunyapot ang backrider.
english: The divider is also attached to a handle bar where the backrider can hold on.

text: Ang pamangkot: Pwede man bala ang kasubong nga ideya sa diin makalapitay na ang mga tawo, katulad kon naga-attend sa isa ka gathering katulad sang concert, meeting, jogging pang-kadam-an, ukon ang paghampang sing basketball, nga popular nga kalingawan sang mga Filipino?
english: The question: Is a similar idea possible where people can get closer, such as when attending a gathering such as a concert, meeting, jogging in public, or playing basketball, which is a popular pastime of Filipinos?

text: Paano ini mahimo?
english: How can this be done?

text: Basi pwede ang isa ka mabakud kag transparent nga taklob sa ulo sang tawo nga may breather sa ubos sang sag-ang nga may epekto katulad sang personal protective equipment (PPE) nga ginagamit sang mga frontliners sa health facilities.
english: Perhaps a strong and transparent headgear with a breather under the chin can have the same effect as the personal protective equipment (PPE) used by frontliners in health facilities.

text: Pwede man ina seguro ma-imbento sang Pinoy.
english: That could probably be invented by a Filipino.

text: Tutal madamo man kita sang mga imbentor diri.
english: After all, we have a lot of inventors here.

text: Sa isa gani ka contest sa Espanya sa padamu-damo makuha nga gatas sa baka, daug gani kita!
english: In a contest in Spain to get the most cow's milk, we even won!

text: Paano?
english: How?

text: Ang uhaw nga toro ang ginkuhaan niya sing gatas!
english: He took milk from the thirsty bull!

text: He-he-he!
english: He-he-he!

text: Tani barato lang ining headgear nga ini agud makagamit man ang kadam-an kag indi mag-suicide ang iban sa kaaburido nga indi makalagaw-lagaw kag makapa-hangin-hangin.
english: I hope this headgear is cheap so that many people can use it and others will not commit suicide in the anxiety of not being able to walk around and get some fresh air.

text: Mas madamo pa sila kuno sangsa napatay sa COVID-19 diri sa Western Visayas, nga mga 11 ka tawo na!/PN
english: They are said to be more than the death toll from COVID-19 here in Western Visayas, which is about 11 people!/PN

text: Mangin host sang Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2026 ang Passi City.
english: Passi City will host the Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association (WVRAA) Meet 2026.

text: Ini ang gin-anunsyo ni Antique Provincial Administrator Atty. Neri Duremdes kadungan sang pagtakop sang WVRAA 2026 sa Binirayan Gym, San Jose de Buenavista, Antique.
english: This was announced by Antique Provincial Administrator Atty. Neri Duremdes during the closing ceremony of WVRAA 2026 at Binirayan Gym, San Jose de Buenavista, Antique.

text: Nahibaluan nga personal man nga nagtambong sa kahiwatan si Passi City Mayor Atty. Stephen Palmares.
english: Passi City Mayor Atty. Stephen Palmares.

text: Sa mensahe naman ni Dr. Ramir Uytico, Regional Director sang Department of Education (DepEd) Region 6 kadungan sang closing ceremony, ginpasalamatan sini ang mga atleta, coaches, local government units kag mga Schools Division sa ila nangin papel sa madinalag-on nga WVRAA 2025.
english: In his message, Dr. Ramir Uytico, Regional Director of the Department of Education (DepEd) Region 6 during the closing ceremony, thanked the athletes, coaches, local government units and Schools Division for their role in the successful WVRAA 2025.

text: Liwat nga ginpamatud-an sang Iloilo ang ila ikasarang sa hinampang matapos ginkilala bilang Champion sa Secondary Division kag Paragames.
english: Iloilo once again proved their ability in the game after being recognized as Champion in the Secondary Division and Paragames.

text: Samtang, nagpangibabaw naman ang Negros Occidental sa Elementary Division.
english: Meanwhile, Negros Occidental won the Elementary Division.

text: Naglab-ot sa 43 ang panibag-o nga narekord nga COVID-19 cases sa Western Visayas.
english: There are 43 new recorded COVID-19 cases in Western Visayas.

text: Santo sa Enero 17 nga bulletin sang Department of Health Region VI, 15 sa panibag-o nga kaso ang halin sa Bacolod City, 9 sa Aklan, duha sa Capiz, 11 sa Negros Occidental, kag anom sa Iloilo City.
english: According to the January 17 bulletin of the Department of Health Region VI, 15 of the new cases are from Bacolod City, 9 from Aklan, two from Capiz, 11 from Negros Occidental, and six from Iloilo City.

text: Narecord man ang dugang nga 11 ka recoveries kag wala na sang may nagdugang sa mga napatay.
english: There were also 11 additional recoveries and no additional deaths.

text: Ang Western Visayas ang may yara na subong sang 22,285 nga total reported cases sang COVID-19.
english: Western Visayas now has 22,285 total reported cases of COVID-19.

text: Sa sini nga numero, 754 ang active cases, 20,838 ang reported recoveries, kag 687 ang reported deaths.
english: Of these, 754 are active cases, 20,838 are reported recoveries, and 687 are reported deaths.
