text: Ginpang-clamp ang 11 tanan ka mga pribado nga salakyan nga naka-park sa likod sang kapitolyo kun sa diin may signage pa nga No Parking kahapon nga adlaw, Pebrero 12.
english: All 11 private vehicles parked behind the capitol where there is still a No Parking signage were clamped yesterday, February 12.

text: Pahayag sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Unit gna nagapatigayon sila sang clearing operations sa Magdalo, La Paz sang may nagpahibalo sa ila nga madamo ang naga-park sa likod sang kapitolyo rason nga gilayon nila ini nga ginkadtuan.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Unit said they were conducting clearing operations in Magdalo, La Paz when they were informed that many people were parking behind the capitol.

text: Nakit-an sang mga ini ang 11 ka mga pribado nga salakyan kun sa diin gilayon nila ini nga ginpangclamp.
english: They found 11 private vehicles where they immediately clamped them.

text: Gilayon n man nga nagbayad ang mga ini sang P1,000 nga penalty sa Iloilo City Hall agud nga makuha ang clamp sa ila nga mga salakyan.
english: They immediately paid a P1,000 penalty to the Iloilo City Hall to remove the clamp from their vehicles.

text: Suno sa mga tag-iya sang salakyan, nahimo nila nga magpark sa nasambit nga area bangud nga may ara sang nagpamaypay sa ila nga pwede magpark sa lugar.
english: According to the owners of the vehicles, they were able to park in the said area because someone waved to them that they could park in the area.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas Inday nga isa sa mga nagpapark, iya ginpahayag nga dugay na sila nga nagabulig sila sa mga tag-iya sang salakyan agud nga magpark sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alyas Inday, one of the parkers, said they have been helping vehicle owners to park in the area for a long time.

text: Nagpahayag naman ini nga ila man nga ginhambalan ang mga tag-iya sang salakyan nga indi anay paghalinan ang ila nga salakyan kag hulatun lang nga maguwa ang iban nga nakapark sa sulod sang capitol grounds.
english: He said they also told the owners of vehicles not to leave their vehicles and wait for others parked inside the capitol grounds to leave.

text: ANG China nag-offer agud i-prioritize ang paghatag (pagbaligya guro) sang vaccine kontra COVID-19 sa Filipinas.
english: CHINA has offered to prioritize the supply (presumably sale) of the vaccine against COVID-19 in the Philippines.

text: Kon ara na, siyempre.
english: Once there, of course.

text: Wala pa man!
english: Not yet!

text: Aba, huwag!
english: Alas, don't!

text: Kon may fake news, sobra-sobra gid ang pagka-fake sang China.
english: If there is fake news, China is very fake.

text: Substandard na ang mga produkto nga gina-import diri sa Filipinas, makahililu pa ang mga hampanganan nga ginabaligya sa aton mga kabataan.
english: The products imported here in the Philippines are substandard, the toys sold to our children are poisonous.

text: Mas fake pa gid ang iya relasyon sa aton.
english: His relationship with us is even more fake.

text: Illegal na ang ila pag-okupa sang daku nga bahin sang South China Sea tungod sa pagka-pierde sini sa International Criminal Court pabor sa Filpinas kag iban pa nga claimants diri, luyag pa sini intuon kita sang iya COVID-19 vaccine nga wala pa gani dahum-dahum kon magamit na.
english: Their illegal occupation of a large part of the South China Sea because of its loss in the International Criminal Court in favor of the Philippines and other claimants here, it wants to teach us its COVID-19 vaccine that is not even expected to be used.

text: Sa clinical trial pa lang pwede na kuno magamit ini.
english: It can only be used in clinical trials.

text: Sus a!
english: On to!

text: Daw Dengvaxia nga wala pa ma-confirm nga “safe” gamiton ginpatulon na sa aton mga kabataan.
english: It seems that Dengvaxia that has not yet been confirmed “safe” to use has been given to our children.

text: Ti, madamo gid ang nagreklamo.
english: Well, there were a lot of complaints.

text: Madamo na gani nga akusasyon ang napasaka angot sa pagkapatay sang mga kabataan tungod sini.
english: Many accusations have been filed regarding the deaths of children as a result.

text: Samtang hipos-hipos lang ang Estados Unidos, ang India, ang United Kingdom kag iban pa nga gapadayon sang ila clinical trials para maseguro kon bala indi lang “effective” ini kundi “safe” man, nga amo gid ang mayor nga dapat seguruhon.
english: Meanwhile, the United States, India, the United Kingdom and others are quietly continuing their clinical trials to ensure whether it is not only “effective” but also “safe”, which is the main thing to ensure.

text: Anhon ta abe ang “effective” nga bulong kon mapatay man lang ang pasyente despues.
english: What about the “effective” medicine if the patient dies later.

text: Indi gid kita magsalig sa sining made-in-China nga vaccine!
english: We should never trust this made-in-China vaccine!

text: Sining ulihi lang gani, nahibal-an nga madamo ang fake sa ila ginbaligya nga mga face mask kag personal protective equipment (PPE) para sa COVID-19.
english: Recently, it has been discovered that many of the face masks and personal protective equipment (PPE) for COVID-19 sold are fake.

text: In fact, nagpakuno-kuno pa sila nga wala nahibal-an parti sa COVID-19 tubtub naglapta na ini sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: In fact, they pretended not to know about COVID-19 until it spread all over the world.

text: In other words, mas “safe” ka pa nga maigu sang mild COVID-19 infection (80 ka porsyento diri a Filipinas), nga eventually mangin immune ka sa pag-ayo mo na, sangsa sa ining Chinese vaccine.
english: In other words, you are safer from getting a mild COVID-19 infection (80 percent here in the Philippines), which you will eventually become immune to when you recover, than from this Chinese vaccine.

text:
***

Halos isa na ka bulan ang ginahimo sang MORE Power nga preventive maintenance sang ila mga service units agud mangin mas masaligan kuno ang pagserbisyo nila sa mga pumuluyo sang siyudad sang Iloilo.
english:
***

MORE Power has been conducting preventive maintenance on its service units for almost a month to make their service to the residents of Iloilo City more reliable.

text: Ugaling lang kay kalawig gid sini nga nagalab-ut 10-13 oras, katulad sang natabo sa La Paz kag Jaro.
english: However, it is very long, reaching 10-13 hours, as happened in La Paz and Jaro.

text: Kag daw langkuyon gid nila ini sa lima pa ka distrito sang siyudad.
english: And they seem to be extending it to the other five districts of the city.

text: To be fair sa MORE, kami sa Mandurriao may mga brownout man.
english: To be fair to MORE, we in Mandurriao have brownouts too.

text: Pero okey lang kay matayog na ang 15 minutos kag mabalik man ang kuryente, kag malaka man matabo.
english: But it's okay because 15 minutes will pass and the power will come back on, and it's rare.

text: Gapasalamat man kita sa MORE sang kaukod sini sa pagpanglagas sang illegal connections, nga nagadugang sa balayran sang honesto nga konsumidor.
english: We also thank MORE for its diligence in pursuing illegal connections, which increase the bill of honest consumers.

text: Sa matandaan namon sa amon billing, ang systems loss nagalab-ut sa 16 ka porsyente.
english: As far as we can remember from our billing, the systems loss is 16 percent.

text: Hamak mo ina nga lukduhon pa sang mga pumuluyo nga wala nagakawat sang kuryente.
english: It's a shame that the residents who don't steal electricity will steal it.

text: Pero, wala gid kita sing dapat pasalamatan sa malawig nga brownout nga tuga sining preventive maintenance sang MORE.
english: However, we have nothing to thank for the long brownout caused by this preventive maintenance of MORE.

text: Perhwisyo gid!
english: What a loss!

text: Hambala pa kon ano ini nga mga perhwisyo sa aton pangabuhi kay magasaka lang ang imo blood pressure.
english: Tell me more about these harms in our lives because your blood pressure will only rise.

text: Madamo kuno ang dapat kalaayuhon sa mga service units, nga madamo sini wala pa seguro ma-repair sa kadugayon ukon maislan sang nagakadapat.
english: There are many things that need to be fixed in the service units, many of which have probably not been repaired or replaced in a long time.

text: Pero kinahanglan gid bala ang kasubong kadugay ining preventive maintenance – 10 tubtub 13 ka oras?
english: But is this preventive maintenance really necessary for so long – 10 to 13 hours?

text: Indi bala pwede ini i-schedule utay-utay agud indi man tuman kadugay gid?
english: Can't you schedule it a little bit at a time so it doesn't take too long?

text: Kon nahimo sang PECO ang malikawan ang kasubong nga problema sa brownout sadto, indi ayhan kaya man ini sang MORE?
english: If PECO was able to avoid the same brownout problem, can't MORE do the same?

text: Well, indi seguro tungod gani sa sining madugay nga pagluntad sang mga brownout.
english: Well, probably not because of the prolonged existence of brownouts.

text: Indi bala ginpasalig sang MORE ang Kongreso nga tagaan sing maayo nga serbisyo ang mga konsumidor kag malikawan na ang probema sa idalom  sang PECO?
english: Didn't MORE assure Congress that it would provide good service to consumers and avoid the problem under PECO?

text: In fact gintagaan ang MORE sing frankisa tungod sa sining ila pasalig.
english: In fact, MORE was given a franchise because of this commitment.

text: Ti, ara na ang ginasiling ninyo nga maayo nga serbisyo!
english: Well, there's what you call good service!

text: Kon indi kamo makasarang, kag pasalig lang gali sa Kongreso ang kaya ninyo, tani nangita man lang kamo sing expert sa problema sang PECO nga inyo ginpanubli.
english: If you can't afford it, and you can only promise Congress, you should have found an expert on the PECO problem you inherited.

text: Yara man si Engr.
english: Also present was Engr.

text: Randy Pastolero, ang anay PECO oprations officer nga karon executive assistant sa City Hall sa kuryente sang siyudad.
english: Randy Pastolero, the former PECO operations officer who is now executive assistant at City Hall on the city's electricity.

text: Tawgi lang ninyo si Engr.
english: Just call Engr.

text: Pastolero kg segurado makabulig ini kon paano solbaron ang problema sang madugay nga brownout.
english: Pastolero and surely this will help solve the problem of prolonged brownout.

text: Indi bala, Engr.
english: Isn't it, Engr.

text: Pastolero?/PN
english: Shepherd?/PN

text: Magadugang ang Pilipinas sang 912 pa ka public charging stations suno sa Department of Energy (DOE), kalabanan sini ang yara sa Metro Manila.
english: The Philippines will add 912 more public charging stations according to the Department of Energy (DOE), most of which are in Metro Manila.

text: Ginpahayag sang DOE nga agud mapadasig ang paglapta sang electric vehicles (EVs), ang ahensya magahimo sang bag-o nga mga pagsulundan kag magpatigayon sang konsultasyon sa publiko agud masiguro nga ang dugang nga charging networks ang safe, epektibo, kag sustainable.
english: The DOE stated that to accelerate the spread of electric vehicles (EVs), the agency will develop new regulations and conduct public consultation to ensure that additional charging networks are safe, effective, and sustainable.

text: Ipaguwa ang guidelines para sa EV charging station providers sini nga Abril, kag may yara sang konsultasyon sa ikaduha nga quarter para sa tuig 2025.
english: Guidelines for EV charging station providers will be released this April, and there will be a consultation in the second quarter for the year 2025.

text: Ang pungsod nagatarget nga makaangkon sang kapin sa 7,000 charging stations sang electric vehicles sa 2028.
english: The country is targeting to have more than 7,000 charging stations of electric vehicles by 2028.

text: ILOILO CITY- Sapulon ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: ILOILO CITY- Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: ang tanan nga mga alkalde sa Probinsya sang Iloilo matapos nga napirmahan na ang kasugtanan sa British-Swedish multinational pharmaceutical kag biopharmaceutical company nga AstraZeneca agud magbakal sang COVID-19 vaccine.
english: all mayors in Iloilo Province after signing an agreement with the British-Swedish multinational pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical company AstraZeneca to purchase the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga P65M ang ginpain sang probinsya para sa purchase price sang bakuna nga igahatag sa mga frontliners sa tagsa ka munisipalidad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Defensor said the province has allocated P65 million for the purchase price of the vaccine to be given to frontliners in each municipality.

text: Suno sa gobernador, ang mangin masunod nga tikang sang probinsya amo ang pagbalay sang executive order para sa detalye sang implementasyon sang vaccination plan sa probinsya.
english: According to the governor, the next step of the province will be to draft an executive order for the details of the implementation of the vaccination plan in the province.

text: Gin-athag man sang gobernador nga magluwas sa bakuna nga libre nga ihatag sang probinsya sa kabanwahanan, mahimo man nga makabakal ang tagsa ka Local Government Unit sang kaugalingon nga bakuna para sa ila pumuluyo.
english: The governor also explained that besides the vaccine that the province will provide free of charge to the municipalities, each Local Government Unit can also purchase its own vaccine for its residents.

text: Nahibaluan nga inisyal nga magabakal ang Iloilo Province sang 270,000 nga doses sang COVID-19 vaccine.
english: Iloilo Province will initially purchase 270,000 doses of the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Samtang, sa bahin naman sang mga pribado nga sektor ukon kompaniya nga magabakal sang kaugalingon nga bakuna para sa ila empleyado, ginpahayag ni Defensor nga mahimo magsulod sa multilateral agreement ini nga mga kumpaniya upod sa national government apang indi pa maathag sa gobernador kon paano ini patigayunon sa Iloilo.
english: Meanwhile, regarding the private sector or companies that will purchase their own vaccines for their employees, Defensor said that these companies can enter into a multilateral agreement with the national government but the governor is not yet clear on how to conduct it in Iloilo.

text: Ginsaylo sa Marso 4-7 ang schedule para sa pagpatigayon sang ikaduha nga Manila International Film Festival (MIFF).
english: The schedule for the second Manila International Film Festival (MIFF) has been postponed to March 4-7.

text: Orihinal kuntani ini nga patigayunon sa Enero 30-Pebrero 2 apang ginpaiway anay bangud sa wildfires sa Southern California.
english: It was originally scheduled for Jan. 30-Feb. 2 but was postponed due to wildfires in Southern California.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang organizers nga ang pors yon sang proceeds halin sa events lakip na sa screenings ang iga-donar para sa fire relief efforts sa Los Angeles.
english: Organizers also confirmed that a portion of the proceeds from the events including the screenings will be donated to fire relief efforts in Los Angeles.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa MIFF, ang tanan nila nga events ang may yara sang fundraising aspect.
english: In fact, according to MIFF, all of their events have a fundraising aspect.

text: Dayunon man ang entries plus special screening films sa TCL Chinese Theatre sa Hollywood kag may simple closing night event nga “A Tribute to Our First Responders” sa International Ballroom sang Beverly Hilton sa Beverly Hills.
english: There will also be entries plus special screening films at the TCL Chinese Theater in Hollywood and a simple closing night event “A Tribute to Our First Responders” at the International Ballroom of the Beverly Hilton in Beverly Hills.

text: Diri itanyag ang libre nga admission sa first responders sa sunog amo man sa ila nga immediate families.
english: Free admission will be offered to first responders to the fire as well as their immediate families.

text: Ang “A Tribute Dinner to Our First Responders” nga amo ang closing night ceremonies amo naman ang magapadungog sa mga tawo nga nagbulig tapna sa wildfires.
english: The “A Tribute Dinner to Our First Responders” which is the closing night ceremonies will honor the people who helped stop the wildfires.

text: Lakip sa entries nga dal-on didto sa California amo ang “And the Breadwinner Is..”; “Espantaho”; “Green Bones”; “Hold Me Close”; “My Future You”; “Strange Frequencies: Taiwan Hospital Killer”; “The Kingdom”; “Topakk”; kag ang “Uninvited”.
english: Among the entries to be brought to California are “And the Breadwinner Is..”; “Scare”; “Green Bones”; “Hold Me Close”; “My Future You”; “Strange Frequencies: Taiwan Hospital Killer”; “The Kingdom”; “Topack”; and “Uninvited”.

text: May special screening man ang “The Debut”; “Love Hurts” ; “Faith Healers”; “Nurse Unseen”; “A Filipino in America”; kag ang box office record-breaking nga “Hello, Love, Again”.
english: There will also be a special screening of “The Debut”; “Love Hurts” ; “Faith Healers”; “Nurse Unseen”; “A Filipino in America”; and the box office record-breaking “Hello, Love, Again”.

text: Magabisita si Pope Leo XIV sa pungsod sang Turkey kag sa Lebanon.
english: Pope Leo XIV will visit Turkey and Lebanon.

text: Suno sa Vatican, ini ang una niya nga biyahe bilang Santo Papa halin sang siya ang nagpungko sa puwesto sang Mayo kasunod sang pagtaliwan ni Pope Francis.
english: According to the Vatican, this is his first trip as Pope since he took office in May following the death of Pope Francis.

text: Matabo ang pagbisita sa Turkey sa Nobyembre 27 tubtob 30.
english: The visit to Turkey will take place on November 27 to 30.

text: Ginalauman nga makakit-anay sila kag maka-istoryahanay ni Patriarch Bartholomew, ang spiritual nga lider sang mga Orthodox nga Kristiyano.
english: They are expected to meet and talk with Patriarch Bartholomew, the spiritual leader of Orthodox Christians.

text: Pagkatapos sini, magapadayon siya sa Lebanon halin Nobyembre 30 tubtob Disyembre 2.
english: After that, he will continue in Lebanon from November 30 to December 2.

text: Ginapaabot nga makapakig-angut siya sa mga Kristiyano nga ara sang Middle East agud magpanawagan sang kalinong sa lugar.
english: He is expected to meet with Christians in the Middle East to call for peace in the area.

text: MABUHAY ang Filipinas sa pag-selebrar naton sang aton independencia sa adlaw nga ini, Hunyo 12!
english: LONG LIVE the Philippines as we celebrate our independence on this day, June 12!

text: Tandaan ta ugaling nga ang aton kusog bilang nasyon nga Hilway kag maka-Diyos wala gasandig sa aton lang pang-kaugalingon nga pagpanikasug.
english: Let us remember, however, that our strength as a free and godly nation does not depend on our own efforts.

text: Indi na ina masaligan sa subong nga lakat sang kalibutan.
english: That's not reliable in today's world.

text: Gasandig ini sa aton pagpakig-ugyon kag kooperasyon sa iban nga pungsod sa diin may komun kita nga values kag aspirations, samtang gahatag respeto sa kinamatarong sang iban sa ila man pagpati nga may pag-amlig, ugaling, batok sa lipot nga mga hingyu nga makahalit sa aton.
english: It is based on our solidarity and cooperation with other countries where we have common values ​​and aspirations, while respecting the rights of others to their beliefs with protection, however, against narrow demands that harm us.

text:
***

Wala na seguro sing mas popular pa nga folktale para sa mga kabataan sa Grade school sangsa istorya ni Pinocchio.
english:
***

There is probably no more popular folktale for Grade school children than the story of Pinocchio.

text: Isa ini ka puppet nga himo sa kahoy nga nangin isa ka bata nga nagkilala bilang amay ang karpintero nga naghimo sa iya.
english: It was a wooden puppet that turned out to be a child who recognized as father the carpenter who made him.

text: Kilala ini si Pinocchio sa iya pagbinutig.
english: Pinocchio is known for his lying.

text: Tungod sini ginpenahan siya sang fairy godmother nga nagalaba ang iya ilong sa kada tion nga magbinutig siya.
english: Because of this, the fairy godmother punished him with a long nose every time he lied.

text: Nonetheless, nagtudlo ining iya istorya sang leksyon sa iya kag sa iban nga kabataan agud  mangin matuod-tuoron sa pagsugid sang kamatuoran.
english: Nonetheless, this story taught her and other children a lesson to be honest in telling the truth.

text: Ugaling indi kasubong kahapos ang paghibalo naton kon ang isa ka tawo gabinutig ukon wala.
english: But it's not that easy to tell if someone is lying or not.

text: Wala kita sing ilong katulad ni Pinocchio.
english: We don't have noses like Pinocchio.

text: Nagakinahanglan ini sang husto nga pagkilala sa panimuot sang isa ka tawo kag pagsayasat sang iya matuod nga motibo batok sa aton kag sa iban man, labi na gid kon daku nga kahalitan ang mangin bunga sini.
english: This requires accurately recognizing a person's motives and examining his true motives against us and others, especially if the result is great harm.

text: Gani, amlig gid kita kag ipahatag ang bagay nga penalidad sa butigon agud madudla kag magtadlong na ang iya dila.
english: Therefore, let us be very careful and give the right penalty to the liar so that his tongue will be cut off and straightened.

text:
***

Sa aktuwal nga hitabo, may mga kaso sang pagbinutig nga sobra gid ang halit nga natuga sa mga biktima.
english:
***

In actual events, there have been cases of lying that have caused too much damage to the victims.

text: Isa na diri ang daku nga binutig ni Bernie Madoff sadtong 2007, sa diin nanguna siya sa pagpakamalaut sa illegal practices samtang taghambal sa isa ka conference sa Wall Street.
english: One of these was Bernie Madoff's big lie in 2007, when he took the lead in condemning illegal practices while speaking at a conference on Wall Street.

text: Siling ni Madoff, nga “imposible ang kalokohan sa stock market”.
english: Madoff said, that “stock market nonsense is impossible”.

text: Ang Wall Street famoso nga lugar sa Manhattan, New York kon diin ginabaligya kag ginabakal ang stocks (investment shares) sang mga dalagku nga mga negosyo.
english: Wall Street is a famous place in Manhattan, New York where stocks (investment shares) of big businesses are sold and bought.

text: Nabisto si Madoff ugaling nga promotor man gali sang kalokohan sa iya mismo negosyo.
english: Madoff, however, was known to be a promoter of fraud in his own business.

text: Ang ginahatag niya nga profit share halin gali sa ginaamot mismo sang mga investors kag indi sa legitimo nga negosyo nga nagabaligya sang mga produkto.
english: The profit share he gives is actually from the investors themselves and not from legitimate businesses that sell products.

text: Ang ining negosyo ginatawag sa Italy sadto nga Ponzi scheme.
english: This business was called in Italy at the time a Ponzi scheme.

text: Katulad ini sa ilegal nga pyramidal scheme sa Filipinas.
english: This is similar to the illegal pyramidal scheme in the Philippines.

text: Sang madakpan siya, nahibal-an sang mga otoridad nga isa ka “big lie” gali ang iya negosyo.
english: When he was arrested, the authorities learned that his business was a “big lie”.

text: Ang sentensya sa iya naglab-ut sa 150 ka tuig sa prisuhan.
english: His sentence was up to 150 years in prison.

text: Salamat sa kaukod sang mga otoridad kay nabawi ang at least $11 ka bilyon sang $18 ka bilyon nga natyope niya sa mga investors.
english: Thanks to the diligence of the authorities, at least $11 billion of the $18 billion he stole from investors was recovered.

text: Isa pa ka negosyo nga naga-earn sa daku nga binutig amo ang pila ka kompaniya sa sigarilyo nga nagagamit sing binutig nga propaganda.
english: Another business that profits from the big lie is some tobacco companies that use false propaganda.

text: Sa ila promotional ad ila ginasiling: “Not a cough in a carload” kag “Cigarette smoking is no more addictive than coffee, tea, or twinkles”.
english: In their promotional ad they say: “Not a cough in a carload” and “Cigarette smoking is no more addictive than coffee, tea, or twinkles”.

text: Sunu ugaling sa US Center for Disease Control and Prevention mga 480,000 nga Amerikano ang nagakapatay sa sigarilyo kada tuig.
english: However, according to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, about 480,000 Americans die from cigarettes each year.

text: Tungod sini, apat sa dalagku nga kompaniya sang sigarilyo ang ginsugo sang husgado sa pagbayad sa 46 ka estado sing $206 ka bilyon sa sulod sang 25 anyos para sa medical costs sang smoking-related nga balatian.
english: As a result, four of the largest cigarette companies were ordered by the court to pay 46 states $206 billion over 25 years for the medical costs of smoking-related disease.

text: Mas daku gid seguro ang kahalitan sang binutig sang Tsina angot sa COVID-19.
english: China's lies about COVID-19 are probably more damaging.

text: Sunu kay President Trump, tungod sang paghinagu sini sang kamatuoran angot sa COVID-19, sa lugar nga mapunggan ini sa paglapta dira mismo sa Tsina, napabay-an ini sa paglapta sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: According to President Trump, because of his hiding the truth about COVID-19, instead of preventing it from spreading in China, it was neglected to spread around the world.

text: Ining kahalitan sa karon nagalakip sang 7,145,539 ka confirmed cases sang COVID-19 kag 408,025 ang patay, as of June 10, 2020.
english: This damage currently includes 7,145,539 confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 408,025 deaths, as of June 10, 2020.

text: Kon ibutang ini sa balor sang kwarta, lab-ut ini sa binilyon nga kwarta nga sa karon gnahikutar sang pila ka pungsod nga dapat bayaran sang Tsina.
english: In monetary terms, it amounts to billions of dollars that some countries are currently holding that China must pay.

text: Of course, gina-deny ini sang Tsina, sa pagsiling nga nangin “transparent” sila parti sa mga kaso sang COVID-19./PN
english: Of course, China denies this, saying they have been “transparent” about COVID-19 cases./PN

text: Nangin labing-una nga team ang Cleveland Cavaliers nga nakasulod sa National Basketball Association (NBA) playoffs subong nga season.
english: The Cleveland Cavaliers became the first team to reach the National Basketball Association (NBA) playoffs this season.

text: Natabo ini matapos ang 112-107 nga kadalag-an sang Cavs batok sa Miami Heat nga amo ang opisyal nga naghatag sa team sang spot sa postseason sa ikatatlo nga sunod-sunod nga tuig.
english: It came after the Cavs’ 112-107 victory over the Miami Heat officially earned the team a spot in the postseason for the third straight year.

text: Ini man ang makabig pinakamaayo nga performance sang franchise halin sang nakalab-ot sila sa finals sa apat ka sunod-sunod nga season sang yara pa sa ila si LeBron James sang 2015-2018.
english: It would also be considered the franchise’s best performance since reaching the finals in four consecutive seasons when LeBron James was still with them in 2015-2018.

text: Ang ila pagdaog batok sa Heat amo man ang ika-12 nga consecutive win subong nga season.
english: Their win over the Heat was also their 12th consecutive win this season.

text: Nanguna sa Cleveland si Donovan Mitchell nga may 26 points kag si Darius Garland nga may 10 assists.
english: Cleveland was led by Donovan Mitchell with 26 points and Darius Garland with 10 assists.

text: Matabo ang una nga round sang playoffs sa Abril 19.
english: The first round of the playoffs will take place on April 19.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, 29-32 ang win-loss record sang Heat subong nga season kag nagapang-pito sa standings sa Eastern Conference.
english: Meanwhile, the Heat have a 29-32 win-loss record this season and are seventh in the standings in the Eastern Conference.

text: Magakalit si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will be surprised.

text: sa pagpataas sang suplay sang produktong petrolyo sa pungsod antes magtakop ang duha ka semana nga ceasefire sang Estados Unidos kag Iran sa Middle East.
english: to increase the supply of petroleum products in the country before the end of the two-week ceasefire between the United States and Iran in the Middle East.

text: Suno kay Marcos nga posible gid nga makabulig ang nasambit nga ceasefire agud nga mapanubo ang presyo sang gatong sa pungsod.
english: Marcos said the ceasefire is likely to help reduce fuel prices in the country.

text: Nagalaum man ang Presidente nga magapadayon ang amo nga ceasefire pananglitan nga mag-ayuhay na ang Amerika kag Iran.
english: The President also hopes that the ceasefire will continue if the United States and Iran reconcile.

text: Dugang pa sini nga magatinguha man ang gobyerno nga makahimo sang hilway nga arrangement sa amo nga rehiyon, agud nga magbalik na sa normal ang presyo sang gatong.
english: He added that the government will also try to make a free arrangement in the region, so that the price of fuel will return to normal.

text: Isa sa mga rason sa pag-overload sang mga pasahero sa mga modernized jeepney amo ang quota sa mga kundoktor.
english: One of the reasons for overloading passengers in modernized jeepneys is the quota on conductors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo Boyet Parcon, Chairman sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, iya ginpahayag nga kun maglapaw ang mga kundoktor sa ila nga mga quota, may ara sila sang makuha nga porsyento.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo Boyet Parcon, Chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, said that if conductors exceed their quotas, they will get a percentage.

text: Apang suno man sa iya, may ara gid sang mga salawayon nga kundoktor kun sa diin bisan pa nga tuman na kagutok sa sulod sang pampubliko nga salakyan, padayun sagihapon sang mga ini nga ginapasulod ang iban nga mga pasahero.
english: However, he said, there are still reprehensible conductors where even though it is very crowded inside public transportation, they continue to let other passengers in.

text: Pahayag man niya, makapila naman ka beses nga nakabaton ang ila opisina sang reklamo nahanungod sa overloading sang ila nga mga unit.
english: He said his office has received several complaints regarding the overloading of their units.

text: Suno man sa iya nga naga-ubra naman sila sang mga tikang agud nga gilayon nga madakpan ang mga salawayun nga mga kundoktor kag masuspende ang mga ini sa ila nga mga ginapang-obra.
english: He said they are taking steps to immediately arrest the guilty conductors and suspend them from their jobs.

text: Nagapati man siya nga dapat komportable ang mga pasahero sa ila nga ginasakyan kag indi dapat magtuga sang problema sa mga ini.
english: He also believes that passengers should be comfortable in their rides and should not cause problems to them.

text: Dugang pa niya, wala nila ginatolerar ang overloading kag nagpahayag man nga pabor sya sa programa kun sa diin dakpon ang mga pasaway nga mga kundoktor kag hatagan sang penalidad.
english: He added that they do not tolerate overloading and said he is in favor of the program where irregular conductors will be arrested and given penalties.

text: Ginpangayo ang bulig sang mga kaparian agud nga matapna ang mga nagapanguna nga problema sa mga eskwelahan sa pungsod nga amo ang nagatuga sang krisis sa edukasyon.
english: The help of the priests was sought to address the main problems in the country's schools that are causing the education crisis.

text: Kabahin ini sang na-istoryahan sa 42nd National Social Action General Assembly (NASAGA) 2026 sang Caritas Philippines sa Tagaytay City.
english: This was part of the discussion at the 42nd National Social Action General Assembly (NASAGA) 2026 of Caritas Philippines in Tagaytay City.

text: Ini nga pagtilipon ang gina-updan sang mga obispo, clergy, kag social action workers agud nga makatutok sa misyon sang simbahan para sa social justice kag iban pa nga isyu kaangay sang kalinong.
english: This gathering is joined by bishops, clergy, and social action workers to focus on the church's mission for social justice and other issues such as peace.

text: Ang isa sa resource persons amo ang Executive Director sang Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2).
english: One of the resource persons was the Executive Director of the Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2).

text: Suno kay Msgr.
english: According to Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, director sang Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), nagtutok ang EDCOM 2 sa makatulublag nga reports kaangot sa epekto sang mass promotion, malnutrisyon, kag bullying sa mga kabataan.
english: Meliton Oso, director of the Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center (JASAC), said EDCOM 2 focused on disturbing reports regarding the impact of mass promotion, malnutrition, and bullying on children.

text: Sa mass promotion, ginapasaka sa masunod nga grade level ang mga estudyante sa mga pampubliko nga eskwelahan apisar nga kulang sa kapasidad kag kaalam.
english: In mass promotion, students in public schools are promoted to the next grade level despite lacking capacity and knowledge.

text:
Sa bullying, ginsulit ni Oso ang report sang EDCOM 2 kag data sang international assessments nga nag-resulta sa pagbansag sa Pilipinas bilang “bullying capital of the world”

Sa malnutrisyon, ginplastar man sini ang datos kun sa diin indi husto ang preparasyon ukon kakulang sang pagkaon nga may malain nga epekto sa ikaayong-lawas sang kabataan.
english:
On bullying, Oso reiterated the report of EDCOM 2 and data of international assessments that resulted in the Philippines being called the “bullying capital of the world”

On malnutrition, he also presented data where improper preparation or lack of food has a negative impact on children's health.

text: Gin-cite man sini ang pagtuon sang UNICEF paagi sa World Vision PH nga 95 ka mga Pilipino ang nagakapatay kada adlaw bangud sang malnutrisyon.
english: He also cited a study by UNICEF through World Vision PH that 95 Filipinos die every day due to malnutrition.

text: Suno kay Oso, ginbaton sang kaparian ang hangkat sang EDCOM 2 nga buligan sila nga ma-address ini nga isyu paagi sa pagbulig sa feeding program kag library para sa kabataan.
english: Oso said the priests accepted the challenge of EDCOM 2 to help them address this issue by helping with the feeding program and library for the children.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa mga nutritionist nga mag-volunteer sa feeding program kag library program nga plano sang JASAC.
english: He also called on nutritionists to volunteer in the feeding program and library program planned by JASAC.

text:
Una naman nga nagpahayag ang Department of Education (DepEd) nga pasangkaron pa sini ang partnership sini sa simbahan kag sa civil society organizations para sa de-kalidad nga edukasyon para sa tanan nga mga Pilipino nga kabataan.#

Photo: Caritas Philippines
english:
Earlier, the Department of Education (DepEd) said it will further strengthen its partnership with the church and civil society organizations for quality education for all Filipino children.

Photo: Caritas Philippines

text: Nanindugan ang aktres nga si Karla Estrada nga bunga sang paghigugma ang pag-angkon niya sang apat ka kabataan nga lain-lain ang mga amay.
english: Actress Karla Estrada insists that having four children with different fathers is the fruit of love.

text: Suno sa iya, tinuig man ang pag-updanay nila sang kada isa sa nangin karelasyon niya nga nagtapos gihapon sa pagbulagay.
english: According to her, they were also together for years with each of her ex-boyfriends who ended up breaking up.

text: Pahayag ni Karla nga apisar gusto man niya nga isa lang ang iya partner, wala siya sang sarang mahimo kun indi na gid man maayo ang dalagan sang kada lalaki nga iya nakarelasyon sang una nga nangin mga amay sang iya anak.
english: Karla said that although she wants to have only one partner, she has no choice but to have a bad relationship with each man who became the father of her daughter.

text: Dugang niya, sa mga nangin amay sang iya mga anak, indi magnubo sa tatlo ka tuig ang ila relasyon gani masiling niya nga bunga gid sang paghigugma ang iya kabataan.
english: He added that to those who became the fathers of his children, their relationship has been at least three years so he can say that his children are the fruit of love.

text: Nagtimbuok ang inbound milk shipments sang Pilipinas sang malapit 20 percent sang nagligad nga tuig bangud sa pagkuha sang mga traders sa mas madamo nga pungsod agud malab-ot ang nagataas nga demand para sa gatas.
english: The Philippines' inbound milk shipments grew by nearly 20 percent last year due to the recruitment of traders in more countries to meet the rising demand for milk.

text: Sa report sang National Dairy Authority (NDA), ang volume yara sa 3.5 billion liters sang 2024, nga nagtaas sang 19.9 percent halin sa 2.9 billion liters sang 2023.
english: In a National Dairy Authority (NDA) report, the volume stands at 3.5 billion liters in 2024, up 19.9 percent from 2.9 billion liters in 2023.

text: Suno sa ahensya, ang value sini naglab-ot sa P80.1 billion, nga nagtaas sang halos 5 percent gikan sa P76.3 billion.
english: According to the agency, its value reached P80.1 billion, up nearly 5 percent from P76.3 billion.

text: Santo sa report, ang 39.62-percent nga pagsaka sa skim milk powder imports kag ang 15.69-percent rise sa iban nga powdered milk imports, kaupod ang mas mataas nga liquid ready-to-drink milk nga ginbakal overseas ang nagpa-improve sang volume sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the report, a 39.62-percent increase in skim milk powder imports and a 15.69-percent rise in other powdered milk imports, along with higher liquid ready-to-drink milk purchased overseas improved the volume last year.

text: Yara na sa deportation area ang Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) nga una na nga na-report nga priso sa pungsod sang Kuwait sang Enero 26, 2026.
english: The Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) who was first reported imprisoned in Kuwait on January 26, 2026, is now in the deportation area.

text: Ini amo si Maricris Lapatero Sacatin, residente sang Poblacion, San Rafael kag 13 na ka tuig nga naga-ubra bilang Domestic Helper sa luwas sang pungsod sa isa lang ka amo.
english: This is Maricris Lapatero Sacatin, resident of Poblacion, San Rafael and has been working as a Domestic Helper abroad for 13 years with the same employer.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Cynthia Dario, Head sang Public Employment Services Office sang Probinsya sang Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa detention center, nasaylo na ini sa deportation area kag ginahulat nalang ang pirma sang Minister of Interior sang State of Kuwait.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Cynthia Dario, Head of the Public Employment Services Office of Iloilo Province, said that from the detention center, he was transferred to the deportation area and is waiting for the signature of the Minister of Interior of the State of Kuwait.

text: Padayon man nga nagakoordinar ang PESO sa talatapan sang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) kag Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) bangud sila mismo ang may direkta nga komunikasyon sang gobyerno sang Kuwait.
english: PESO also continues to coordinate with the offices of the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) and the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) as they themselves have direct communication with the Kuwaiti government.

text: Nahibaluan nga nalapas sang amo sang OFW ang Labor Law sang Kuwait bangud nagaubra ini bilang Part-time cook sa negosyo mismo sang iya amo nga wala sang nagakaigo nga permiso.
english: It was learned that the OFW's employer violated the Labor Law of Kuwait because he worked as a part-time cook in his employer's own business without proper permission.

text: Makatalandog-balatyagon ang panawagan sang isa ka Lola nga naggamit sang pangalan sang Argentine football superstar nga si Lionel Messi agud nga makaluwas sa isa ka daku nga katalagman.
english: The appeal of a grandmother who used the name of Argentine football superstar Lionel Messi to save herself from a serious danger is touching.

text: Istorya ini sang 90-anyos nga si Ester Cunio nga nagapuyo didto sa Israeli Kibbutz nga Nir Oz.
english: This is the story of 90-year-old Ester Cunio, who lives in the Israeli Kibbutz Nir Oz.

text: Sang Oktubre 7, 2023 ukon ang adlaw nga nag-atake ang Hamas sa southern Israel kag nagpangdala sang mga bihag, isa ang balay ni Ester sa mga ginsulod sang armado nga kalalakinhan.
english: On October 7, 2023 or the day Hamas attacked southern Israel and took hostages, Esther’s house was one of those broken into by armed men.

text: Sang amo nga adlaw, ginpamangkot ang Lola kun sa diin ang iban nga myembro sang iya pamilya apang indi ini makasabat sang maayo sa Hebrew ukon mangin sa English.
english: That day, the grandmother was asked where the other members of her family were but she could not answer well in Hebrew or even in English.

text: Ginsilingan sini ang lalaki nga ang ginagamit gid sini nga lengguwahe amo ang Argentinian-Spanish bangud tumandok siya sang Argentina kag tigulang na sang nagsaylo sa Israel.
english: He told the man that his only language was Argentinian-Spanish because he was a native of Argentina and was old when he moved to Israel.

text: Daw nagapanginit na ang lalaki, agresibo, kag nagpamangkot sa Lola kun ano ina ang Argentinian!
english: The man seemed to be getting hot, aggressive, and asked Lola what that Argentinian was!

text:
Nagsabat si Lola: “Nagalantaw ka bala sang football?” Sang nagtango ang lalaki, nagsiling si Lola: “Didto ako halin sa lugar ni Messi!”

Nakibot ang tawo kag naglain ang trato sini sa Lola kag ginsiling pa sini nga idol sini ang amo nga footballer gani iya gin-agbayan ang tigulang, ginpa-uyatan ang iya nga AKA47 gun, nag-peace sign, kag nagpa-picture pa.
english:
Grandma replied: “Do you watch football?” When the man nodded, Grandma said: “I’m from Messi’s place!”

The man was shocked and treated the grandmother badly and said that the footballer was his idol so he hugged the old man, held his AKA47 gun, made a peace sign, and took a picture.

text: Nakaluwas ang Lola apang ang masakit nga bahin sang istorya sang Lola amo ang panawagan sini kay Messi.
english: The Grandmother survived but the painful part of the Grandmother’s story was its appeal to Messi.

text: Pahayag sini, kun malantaw sang football star ang iya istorya, kuntani manawagan ini nga mahilway na sang Hamas ang mga hostages.
english: He said that if the football star watched his story, he would have called for Hamas to release the hostages.

text: Didto nalakip sa mga bihag ang iya duha ka apo nga sanday David kag Ariel nga nalakip sa gin-abduct sang Hamas militants sang amo nga adlaw sang 2023.
english: There among the hostages were his two grandchildren, David and Ariel, who were among those abducted by Hamas militants on that day in 2023.

text: Ginahulat pa ang mangin sabat sang world champion sa sini nga panawagan sang tigulang ilabi na bangud ginsuportahan man sini anay ang 2014 match nga gin-organisar ni Pope Francis agud nga matib-ong ang kalinong sa tunga sang Israelis kag Palestinians.#
english: The world champion's response to the old man's call is still awaited, especially since he also supported the 2014 match organized by Pope Francis to promote peace between Israelis and Palestinians.

text: Gin-utdan sang dila ang 82-anyos nga lolo sa ila balay samtang nagakatulog ini sa Brgy.
english: An 82-year-old grandfather was cut off his tongue while sleeping in his house in Brgy.

text: Military, Tukuran, Zamboanga del Sur.
english: Military, Tukuran, Zamboanga del Sur.

text: Ginkilala ang biktima kay Rogelio Chavez, suno sa anak sang biktima natabo ang insidente pasado las-4 sang kaagahon sang Lunes, Nobyembre 24.
english: The victim was identified as Rogelio Chavez, according to the victim's son. The incident occurred around 4 am on Monday, November 24.

text: Nabatian sang anak sang biktima nga may kinagamo nga nagakatabo sa puluy-an sang iya amay kag gilayon niya ini ginkadtuan.Didto kag naabtan niya ang suspek nga ginkilala kay alyas “Kimkim,” nga ginapatihan nga may problema sa paminsaron.
english: The victim's son heard that there was a commotion at his father's house and immediately went to him. There he found the suspect identified as alias “Kimkim,” who is believed to have mental problems.

text: Ginpahayag pa sang anak sang biktima nga pasado las-5 sang aga, nagpangabay pa gid ang suspek nga tapuson ang pag-utod sang dila sang iya amay, apang gilayon niya ginkuha ang dala sang suspek agud mapunggan ang ginabalak sini.
english: The victim's son said that around 5 am, the suspect asked him to finish cutting off his father's tongue, but he immediately took the suspect's hand to stop what he was planning.

text: Sa subong, pagpermahanay sang pamilya sang biktima kag sang suspek sang kasugtanan sa Barangay.
english: The victim's family and the suspect are currently signing an agreement with the Barangay.

text: Masami ginapangita sang kadam-an nga mga Pilipino amo ang epektibo nga mga cream, habon ukon ano man nga makapaputi ukon makapapino sang supat.
english: Most Filipinos often look for effective creams, soaps or anything that can whiten or refine the skin.

text: Apang ano ikaw ka sigurado nga safe ang mga ginagamit mo nga pampaputi ukon pampagwapa?
english: But how sure are you that the whitening or beauty products you use are safe?

text: Ang Asia Pacific region ang may pinakadako nga share sa global skin lightening products sa merkado.
english: The Asia Pacific region accounts for the largest share of global skin lightening products in the market.

text: Samtang ang Pilipinas amo ang nagapanguna sa listahan nga mahilig magbakal sang mga pampaputi.
english: Meanwhile, the Philippines tops the list of people who like to buy whitening products.

text: Suno kay Thony Dizon, isa ka chemical safety campaigner, ang mga baratuhon nga mga creams ukon pampaputi nga ginagamit sa nawong ang delikado sa panit bangud may yara ini sang mercury content.
english: According to Thony Dizon, a chemical safety campaigner, cheap creams or whitening products used on the face are dangerous to the skin because they contain mercury content.

text: Ang ini nga mga produkto ang mabakal sa tindahan nga nagabalor lamang sang singkwenta pisos (P50).
english: These products can be purchased at the store for only fifty pesos (P50).

text: Ang paggamit sang produkto nga may mercury kag pagbutang sini sa supat adlaw-adlaw ang nagatuga sang tremors, kidney failures kag birth defects sa baby para sa mga nagabusong.
english: Using mercury products and putting them in the mouth every day causes tremors, kidney failures and birth defects in the baby for pregnant women.

text: Gani panugyan sang doktor, kun luyag gid nga magpaputi, mangin mahinalungon sa mga ginabakal nga skin whitening products.
english: So the doctor's advice, if you really want to whiten, be careful with the skin whitening products you buy.

text: Nagalalain ang tag-iya sang motorsiklo sa Brgy.
english: Motorcycle owner in Brgy.

text: Quintin Salas, Jaro, matapos nga ginkawat ang iya motor kahapon nga adlaw, Pebrero 11.
english: Quintin Salas, Jaro, after his motorcycle was stolen yesterday, February 11.

text: Ang ginkawat nga motor amo ang XRM Honda nga may duag pula, puti kag itom kun sa diin may temporary plate number ini nga 080103.
english: The stolen motorcycle was a red, white and black XRM Honda with temporary plate number 080103.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa nagapanag-iya sang motor nga si Alyas Joni, iya ginpahayag nga bata niya nga estudyante ang naggamit sang motorsiklo kun sa diin angkas man niya ang iya utod nga babayi antes nadula.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the owner of the motorcycle, alias Joni, said his daughter, a student, used the motorcycle with her sister before disappearing.

text: Pahayag niya nga ginbilin lang sa bahin sang nasambit nga barangay ang motorsiklo bangud nga naga-commute ang mga ini pakadto sa ila nga tutor sa San Vicente, Jaro.
english: He said the motorcycle was left in the barangay because they were commuting to their tutor in San Vicente, Jaro.

text: Sang nagapakadto na sila sa ila motor, nakit-an pa sang bata sini nga babayi nga daw ila motor ang gamit sang isa ka lalaki apang ginbalewala niya ini.
english: When they were on their way to their motorcycle, the girl's daughter saw a man's motorcycle but she ignored it.

text: Sang nag-aot na ang mga ini sa lugar nga ginbilinan sang motor, wala na nila ini makita kag nagdesisyon nalang nga magpauli agud pamangkuton ang ila amay kun siya ang nagkuha sang motor.
english: When they reached the place where the motorcycle was left, they could not find it and decided to go home to ask their father if he took the motorcycle.

text: Matapos nila nga makapauli, didto nila sang nakumpirma nga wala ang ila amay nagkuha ukon naggamit sang nadula nga motorsiklo.
english: After they returned home, they confirmed that their father had not taken or used the missing motorcycle.

text: Nagpahayag naman ang isa ka parking boy nga nakit-an sini ang suspek apang wala siya sang ihibalo nga amo ini ang nagkawat sang motor.
english: A parking boy said he saw the suspect but did not know that he stole the motorcycle.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas Alog, iya ginpahayag nga posible nga matudlo niya ang suspetsado ilabi na kun makita niya liwat ang itsura sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alog said he is likely to identify the suspect especially if he sees his face again.

text: Suno sa iya, madasig man nga napaandar sang motornapper ang ginkawat nga motorsiklo, rason nga wala man siya nagduda diri.
english: He said the motornapper was able to start the stolen motorcycle quickly, so he did not suspect it.

text: May pagnubo sa presyo sang liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) products epektibo subong nga adlaw, Abril 1.
english: There is a reduction in the price of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) products effective today, April 1.

text: Sa Solane, may rollback nga P0.27 per kilo epektibo 6:00 subong nga aga.
english: In Solane, there will be a rollback of P0.27 per kilo effective 6:00 this morning.

text: Samtang sa Petron naman, nagnubo man ang LPG prices sang P0.25 per kilo umpisa 12:01 kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Meanwhile, in Petron, LPG prices also decreased by P0.25 per kilo from 12:01 this morning.

text: Ini nga duha ka mga kumpaniya ang nag-implementar man sang rollback sa sini nga produkto sang Marso 1, 2025.
english: Both of these companies have also implemented a rollback on this product on March 1, 2025.

text: ANG enrolment sa school year 2020-2021 sa public kag private schools nagsugod na sadtong Hunyo 1, samtang ginatalana man ang klase sa hayskul, elementarya, kindergarten kag pre-school sa Agosto 24, 2020.
english: Enrollment for the 2020-2021 school year in public and private schools began on June 1, while classes in high school, elementary, kindergarten and pre-school are also scheduled for August 24, 2020.

text: May schedule man ang Higher Education sa idalom sang CHED.
english: Higher Education also has a schedule under CHED.

text: Ugaling, hibaluan pa naton ini.
english: However, we still have to find out.

text: Tungod sa pagpamahog gihapon sang Covid-19, wala sing face-to-face (F2F) nga pagpa-enrol.
english: Due to the still threat of Covid-19, there will be no face-to-face (F2F) enrollment.

text: Himuon lang ini online, paagi sa telefono, ukon sa iban pa nga paagi nga itugyan sang Dept.
english: This will only be done online, by telephone, or by other means assigned by the Dept.

text: of Education.
english: of Education.

text: Sa pag-enrol, ginatagaan sing choice ang estudyante kon ano ang maluyagan sini nga mode sang pagtuon.
english: Upon enrollment, the student is given a choice of which mode of learning to prefer.

text: Blended bala – online kag home work sa puluy-an?
english: Is it blended – online and home work at home?

text: Ukon lubos nga online, lubos nga home work sa puluy-an, ukon sa ano pa nga paagi nga mapanugyan sang DepEd.
english: Or fully online, fully home work at home, or in any other way that the DepEd recommends.

text: Ipatuman man sang DepEd – labi na gid sa hayskul – ang Modular Curriculum sa diin ang estudyante may malawak nga opportunidad sa pagpili sang iya “program of study” nga bagay sa iya interes, kag ginapakita nga skills kag competence, katulad sang aptitude sa entrepreneurship kag iban pa nga specialization (modular courses) agud mas epektibo sa ulihi nga worker sa sosyedad.
english: The DepEd will also implement – ​​especially in high school – the Modular Curriculum where students have ample opportunity to choose their program of study that suits their interests, and demonstrated skills and competence, such as aptitude in entrepreneurship and other specializations (modular courses) to be more effective workers in society.

text: Ginapasanyog man sini ang Independent Learning, sa diin ang konsentrasyon amo ang student-subject matter connectivity kag less sa tunga sang estudyante kag manunudlo.
english: It also promotes Independent Learning, where the concentration is on student-subject matter connectivity and less between student and teacher.

text: Indi ko ugaling lubos ma-imagine kon paano ining modular courses ipatuman sang DepEd tungod wala man ini sing paathag.
english: However, I cannot fully imagine how the DepEd will implement these modular courses because there is no explanation.

text: Segurado ko lang nga ang kadam-an magapili sang Home Schooling kag indi F2F sa classroom agud likawan ang Covid-19.
english: I am sure that the majority will choose Home Schooling and not F2F in the classroom to avoid Covid-19.

text:
***

Nonetheless, tagaan ta kamo sang ideya kon paano ko sadto ginpatuman ang Independent Learning nga bahin sang Modern Education nga naabtan ko sa akon panahon bilang estudyante kag manunudlo sang ulihi sa hayskul sa University of Iloilo kag, sang ulihi, sa Iloilo City (Molo) National High School bag-o ako nagsaylo sing interes sa pangabuhi.
english:
***

Nonetheless, let me give you an idea of how I implemented the Independent Learning part of Modern Education that I experienced during my time as a student and teacher later in high school at the University of Iloilo and, later, at Iloilo City (Molo) National High School before I changed my interest in life.

text: Sa Modern Education nga ginapatuman na sadto, ang pagtudlo natutok sa mga konsepto sang Discovery Learning, Critical Thinking, kag Independent Learning, nga amo man ang mayor nga goal sang Modular Education sa karon.
english: With Modern Education already in place then, teaching is focused on the concepts of Discovery Learning, Critical Thinking, and Independent Learning, which is also the main goal of Modular Education at present.

text: Major specialization ko ang Math kag Geometry ang akon ginatudlo sa Molo High.
english: I majored in Math and Geometry at Molo High.

text: Mabudlay gid man ang Math sa kabataan, labi na gid sa lower sections sa diin ang mas mahina man ang gatupa diri.
english: Math is very difficult for children, especially in the lower sections where the weaker ones also fall here.

text: Na-assign ako sa sections 12-15.
english: I was assigned to sections 12-15.

text: Nangin mas interesante na ang pagtuon sang mga kabataan sa Discovery Learning.
english: Children have become more interested in learning with Discovery Learning.

text: Napalawak man ang Critical Thinking nila paagi sa combined inductive kag deductive reasoning, nga ginapahapos pa sang konsepto sang sets, subsets kag universal set.
english: Their Critical Thinking is also expanded through combined inductive and deductive reasoning, which is further facilitated by the concepts of sets, subsets and universal sets.

text: Ang problema ko na lang amo kon paano itudlo ang Independent Learning sa kabataan, nga nagahatag emphasis sa student-subject matter connectivity.
english: My only problem was how to teach Independent Learning to children, emphasizing student-subject matter connectivity.

text: Una gid, ginpatuon ko anay ang akon estudyante sa kwarto sa isa ka tsapter sang student edition nga libro.
english: First, I had my student in the room study a chapter of the student edition book.

text: Sadtong panahon indi makahatag ang eskwelahan sang libro sa kada estudyante.
english: In those days the school could not give a book to every student.

text: At best, tunga lang sang klase.
english: At best, only half a class.

text: So, ginapa-share ko ang duha sa isa ka libro.
english: So, I’m having the two share one book.

text: Dayon gwa ko sa kwarto sa sulod sang mga 20 minutes sang 40 minutes nga klase, kag magbalik.
english: Then I leave the room for about 20 minutes of the 40 minute class, and come back.

text: Ipasara ang libro kag tagaan sing test sa ila gintun-an.
english: Close the book and give them a test on what they have learned.

text: Tsekan ang ila ubra kag ipahibalo ang resulta sa ila nga may upod nga grado, samtang ginaupdan ini sang paathag ang resulta.
english: Check their work and announce the result to them with a grade, accompanied by an explanation of the result.

text: Sa mga mas mahina (unfortunately, tanan gid sila), ang ginahatag ko amo ang sample problems.
english: For the weaker ones (unfortunately, they all are), what I give is sample problems.

text: Ginapatun-an sa ila sa kwarto.
english: They are taught in the room.

text: Dason tagaan sila sing test, kon indi dayon sa masunod pa nga adlaw.
english: Then they will be given a test, if not immediately the next day.

text: Ining test amo-amo man sa sample problems nga ginaligwat lang ang mga detalye nga madale na nila ma-answeran.
english: This test is similar to the sample problems where the details are repeated so that they can easily answer them.

text: Daw wala man gani kinalis ining pagtudlo ko sa classroom, nga amo man gihapon seguro ang ginahimo sang karon nga mga manunudlo, sa pagpatudlo sang Modular Education sa karon sa sulod lang sang puluy-an sang estudyante.
english: It seems that my teaching in the classroom, which is probably still done by teachers today, is no different from teaching Modular Education now inside the student's home.

text: Pwede man gihapon magkilalahay kag magsugilanon ang estudyante kag ang manunudlo paagi sa celfone nga kaugalingon ukon ginhulaman, ukon makaduaw man si ma’am ukon si sir sa importante nga kahigayunan.
english: The student and the teacher can still meet and talk through their own or borrowed cellphone, or ma’am or sir can visit on important occasions.

text: In fact, indi gid man problema ang home schooling tungod Independent Learning man ang ginapatuman kag kumpleto man sing instructional materials ang mga estudyante.
english: In fact, home schooling is not a problem because Independent Learning is also implemented and the students are complete with instructional materials.

text: May bentaha pa gani ini sa estudyante tungod makatuon siya kon san-o luyag niya magtuon – sa aga, hapon ukon bisan sa gab-i pa./PN
english: It even has an advantage for the student because he can study when he wants to study – in the morning, afternoon or even late at night./PN

text: Ginakabig nga top 7 nga makamamatay nga cancer sa bilog nga kalibutan amo ang liver cancer.
english: Considered top 7 deadly cancer worldwide is liver cancer.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Elvin Tiangha, iya ginpahayag nga cancer sa atay amo ang resulta sang pagdako sang mga hepatic cells sa lawas sang tawo nga nagatuga sang tumor.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Elvin Tiangha, he said liver cancer is the result of the growth of hepatic cells in the human body that cause tumors.

text:
Suno kay Dr. Tiangha, pila sa mga sintomas ang liver cancer amo ang masunod:

Ang pagbulong naman sang nasambit nga balatian suno kay Tiangha, amo ang pagpatigayon sang operasyon agud kuhaon ang tumor sa atay pinaagi sa liver transplant.
english:
According to Dr. Surprisingly, some of the symptoms of liver cancer are as follows:

The treatment of the disease, Tiangha said, is to undergo surgery to remove the tumor from the liver through a liver transplant.

text: Pahayag sang doktor, mahimo pilian sang pasyente agud nga makapabulong amo ang chemotherapy, immunotherapy, kag radiation therapy.
english: According to the doctor, the patient can choose from chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and radiation therapy.

text: Agud makalikaw sa liver cancer, nagakadapat nga hibaluon ang health status sang partner bag-o makighilawas, likawan ang mga mapait nga pagkaon, pag-inom sang alcohol, kag untatan ang pagpanigarilyo.
english: To prevent liver cancer, it is important to know the health status of the partner before having sex, avoid spicy foods, drinking alcohol, and quit smoking.

text: Importante man suno sa doktor ang pag-angkon sang healthy lifestyle pinaagi sa diet kag exercise.
english: The doctor said it is also important to have a healthy lifestyle through diet and exercise.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong nga bulan sang Enero amo ang Liver Cancer and Viral Hepatitis Awareness and Prevention Month.
english: It is known that this month of January is Liver Cancer and Viral Hepatitis Awareness and Prevention Month.

text: Nag-ulan ang simpatiya sang fans para sa anay National Basketball Association (NBA) champion nga si Klay Thompson nga isa sa nabilin sa gamay nga paglaum sang Dallas Mavericks subong nga season.
english: Fans showered sympathy for former National Basketball Association (NBA) champion Klay Thompson, who is one of the few hopes left for the Dallas Mavericks this season.

text: Nag-sulod si Thompson sa Mavs agud nga mabuligan sanday Kyrie Irving kag Luka Doncic nga makabawi na kuntani subong nga tuig, kag mabulsa ang NBA Championship matapos nagkabos sila kag nalutos sa kamot sang Boston Celtics sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Thompson joined the Mavs in order to help Kyrie Irving and Luka Doncic recover this year, and pocket the NBA Championship after they fell short and lost at the hands of the Boston Celtics last year.

text: Apang sa isa ka makakilibot nga hitabo, gin-trade sang Mavs si Doncic sa Los Angeles Lakers, kag subong nga semana, nagsuprer naman si Irving sang injury kag indi na makabalik sa bilog nga season.
english: But in a surprise move, the Mavs traded Doncic to the Los Angeles Lakers, and this week, Irving suffered an injury and will not return for the rest of the season.

text: “It hasn’t been 48 hours since I tore my ACL, but the recovery process already started mentally, spiritually, emotionally,” suno kay Irving sa iya nga Instagram Live.
english: “It hasn’t been 48 hours since I tore my ACL, but the recovery process has already started mentally, spiritually, emotionally,” Irving said in his Instagram Live.

text: “I just wanted to let you guys know I’m OK, and I will be OK moving forward.
english: “I just wanted to let you guys know I’m OK, and I will be OK moving forward.

text: It does suck a lot, I ain’t gonna lie to you guys.
english: It does suck a lot, I ain’t gonna lie to you guys.

text:
This one stings for sure.”

Mangin ang anay Lakers star nga si Anthony Davis ang nagasuprer man subong sang injury kaupod sa iban pa nga Mavs players nga sanday Daniel Gafford kag Dereck Lively II.
english:
This one stings for sure.”

Former Lakers star Anthony Davis is also suffering from an injury along with other Mavs players Daniel Gafford and Dereck Lively II.

text: Dugang pa sa injury ni Irving amo si Jaden Hardy nga nakaangkon man sang sprained ankle sa 122-98 loss sang Dallas batok sa Sacramento Kings.
english: Adding to Irving’s injury is Jaden Hardy who also suffered a sprained ankle in Dallas’ 122-98 loss to the Sacramento Kings.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang summer sang 2024 sang natapos ang 13 ka tuig ni Klay sa Golden State Warriors matapos ang apat ka kampyonato kaupod sa franchise.
english: It is known that in the summer of 2024 when Klay's 13 years with the Golden State Warriors ended after four championships with the franchise.

text: Wala sini ginpirmahan ang gin-report nga kontrata nga gintanyag sang Lakers agud kuntani maupdan si LeBron James.
english: He did not sign the reported contract offered by the Lakers to join LeBron James.

text: Subong nga season, may average si Klay nga 13.8 points.
english: This season, Klay is averaging 13.8 points.

text: “The injuries we’ve had this season, guys are trying to hold it together to get other bodies back,” pahayag naman ni Mavericks head coach Jason Kidd.
english: “The injuries we’ve had this season, guys are trying to hold it together to get other bodies back,” Mavericks head coach Jason Kidd said.

text: “And then it just seems every time we get close to getting someone back, someone else goes down….
english: “And then it just seems every time we get close to getting someone back, someone else goes down….

text: We’re running out of bodies here.
english: We’re running out of bodies here.

text:
But guys keep fighting.”

32-30 subong ang team kag pang-10 sa Western Conference.
english:
But guys keep fighting.”

The team is now 32-30 and 10th in the Western Conference.

text: Gina-monitor na sang Task Force on Moral Values and Formation (TFMVF) ang mga accommodation establishments kaangay sang Lodging Houses, Pension Houses, Inns, Hotels, Motels kag Apartelles, para sa palaabuton nga Valentine’s Day sa Pebrero 14.
english: The Task Force on Moral Values ​​and Formation (TFMVF) is already monitoring accommodation establishments such as Lodging Houses, Pension Houses, Inns, Hotels, Motels and Apartelles, for the upcoming Valentine’s Day on February 14.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Nestor Canong, head sang Task Force, iya ginpahayag nga naglab-ot na sa 22 ka mga establisyemento ang ila nga ginpangkadtuan kag gin-remind angot sa ordinansa nga nagadumili sa pagsulod sang mga menor de edad sa nasambit nga mga establisyemento sa amo nga adlaw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Nestor Canong, head of the Task Force, said they have already visited 22 establishments and reminded them of the ordinance that prohibits minors from entering these establishments on that day.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Iloilo City Regulation Ordinance No.
english: It is known that Iloilo City Regulation Ordinance No.

text: 2015-447 ang istrikto nga ginapatuman para sa proteksyon sang mga menor de edad.
english: 2015-447 is strictly enforced for the protection of minors.

text: Ini amo ang ordinansa nga nagapahanumdom sa kun sin-o man ukon amo man nga establisyamento ang madakpan, ang mahimo nga multahan sang P5,000 ukon silutan sang pagkapreso sa masulod sang isa ka tuig kag possible nga kanselasyon sang business permit.
english: This is an ordinance that reminds anyone or the same establishment caught, can be fined P5,000 or punished with imprisonment for one year and possible cancellation of business permit.

text: Suno kay Canong, may ara ila sang mga personnel kag Community Watch Group nga magabantay mismo sa mga establisyemento sa tion sang Valentine’s Day.
english: According to Canong, they have personnel and Community Watch Groups who will guard the establishments during Valentine's Day.

text: Ginpreso ang duha ka yaya matapos nga nalumos ang ila ginabantayan nga apat ka tuig nga bata nga lalaki sa swimming pool sa Talisay City, Cebu.
english: Two nannies were arrested after their four-year-old son drowned in a swimming pool in Talisay City, Cebu.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, natulugan ang duha ka yaya kag wala nila mabantayan ang bata nga naggwa sa ila balay kag naghampang sa swimming pool tubtob nahulog kag nalumos.
english: According to the investigation, the two nannies fell asleep and did not notice the child who went out of their house and played in the swimming pool until he fell and drowned.

text: Ginpasakaan sang kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting to homicide ang duha ka yaya.
english: The two nannies were charged with reckless imprudence resulting in homicide.

english: ONE OF maybe five readers of our column has wondered why it's playing online, when they know it comes out every Wednesday and Friday.

text: Daw mga apat gid ka beses kuno nga ginpangita niya ang aton kolum sa Panay News Online pero wala gid, kag ina tungod indi man mabuksan ang website sini sa sining mga tinion.
english: It seems that he searched for our column in Panay News Online about four times but nothing happened, and that's because the website can't be opened at these times.

english: Among these friends are ICPO spokesperson Police Capt.

english: Sheila Mae Sangrines, Toto Lopez of Metro Manila and our two friends in Midnight Sun country in Europe.
