english: Even Atty. Gene Original, one of our closest frat brod who also often appears on our Facebook page.

text:
***

Ang Panay News kilala bilang isa sang mga maisug nga independent regional newspaper nga may bumalasa indi lang sa mga Ilonggo community, kundi sa halos tanan sang reading public, sa pungsod nga malab-ut sini tungod sa appeal sini sa hilway nga mga pumuluyo.
english:
***

Panay News is known as one of the brave independent regional newspapers that has readers not only in the Ilonggo community, but in almost all of the reading public, in the country it reaches because of its appeal to the free people.

text: Indi ayhan gina-censor ini kon kis-a sang gobyerno tungod wala ini sing qualms, ukon pagpangalag-ag,  sa paghimo sang isyu batok diri?
english: Isn't it sometimes censored by the government because it has no qualms, or hesitation,  to make an issue against it?

text: Indi man seguro.
english: Probably not.

text: Well… depende na lang ina sa inyo kon indi kamo magpati.
english: Well... that's up to you if you don't believe it.

text: Hilway man kamo, katulad ko, I believe, sa inyo man pagpati.
english: You are free, like me, I believe, in your beliefs.

text:
***

Nahangpan naton kon ngaa luyag updan sang aton mga lideres, lakip na ni Presidente Duterte, ang balatyagon sang aton mga pumuluyo agud indi anay pasugtan ang pagbukas sang mga klase sa subong nga school year 2020-2021.
english:
***

We understand why our leaders, including President Duterte, want to join the feelings of our people in order not to allow the opening of classes in the current school year 2020-2021.

text: Matuod, sin-o man nga lider abe ang magsuay sang balatyagon sang kadam-an, luas lang kon itulod liwat ang martial law sa pungsod sa diin ang juez de cuchillo sang militar naman ang magagahum.
english: It is true that any leader can violate the feelings of the people, unless martial law is restored in the country where the juez de cuchillo of the military will rule.

text: Sig-ano nga sila naman ang sikwayon sang mga pumuluyo.
english: How can they be rejected by the people?

text: Pero, sa san-o nga rason?
english: But, for what reason?

text: Tungod lang sa kahadlok sa COVID-19?
english: Just because of the fear of COVID-19?

text: Ara na ako da.
english: I'm already there.

text: Pero, wala na bala sing medyos agud indi kita mahadlok sa COVID-19 para sa aton mga kabataan?
english: But, is there no way to keep us from being afraid of COVID-19 for our children?

text: Siling ni President Duterte nga luyag lang niya tugtan ang pagbalik-eskwela sang mga kabataan kon ma-develop na ang vaccine kontra COVID-19 sa sunod nga tuig.
english: President Duterte said he only wants to allow children to return to school once a vaccine against COVID-19 is developed next year.

text: Ang problema lang dira kay sa matuod wala kita pihu kon san-o ma-develop ang vaccine sa COVID-19.
english: The problem is that we are not sure when the vaccine for COVID-19 will be developed.

text: Posible sa pila lang ka bulan ukon sa sunod nga tuig, ukon sa sulod pa sang isa ka dekada ukon 10 ka tuig, sunu gani sa mga mangin-alamon sa siyensya.
english: It could be in a few months or next year, or even within a decade or 10 years, according to scientists.

text: Ang problem pa gid kay basi wala gid sing ma-develop nga vaccine sa COVID-19.
english: The problem is that there may never be a vaccine developed for COVID-19.

text: In fact, wala pa sing vaccine nga na-develop sa sulod na sang sobra 50 ka tuig nga pagtuon batok sa HIV nga virus nga nagatuga sang balatian nga AIDS.
english: In fact, no vaccine has been developed in more than 50 years of research against the HIV virus that causes AIDS.

text: Isa sang nabiktima sini ang popular nga Hollywood actor nga si Rock Hudson, nga ginkamatay gid sini sing temprano pa.
english: One of its victims was the popular Hollywood actor Rock Hudson, who died prematurely.

text: Kon may treatment agud makapa-slow down sang pag-atake sang HIV kag punggan ang panglaton sini amo lang ang mga retroviral nga mga bulong nga nagpadugay sang kabuhi sang famoso nga NBA player nga si Ervin “Magic” Johnson.
english: If there is a treatment to slow down the attack of HIV and prevent its spread, it is the retroviral drugs that prolonged the life of the famous NBA player Ervin “Magic” Johnson.

text: Ang SARS-CoV-1, nga himata ni COVID-19, nadula lang gani nga wala sing na-develop nga vaccine halin sadtong 2003 tubtub karon.
english: SARS-CoV-1, a relative of COVID-19, has disappeared without a vaccine being developed since 2003 until now.

text: In other words, indi naton masaligan ining pagpati ni Presidente Duterte nga ma-develop na ang vaccine kontra COVID-19 sa sunod nga tuig.
english: In other words, we cannot trust President Duterte's belief that a vaccine against COVID-19 will be developed next year.

text:
***

Meantime, ma-sufrir ang aton objective sa “continuing education” kag “walang dapat maiwan” tubtub kon ano man ka dugay nga ma-develop ang vaccine kontra COVID-19, nga basi abtan pa madamo nga tagkiriwi.
english:
***

Meantime, our objective of “continuing education” and “nothing should be left behind” will suffer no matter how long it takes to develop a vaccine against COVID-19, which may reach more people.

text: Tungod sini, sugot ako sa panugyan ni Education Secretary Briones nga i-implementar ang “blended” nga pagpatuman sang pagpa-eskwela sang mga kabataan.
english: Therefore, I agree with the suggestion of Education Secretary Briones to implement the “blended” implementation of children's education.

text: Sugot man ako sa panugyan ni Health Secretry Duque nga ipatuman ang pagbukas sang eskwelahan sa diin mapasalig  naton nga “safe” ang mga kabataan batok sa COVID-19, katulad sa Guimaras nga may zero cases.
english: I also agree with Health Secretary Duque's advice to implement the opening of schools where we can ensure that children are “safe” against COVID-19, like Guimaras with zero cases.

text: Kag, sa mga eskwelahan nga may peligro, nga ipatuman ang “distance education” kag ang katulad sa “correspondence school” nga pagpa-eskwela sa mga kabataan.
english: And, in schools at risk, to implement “distance education” and similar “correspondence school” education for children.

text: Angot diri, pwede naton makuhaan leksyon (see my column May 27) ang Taiwan kag China kag iban pa nga pungsod nga nagapatuman sang kasubong nga “blended” nga edukasyon sa ining panahon sang COVID-19./PN
english: In this regard, we can learn lessons (see my column May 27) from Taiwan and China and other countries that are implementing such “blended” education during this time of COVID-19./PN

text: Pagpasalamat, pagpangayo sang pasaylo, kag pagpabilin sang pagtuo sa Diyos.
english: Thank you, apologize, and keep your faith in God.

text: Amo ini ang kaundan sang emosyonal nga mensahe sang 37-anyos nga actress-vlogger nga si Alex Gonzaga para sa iya bana nga si Lipa City Councilor Mikee Morada matapos ginsapubliko sang mister nga nahulugan ang aktres sa ikatatlo na nga tion.
english: This is the content of the emotional message of 37-year-old actress-vlogger Alex Gonzaga for her husband, Lipa City Councilor Mikee Morada, after the husband made it public that the actress fell for the third time.

text: Sa iya recent YouTube video, gin-detalye ni Alex ang iya birthday celebration sang Enero 16 lakip na ang family dinner kag pagbisita sa Lipa City Hospital agud nga maghatag sang donasyon sa mga iloy kag sa ila mga lapsag.
english: In his recent YouTube video, Alex detailed his birthday celebration on January 16 including a family dinner and a visit to Lipa City Hospital to donate to mothers and their babies.

text: Didto man sa video nahibaluan nga antes ang birthday ni Alex, na-ospital ini sang Enero 9.
english: The video also reveals that before Alex's birthday, he was hospitalized on January 9.

text: Sa iya mensahe sini, ginsiling sini kay Mikee nga bisan nadula sa ila ang ila ‘little miracle’, magapadayon sila sa pagpati bangud sa bulig sang Ginuo, maangkon gid nila ang pamilya nga ila ginapangamuyo.
english: In his message, he told Mikee that even though they lost their 'little miracle', they will continue to believe because with the help of the Lord, they will have the family they prayed for.

text: “Dearest Mikee, I’m so sorry for our loss.
english: “Dearest Mikee, I’m so sorry for our loss.

text: The little miracle we had will always stay with us.
english: The little miracle we had will always stay with us.

text: Let’s keep believing.
english: Let’s keep belief.

text: By God’s grace, we will have the family we have always prayed for.
english: By God’s grace, we will have the family we have always prayed for.

text: Love, Catherine,” pahayag ni Alex.
english: Love, Catherine,” Alex stated.

text: May separado man nga Instagram post kun sa diin makit-an si Mikee nga nagasaot samtang yara sa hospital bed ang iya asawa.
english: There was also a separate Instagram post where Mikee was seen dancing while his wife was in the hospital bed.

text:
Caption sini: “My favorite memory is when my husband made sure I was happy before my medical procedure.”

Disyembre 28 sang ginpahibalo kanday Alex kag Mikee nga wala nagmadinalag-on ang pagdala sang aktres bangud nadulaan ini sang heartbeat.
english:
Caption it: “My favorite memory is when my husband made sure I was happy before my medical procedure.”

On December 28, Alex and Mikee were informed that the delivery of the actress was unsuccessful because she had lost her heartbeat.

text: Antes sini, nahulugan man si Alex sang 2021 kag 2023.
english: Before that, Alex also fell in 2021 and 2023.

text: Bisan masakit suno kay Mikee, ginakabig nila ini nga eksperyensya nga amo ang nagapabaskog sang ila relasyon bilang mag-asawa.
english: Although painful, Mikee said, they consider this experience to be what strengthens their relationship as a couple.

text: Na-engage ang duha sang January 2020 kag nagpakasal sadtong November 2021.
english: The two got engaged in January 2020 and married in November 2021.

text: INSPIRED sang aton nagligad nga kolum “Power of Love…” (Panay News, May 20, 2020), gina-dedicar naton ang aton kolum sa subong nga isyu sa isa ka tumalagsahon nga pagpalangga kag paghatag inspirasyon sa isa ka grupo sang katawhan nga gin-sikway sang ila katilingban.
english: INSPIRED by our previous column “Power of Love…” (Panay News, May 20, 2020), we dedicate our column in today’s issue to an extraordinary love and inspiration to a group of people who have been rejected by their society.

text: Siya si Saint Damien Joseph de Veuster (1840-1889), isa ka Belgian missionary sang Catholic Church nga nag-volunteer sa pagpuyo upod sa mga aruon (lepers) sa ila settlement sa Kalawao sa isla sang Molokai, Hawaii.
english: He was Saint Damien Joseph de Veuster (1840-1889), a Belgian missionary of the Catholic Church who volunteered to live with lepers (lepers) in their settlement at Kalawao on the island of Molokai, Hawaii.

text: Natandug gid ang iya balatyagon sa ila kahimtangan kag nag-volunteer nga ma-assign didto agud makabulig sa ila spiritual kag dutan-on nga kinahanglanon tubtub sa iya kamatayon.
english: He was deeply moved by their plight and volunteered to be assigned there to care for their spiritual and earthly needs until his death.

text: Napatay siya nga nangin aruon man sa ulihi nga tinion sang iya kabuhi.
english: He died of leprosy in the later part of his life.

text: Gin-deklarar siya nga isa ka santo sang Catholic Church nga ang pyesta natalana sa Mayo 10.
english: He was declared a saint by the Catholic Church with the feast scheduled for May 10.

text:
***

Ginakangil-aran sadto ang mga aruon kag daw pinunubol pa sang Kahitaasan sa pagpati nga ang ila balatian tuga sang daku nga pagpakasala nga diri pa lang sa duta ginasilutan na.
english:
***

Lepers were despised and seemed to be driven by the Most High to believe that their illness was the result of a serious sin that was already being punished here on earth.

text: Ini nga balatian nga aru (Leprosy, ukon Hansen Disease) ginakahadlukan kag ginakarigmaan sang mga tawo bisan pa sa panahon ni Hesukristo sa duta.
english: This disease of leprosy (Hansen's Disease) was feared and feared by people even in the time of Jesus Christ on earth.

text: Luas nga makalalaton ang aru, marigkam ka sa pagtan-aw sa ila na-disfigure nga kahimtangan nga daw zombie sa pelikula ang hitsura ang matam-an gid.
english: Besides being contagious, leprosy is shocking to see in their disfigured state that looks like a zombie in a movie.

text: Ginpakita ugaling ni Hesukristo nga indi ini sila mga pinunubol sang Kahitaasan agud mag-antos sa katubtuban.
english: Jesus Christ, however, showed that they were not sent by the Most High to suffer forever.

text: Isa sa ila nagpilit gid sa pagpalapit sa Ginuo.
english: One of them insisted on coming to the Lord.

text: Ginbaton niya ini nga wala sing pagkangil-ad kag gilayon ginpaayo niya ini.
english: He accepted it without disgust and immediately made it better.

text: Padayon nga wala sing bulong ang leprosy tubtub sa ika-19 ka siglo (19th century) tubtub nga madiskubrihan ini ni Dr. Gerhard Henrik Armauer Hansen sang Norway sadtong 1873.
english: Leprosy remained incurable until the 19th century when it was discovered by Dr. Gerhard Henrik Armauer Hansen of Norway in 1873.

text: Sa pagdiskubre sini ni Dr. Hansen, napamatud-an niya nga ang leprosy ginatuga sang isa ka mikrobyo kag indi panublion ukon bunga sang curse (gaba), ukon sang daku nga pagpakasala, kay bisan ang mga inosente pwede magmasakit sini.
english: In this discovery, Dr. Hansen, he proved that leprosy is caused by a germ and not the inheritance or fruit of a curse (gaba), or of great sin, for even the innocent can become ill with it.

text: Ang leprosy pwede na sa karon mabulong paagi sa multi-drug treatment gamit ang antibiotics.
english: Leprosy can now be treated with multi-drug treatment using antibiotics.

text:
***

Sadtong 1860, gin-igu sang aru ang Hawaii, sa diin, pagkaligad sang tatlo ka tuig, mga 10-15 ka porsyento sang populasyon ang nalatnan na sang balatian nga ini.
english:
***

In 1860, smallpox struck Hawaii, where, three years later, about 10-15 percent of the population was infected with the disease.

text: Nagdulot ini sing tuman nga kasubo sa mga pasyente sini, labi na gid kay wala pa sadto sing bulong para sa ila balatian.
english: This caused great distress to its patients, especially since there was no cure for their disease.

text: Masakit man ang kamaturan nga lubos sila mabulag sa ila mga pamilya.
english: The fact that they are completely separated from their families is also painful.

text: Dugang pa kay nangin miserable ang ila kahimtangan didto sa ila settlement.
english: In addition, their situation in their settlement became miserable.

text: Tungod sini, nanawagan na ang mga pahayagan sa Hawaii sa mga misyoneryo kag mga charitiable institutions agud buligan sila.
english: As a result, newspapers in Hawaii have called on missionaries and charitable institutions to help them.

text: Tungod gani sa kapeligro sang balatian nga leprosy, bisan ang apostolic vicar sa Hawaiian Islands, nga si Bishop Luis Maigret, daw gapang-alang-alang sa pag-assign didto sang mga misyoneryo.
english: Because of the danger of leprosy, even the apostolic vicar in the Hawaiian Islands, Bishop Luis Maigret, seemed reluctant to assign missionaries there.

text: May apat ugaling ka misyoneryo nga nangisug.
english: However, four missionaries showed courage.

text: Isa na diri si Fr.
english: One of them is Fr.

text: Damien, agud magpa-assign didto sa Kalawao settlement sa isla sng Molokai nga bulos-bulosan nila sing tatlo ka bulan.
english: Damien, to be assigned to the Kalawao settlement on the island of Molokai where they will take turns for three months.

text: Una nga na-assign sa Kalawao si Fr.
english: Fr. was first assigned to Kalawao.

text: Damien, 33 anyos sadto kag mga 9 ka tuig na nga misyonero sa Hawaii.
english: Damien, then 33 years old, had been a missionary in Hawaii for about nine years.

text: Apang, pagkatapos sang iya termino, ginpangabay gid niya nga ma-assign didto sing permanente nga ginpasugtan naman siya.
english: However, after his term, he requested to be assigned there permanently, which was granted.

text: Nagpabilin si Fr.
english: Fr. remained.

text: Damien sing 16 anyos diri, sa diin indi lang siya nangin pari sang mga aruon, kundi pati ang mag-akto bilang nars, police officer kag bisan pa karpintero sa mga ulubrahon didto.
english: Damien spent 16 years here, where he not only became a priest of the lepers, but also acted as a nurse, police officer and even a carpenter in the work there.

text: Tungod sa iya presencia kag pagpakita sing pag-ulikid sa ila, natun-an sang mga aruon ang maghatag importansya sa ila pagkatawo kag magpakita sing kaukod nga may kapagsik sa kon ano man nga buluhaton kag bululigan sa settlement agud mapasanyog man ila pagpuyo kag pagsinalayo diri.
english: Because of his presence and showing concern for them, the lepers learned to give importance to their humanity and show diligence with enthusiasm in any work and help in the settlement in order to improve their living and interaction here.

text: Nangin maukod si Fr.
english: Fr. was diligent.

text: Damien sa pagpangita sing bulig sa gobyerno kag mga religious congregation agud padalhan sing padayon nga pagkaon kag medisina ang colony, nga nag-alabot man sing sobra-sobra.
english: Damien to seek help from the government and religious congregations to send continuous food and medicine to the colony, which also arrived in excess.

text: Sang Disyembre 1884 gin-anunsyar ni Fr.
english: In December 1884 Fr.

text: Damein sa iya mga parishioners ang ini: “we lepers…”, sa pagpamatuod nga isa na siya sa mga aruon dira.
english: Damein said to his parishioners: “we lepers…”, to prove that he was one of the lepers there.

text: Napatay si Fr.
english: Fr. died.

text: Damien sa leprosy sadtong Abril 1889 kag ginlubong sa idalom sang “pandanus tree” sa diin nagtulog siya sa iya gid pag-abot sa Kalawao.
english: Damien with leprosy in April 1889 and was buried under the “pandanus tree” where he slept upon his arrival in Kalawao.

text: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)
english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Kun kaisa, daw ginahimo na man lang naton nga kaladlawan ang mga adlaw nga nagasundanay kita sang sabat sa eskwelahan.
english: Sometimes, we just make fun of the days when we follow each other's answers at school.

text: Ara bala nga wala ikaw nakatuon ukon wala ka nagapamati kag pasalamat ka nalang sa imo nga seatmate kun mabuot ini kag kun may ihatag nga sabat sa imo sa test!
english: There are times when you don't study or don't listen and you just thank your seatmate if he is kind and if he gives you an answer on the test!

text: Apang syempre, indi gid maayo ang cheating kag indi ini dapat pag-i-tolerar.
english: But of course, cheating is never good and should not be tolerated.

text: Sa India, nabutang sa sentro sang kontrobersiya ang isa ka eskwelahan matapos nakuhaan sang video ang mga tawo nga nagatalaklas sa pader agud lamang mapasahan sang sabat ang mga nagakuha sang exam sa sulod.
english: In India, a school has been at the center of controversy after people were caught on video climbing a wall just to pass the answers to the exam takers inside.

text: Sandig sa reports, natabo ini sa Chandravati School sa Tauru sa Nuh district sa amo nga pungsod.
english: According to reports, the incident took place at Chandravati School in Tauru in the Nuh district of the country.

text: Ginpahayag nga pila lang ka ginutlo ang makaligad sang nag-umpisa ang exam, may nag-leak sang examination paper — rason kun ngaa naghulag gilayon ang mga ginikanan kag mga himata sa guwa sang eskwelahan, gin-search ang mga sabat, kag sang ulihi, nagtaklas ang mga ini sa pader agud nga maduhulan sang sabat ang mga examinees.
english: It was reported that a few minutes after the exam began, someone leaked the examination paper — which is why parents and relatives immediately moved outside the school, searched for the answers, and later, they climbed the wall to get the answers from the examinees.

text: Todo-panindugan naman ang principal sang buluthuan nga wala sang cheating scandal nga natabo bangud sa ila seguridad nga ginpatuman.
english: The principal of the school insisted that there was no cheating scandal because of their security measures.

text: Ang video suno sa iya ang nagapakita lang sa tuyo nga mag-cheat, apang wala ini nadayon bangud may mga police sila nga nagapatrolya sa area kag naka-estasyon sa kada corner sang campus kun may mga kaangay sini nga board exams.
english: He said the video was only showing the intention to cheat, but it did not happen because they have police patrolling the area and stationed at every corner of the campus when there are such board exams.

text: Apisar sang depensa sang eskwelahan, may pila naman nga nagpahayag nga daw nahimo na nga routine ang cheating sa amo nga eskwelahan, kag sa pagkamatuod suno sa ila, daw para lamang sa “formality” ang security sa tion sang importante nga pasinawan.
english: Despite the school's defense, some said that cheating seems to have become a routine in the school, and in fact, according to them, security seems to be only for “formality” during important examinations.

text: Suno sa district education officer, nagmandu na siya sa officials nga magpasa sang report kaangot sa amo nga insidente.
english: The district education officer said he has already ordered officials to submit a report on the incident.

text: Gindugang naman sang Block Education Officer nga wala ginatugutan ang cheating sa bisan anuman nga sirkumstansya kag dapat nga manabat pananglitan matuod nga may yara gid man sang involved diri samtang padayon ang exam.
english: The Block Education Officer added that cheating is not allowed under any circumstances and should be held accountable if it is true that someone is involved in it while the exam is ongoing.

text: Nag-appoint sang labing una nga babayi nga Arsobispo ang Canterbury sa United Kingdom.
english: Canterbury has appointed the first female Archbishop in the United Kingdom.

text: Ang 63-anyos nga si Sarah Mullally ang obispo sang London sang 2018 ang gin-ordinahan bilang mangin arsobispo.
english: 63-year-old Sarah Mullally the bishop of London in 2018 was ordained as the future archbishop.

text: Nag-ubra man si Sarah bilang nurse sa isa ka hospital sa London kun sa diin siya nangin Chief Nursing Office para sa England.
english: Sarah also worked as a nurse in a hospital in London where she became Chief Nursing Office for England.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga iya ginbayaan ang iya pag-ubra bilang nurse matapos ginsabat ni Cristo ang panawagan sini sa bag-o nga ministeryo.
english: She said she left her job as a nurse after Christ answered her call to a new ministry.

text: Pagatal-osan niya si Justin Welby nga nagbuya sa puwesto matapos nga napaslawan i-report si John Smyth nga gin-akusaran sang physically kag sexually nga pang-abuso sa pila ka mga kalalakinhan sa isa ka Christian camp sang 1970 tubtob 1980.
english: He will succeed Justin Welby, who resigned after failing to report John Smyth, who was accused of physically and sexually abusing several men at a Christian camp in the 1970s and 1980s.

text: Ginpatay ang isa ka amay sa atubang mismo sang iya bata sa Barangay Mable, Malabang, Lanao Del Sur.
english: A father was killed in front of his son in Barangay Mable, Malabang, Lanao Del Sur.

text: Natabo ang krimen kahapon, Nobyembre 27.
english: The crime took place yesterday, November 27th.

text: Suno sa pamilya, wala gid sa hinalung-ong ang bata nga lalaki nga wala na sang kabuhi ang iya amay samtang nagapungko ini sa ila tricycle.
english: According to the family, the boy did not realize that his father was dead while he was sitting on their tricycle.

text: Nagasinggit subong sang hustisya ang pamilya sang biktima.
english: The victim's family is now crying for justice.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan angot sa insidente.
english: Police are still investigating the incident.

text: Madamo ang napuhag bangud sa emergency landing sang isa ka helicopter sa bakante nga lote sa banwa sang Guindulman sa probinsya sang Bohol — nga sang ulihi natukiban nga ang rason amo ang isa ka burador!
english: Many were shocked by the emergency landing of a helicopter on a vacant lot in Guindulman town in Bohol province — which was later discovered to be caused by a draft!

text: Natabo ini sa Sitio Sta.
english: This happened in Sitio Sta.

text: Lucia, Barangay Trinidad, Guindulman, isa ka fourth class municipality nga nahamtang 91.5 km east sang capital city nga Tagbilaran.
english: Lucia, Barangay Trinidad, Guindulman, is a fourth class municipality located 91.5 km east of the capital city of Tagbilaran.

text: Suno sa mga residente, antes pa man maghugpa ang helicopter, nakit-an na nila nga may deperensya sa paglupad sini.
english: According to residents, even before the helicopter landed, they noticed that there was a defect in its flight.

text: Sang nakaabot na sa bakante nga lote, gin-check sang piloto kun ano ang problema kag may nakit-an nga nylon string sang burador sa rotor blades sang helicopter.
english: When he arrived at the vacant lot, the pilot checked what the problem was and found a nylon string of eraser on the rotor blades of the helicopter.

text: Hilway sa katalagman ang piloto kag duha ka mga pasahero kag wala man sang nakit-an nga damage sa helicopter rason nga naglupad man gilayon dies minutos matapos ang emergency landing.
english: The pilot and two passengers were safe and no damage was found to the helicopter, which took off 10 minutes after the emergency landing.

text: NAPAMATUD-AN sing indi lang isa ka bes nga “Love conquers all”.
english: IT HAS been proven more than once that “Love conquers all”.

text: Indi lang tungod lapaw sa manggad kag kadungganan ang pagpalabi sa pinalangga, kundi bisan pa gani agud madaug ang isa ka kawsa sa maalungayon nga paagi.
english: Not only because it is beyond wealth and honor to prefer the beloved, but even to win a cause in a peaceful way.

text: Madamo kita sing ejemplo sa mga royalty nga ginsikway ang ila titulo agud lang makaupod ang pinalangga nga halin sa ordinaryo nga kahimtangan.
english: We have many examples of royalty who renounced their title just to be with a loved one from the commons.

text: Isa sa mga famoso nga istorya sang paghigugma amo ang kaso ni Prince Edward VIII nga ginsikway ang maging hari sang Inglatera agud pangasaw-on ang isa ka diborsyda nga Amerikana nga si Wallis Simpson sadtong 1936.
english: One of the most famous love stories is the case of Prince Edward VIII who rejected the throne of England to marry a divorced American named Wallis Simpson in 1936.

text: Yara man si Japanese Princess Atsuko, sadto 21 anyos nga anak ni Emperor Hirohito, nga nagbiya sang iya titulo agud mapamana ang isa ka negosyante nga si Takamas Ikda, 25, sadtong Oktubre 1952.
english: There was also Japanese Princess Atsuko, then the 21-year-old daughter of Emperor Hirohito, who renounced her title to marry businessman Takamas Ikda, 25, in October 1952.

text: Si Princess Ubolratana sang Thailand nagbiya man sang iya titulo sa iya pagpamana sa kay Peter Jensen nga isa ka American student nga nakilala niya sa Boston school sadtong 1972.
english: Princess Ubolratana of Thailand also gave up her title upon her marriage to Peter Jensen an American student she met at Boston school in 1972.

text:
***

Samtang, gingamit naman ni Mahatma (Venerable) Gandhi agud dag-on ang bug-os nga pwersa sang British Rule paagi sa “non-violent resistance”.
english:
***

Meanwhile, Mahatma (Venerable) Gandhi used it to defeat the entire force of British Rule through non-violent resistance.

text: Sunu mismo sa iya, “Duha ka klase ang pagpakita sang Gahum (Power).
english: According to him, “There are two kinds of manifestations of Power.

text:
Ang isa paagi sa pagtuga sang kahadlok paagi sa pagsilot sa mga pumuluyo, kag ang isa sa pag-alungay ukon sa mahigugmaon nga paagi (Acts of Love).”

“Ang ikaduha mas epektibo sing isa ka libu ka pilu sangsa nahauna,” pamat-ud gani niya.
english:
One by creating fear by punishing the inhabitants, and the other by reconciliation or in a loving way (Acts of Love).”

“The second is a thousand times more effective than the first,” he concluded.

text: Si Mahatma Gandhi – Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, sa matuod nga ngalan – isa ka abogado nga taga-India nga nanguna sa kampanya agud maangkon ang kahilwayan (independence) sang India halin sa gamhanan nga Britanya, nga wala naggamit sing maduguon nga rebolusyon.
english: Mahatma Gandhi – Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, by real name – was an Indian lawyer who led the campaign to win India’s independence from the mighty Britain, without resorting to bloody revolution.

text: Paagi sa “non-violent resistance”, ginpakita ni Gandhi kag sang iya sumulunod ang Power of Love versus Love of Power agud ipadaug ang ila kawsa para maangkon ang independencia sang India, nga naangkon gid man nila sadtong Agosto 1947.
english: Through non-violent resistance, Gandhi and his followers demonstrated the Power of Love versus Love of Power to win their cause for India's independence, which they achieved in August 1947.

text: Nag-inspire ini sa balo ni Senador Benigno Aquino Jr.
english: This inspired the widow of Senator Benigno Aquino Jr.

text: nga si Corazon Cojuangco Aquino agud pangunahan man ang pagtumba sang martial law regime ni anay President Ferdinand Marcos paagi sa bloodless revolution, ukon Edsa Revolt, sadtong 1986.
english: Corazon Cojuangco Aquino to also lead the overthrow of former President Ferdinand Marcos' martial law regime through the bloodless revolution, or Edsa Revolt, in 1986.

text: Napabalik sini ang Filipinas sa Demokrasyahon nga pangginahum sa idalom ni Presidente Cory Aquino, nga nagbugras sang tanikala sang gahum militar kag nagpaluntad sang hilway nga pangabuhi sang mga pumuluyo nga ginpabakud sa idalom sang 1987 Constitution.
english: It returned the Philippines to democratic rule under President Cory Aquino, who broke the chains of military power and established the freedom of movement of the people enshrined under the 1987 Constitution.

text: Sa idalom sang sining konstitusyon ginpabakud ang kahilwayan sang mga pumuluyo sa madamo kag importante nga mga kinamatarong.
english: Under this constitution the freedom of the citizens was strengthened in many and important rights.

text: Lakip sini ang pagpasiguro sang “due process” sa kon sin-o man nga suspetsado nga dapat anay mapamatud-an ang kasal-anan sa isa ka “fair and just trial”, kag ang hilway nga pagpahayag sang balatyagon sang mga pumuluyo batok sa mga opisyales sang gobyerno, nga sa aton Demokrasya mga suluguon sang banwa.
english: This includes ensuring due process to any suspect who must first be proven guilty in a fair and just trial, and the free expression of the feelings of the people against government officials, who in our Democracy are servants of the people.

text: Sa aton gindaug nga Demokrasya, ginatindugan man naton ang pag-respeto sa pila ka importante nga bagay sa aton pribado nga pagkatawo kag relasyones.
english: In our won Democracy, we also insist on respecting some important things in our private identity and relationships.

text: Wala naton gina-criminalize ang suicide kay personal ini nga desisyon sang isa ka tawo nga sabton lang niya sa Diyos; ang ma-assign sa isa ka suicide mission kon soldado sa ngalan sang ila gugma sa pungsod; ang mag-risgo agud luwason sa peligro, katulad sang sunog kag pagkalumos, nga pwede naton ikamatay; kag sa iban pa nga sitwasyon nga ang konsyensya ang mayor nga manunudlo sang kabuhi.
english: We do not criminalize suicide because it is a personal decision of a person to answer to God; to be assigned to a suicide mission if soldiers in the name of their love of country; to take risks to save ourselves from danger, such as fire and drowning, that can kill us; and in other situations where conscience is the major teacher of life.

text:
Labaw kag labi sa tanan, ang kinamatarong sang mag-asawa nga tindugan ang ila sinumpaan – :”for better or for worse; for richer or poorer; in sickness and in health; to love and cherish, til death do us part.”

Tungod sini, dapat may exception sa kaso sang mag-asawa agud mapasugtan ang riding-in-tandem sa motorsiklo sang mag-asawa sa kinahanglanon nila nga pag-upod bisan pa sa gina-requirer nga social distancing sa padayon naton nga away batok sa COVID-19.
english:
Above all, the right of the couple to keep their vows – :”for better or for worse; for richer or poorer; in sickness and in health; to love and cherish, til death do us part.”

Therefore, there should be an exception in the case of a couple to allow riding-in-tandem on a couple's motorcycle in their necessary companionship despite the required social distancing in our ongoing fight against COVID-19.

text: Isa pa, inutil na ina ya ang pagsulundan nga bulagon mo sila sa motorsiklo samtang pirme man sila nagahulid sa isa ka hiligdaan.
english: Besides, it's useless to separate them from the motorcycle when they're always sleeping in the same bed.

text: Ginahanda na ang 66,235 metric tons (MT) sang kalamay nga iga-export sang Pilipinas sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika umpisa sa Abril subong nga tuig.
english: The 66,235 metric tons (MT) of sugarcane that the Philippines will export to the United States of America is being prepared starting April this year.

text: Suno kay Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona, ginahanda na sang exporters ang duha ka mga barko nga amo ang magadala sang kalamay.
english: According to Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) Administrator Pablo Luis Azcona, exporters are already preparing the two ships that will carry the sugarcane.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, madumduman nga diutayan lang nga wala nakahingabot ang Pilipinas sa Septyembre 30 nga deadline.
english: Last year, the Philippines almost missed the September 30 deadline.

text: Natigayon nga nakaabot ang produkto sang Septyembre 27 apang may natabo na nga discoloration kag quality deterioration rason nga may gindagdag nga 10-percent penalty.
english: The product arrived on September 27 but discoloration and quality deterioration occurred, resulting in a 10-percent penalty.

text: Subong nga tuig, himuon ang shipment kadungan sang milling season agud masigurado nga preska pa ang iga-export.
english: This year, the shipment will be done in conjunction with the milling season to ensure fresh exports.

text: Pahayag ni Azcona, napahibalo na sang ahensya ang United States nga idul-ong ang raw sugar antes ang Agusto.
english: Azcona said the agency has already informed the United States to deliver the raw sugar before August.

text: Sa sitwasyon naman sa pag-harvest kag paggaling sang tubo sa Negros Island Region, ginsiling ni Azcuna nga kadam-an sa sugar producers sa south ang manugtapos naman; samtang sa north naman, may mga delay lang nga nagakatabo bangud sa masami nga pag-ulan.
english: On the situation of harvesting and milling of sugarcane in the Negros Island Region, Azcuna said that most of the sugar producers in the south are finishing; while in the north, there are only delays due to frequent rains.

text: Tubtub sa Mayo ang pag-harvest.
english: Harvesting lasts until May.

text: Una naman nga nag-promisa ang Department of Agriculture (DA) kag ang SRA sa sugarcane farmers nga wala sang sugar importation order nga ipaguwa halin sa Mayo tubtub sa Hunyo.
english: Earlier, the Department of Agriculture (DA) and the SRA promised sugarcane farmers that no sugar importation order would be issued from May to June.

text: Ipinahayag ni Madagascar President Andry Rajoelina na kanyang binuwag ang gobyerno kasunod ng serye ng protesta ng kabataan laban sa malalang problema ng water at power cuts na ikinasawi ng hindi bababa sa 22 katao at mahigit 100 ang nasugatan, ayon sa United Nations.
english: Madagascar President Andry Rajoelina has announced that he has dissolved the government following a series of youth protests against severe water and power cuts that have killed at least 22 people and injured more than 100, according to the United Nations.

text: Sa kanyang televised speech nitong Lunes, sinabi ni Rajoelina na humihingi siya ng paumanhin kung may mga opisyal ng gobyerno na nabigong gampanan ang kanilang tungkulin.
english: In her televised speech on Monday, Rajoelina said she would apologize if any government officials failed to perform their duties.

text: Ang tatlong araw na protesta, na tinaguriang hango sa “Gen Z” protests sa Kenya at Nepal, ang pinakamalaki sa Madagascar sa nakalipas na maraming taon.
english: The three-day protest, dubbed the “Gen Z” protests in Kenya and Nepal, is the largest in Madagascar in many years.

text: Itinuturing din itong pinakamabigat na hamon kay Rajoelina mula nang siya ay muling mahalal noong 2023.
english: It is also considered the most difficult challenge for Rajoelina since she is re-elected in 2023.

text: Batay sa ulat ng United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights, kabilang sa mga namatay ang ilang nagpoprotesta at mga sibilyan na tinamaan sa operasyon ng security forces.
english: According to the report of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights, among the dead were some protesters and civilians who were hit in the operation of the security forces.

text: May mga nasawi rin bunsod ng malawakang karahasan at pamimirata na isinagawa ng mga indibidwal at gang na walang kaugnayan sa mga demonstrador.
english: There were also reports of widespread violence and harassment committed by individuals and gangs unrelated to the demonstrators.

text: SO, YARA naman kita sa Modified GCQ, pila ka tikang panaog sa ECQ nga una naton ginhamtangan, nga natalana ipatuman naton sa Mayo 16.
english: SO, we are in Modified GCQ, a few steps down from the ECQ that we first placed, which is scheduled to be implemented on May 16.

text: Tungod sini, the more nga mag-amlig kita kay mas exposed na kita sa COVID-19.
english: Because of this, the more we protect ourselves because we are more exposed to COVID-19.

text: The more man nga kinahanglan naton ang mas masaligan nga “calculated risk”, ukon ang pagpaniguro sang aton tikang agud indi matiplang sining tuso nga virus sang COVID-19.
english: The more we need a more reliable “calculated risk”, or the assurance of our steps to avoid being infected by this insidious virus of COVID-19.

text: Paano naton mapatuman ang ining “calculated risk” agud mangin madinalag-on sa sunod ta nga mga tikang?
english: How can we implement this “calculated risk” to be successful in our next steps?

text: Sa karon may handa na kita nga mga armas.
english: By now we have ready weapons.

text: Galakip diri ang isolation, padayon nga contact tracing, border control, ang mandatory nga paggamit sang face mask sa publiko, kag padayon nga social distancing.
english: These include isolation, continuous contact tracing, border control, the mandatory use of face masks in public, and continued social distancing.

text: Kinahanglan ta man ang pagpabaskug sang aton ikaayong lawas, particular ang aton immune system, nga samtang wala pa sing vaccine maaway naton gihapon ang COVID-19 virus.
english: We also need to strengthen our health, particularly our immune system, so that while there is no vaccine we can still fight the COVID-19 virus.

text:
***

Kinahanglan man mahibal-an naton kon paano malikawan ang “severe” nga igu sang COVID-19 nga pwede naton ikamatay sa sining mas maluag-luag na nga panghulag.
english:
***

We also need to know how to avoid the “severe” impact of COVID-19 that can kill us in this more widespread movement.

text: Ang experyensya sang Wuhan, China, nagasiling nga “mild” lang ang igu sang mga 80 porsyento sang mga pumuluyo kag 20 porsyento ang “moderate” kag “severe”.
english: The experience of Wuhan, China, says that about 80 percent of the population is “mild” and 20 percent is “moderate” and “severe”.

text: Apang, ina tungod indi gawa makadulot ang barang sang COVID-19 sa mga kabataan – edad 19 paidalom – kag tungod man sa maamligon nga pagtatap sang ikaayong lawas sa maayo nga pagkaon, eherhisyo kag positibo nga panan-aw sa kabuhi, kag ang maamligon man nga pagtatap sang mga ginabatyag.
english: However, that is because the COVID-19 virus cannot even spread to children – age 19 and under – and also because of the protective care of health in good diet, exercise and a positive outlook on life, as well as the protective care of feelings.

text: Ini nga kamatuoran, nga ginapakita man sang mga kaso sa iban nga pungsod, indi naton mapaseguro ugaling sa kinaiya sang balatian nga COVID-19.
english: This fact, which is also shown by cases in other countries, cannot be assured however by the nature of the disease COVID-19.

text: Sunu sa mga health experts, ang igu sang COVID-19 depende sa “viral load” ukon “infectious dose” nga mabaton sang aton lawas sa tion sang infection.
english: According to health experts, the impact of COVID-19 depends on the viral load or infectious dose that our body receives during the infection.

text: Meaning, mas madamo nga virus ang mabaton sang aton lawas, mas mataas man ang  igu nga balatian pakadto sa “severe”; kag kon diutay man, mahuyang, ukon “mild”, lang ang igu.
english: Meaning, the more viruses our bodies receive, the higher the severity of the disease; and if it is small, weak, or “mild”, it is enough.

text: Diri masulod ang paglikaw sa padayon nga “exposure”, sa diin kinahanglan sang aton mga health workers kag iban nga frontliners ang maayo nga pangamlig katulad sang masaligan (indi substandard ukon fake) nga mga Personal Protective Equipment.
english: This includes avoiding continuous exposure, where our health workers and other frontliners need good protection such as reliable (not substandard or fake) Personal Protective Equipment.

text: Diri man masulod ang mas maayo nga pagpangamlig sang mga may compromised health conditions katulad sang diabetes, heart failure, high blood, kag kasubong nga ginabatyag.
english: This includes better protection for those with compromised health conditions such as diabetes, heart failure, high blood pressure, and similar conditions.

text:
***

Duha ka klase ang carrier sang COVID-19 virus – ang symptomatic, ukon gapakita sintoma, kag ang asymptomatic ukon wala nagapakita sang sintoma.
english:
***

There are two types of carriers of the COVID-19 virus – the symptomatic, or showing symptoms, and the asymptomatic.

text: Well, madali naton ma-identify ang mga symptomatic tungod sang mga sintoma nga dala nila, nga makita sang mga surveillance team sang barangay nga may obligasyon sa pag-identify sa ila dira mismo sa ila mga lugar.
english: Well, we can easily identify the symptomatic because of the symptoms they carry, which can be seen by the surveillance teams of the barangay who have an obligation to identify them right there in their areas.

text: Nagagwa nga may problema kita sa mga asymptomatic, tungod gani wala sila nagapakita sang sintoma kag bisan ano nga ginabatyag.
english: It turns out that we have a problem with the asymptomatic, because therefore they are not showing a symptom and anything that feels.

text: Sa WHO-China Joint Mission Report on Coronavirus 2019, nga napetsahan Pebrero 16-24, 2020, wala ugaling ginsapak sini ang kaso sang mga asymptomatic.
english: In the WHO-China Joint Mission Report on Coronavirus 2019, dated February 16-24, 2020, however, it ignored the case of asymptomatic cases.

text:
Siling sini, sa Iningles: “(I)nfections by people with no symptoms were ‘relatively rare’ and did not appear to be driving transmission of the disease.”

Ang hangop ta sini nga malaka ang kaso sang asymptomatic sa China.
english:
It says, in English: “(I)nfections by people with no symptoms were ‘relatively rare’ and did not appear to be driving transmission of the disease.”

We understand that there are many asymptomatic cases in China.

text: Aba, kag wala sila nagapati nga aktibo ini sa pagpanglaton!
english: Well, and they don't believe it's active in infection!

text: Ina seguro kay “mild” lang ang igu nila tungod manubo man ang ila “viral load” ukon “infectious dose” nga indi bastante maka-infect gid sa ila kag sa iban.
english: That's probably because they are only mildly infected because their viral load is low or infectious dose is not enough to infect them and others.

text: Of course, posible lain man ang sitwasyon sa iban nga pungsod.
english: Of course, the situation may be different in other countries.

text: Sa report sang aton Dept.
english: In the report of our Dept.

text: of Health, mga 80 porsyento ang “mild” cases sang COVID-19 sa Filipinas, nga tungod “mild” ang ila mga kaso, posible laban sini mga asymptomatic.
english: of Health, about 80 percent of the “mild” cases of COVID-19 in the Philippines, which because their cases are “mild”, it is possible that most of them are asymptomatic.

text: Tungod sini, indi gid man ini sila makatulublag gid, kag malikawan ini sila sa maayo nga paggamit lang sang face mask sa publiko.
english: Because of this, they are not very disturbing, and they can be avoided by using face masks in public.

text: In other words, ang matuod-tuod ta gid nga problema amo ang mga symptomatic kay posible diri nagahalin ang mga “severe” nga mga kaso.
english: In other words, our real problem is the symptomatic because it is possible that the “severe” cases come from here.

text: Kon husto ang ginasiling sa aton sang mga researchers, malikawan ta ang mga “severe” nga igu paagi sa paglikaw sa mga pasyente nga may mga “severe” cases man, kag ang sobra nga exposure sa mga pasyente nga wala sing epektibo nga mga PPE kag kasubong nga proteksyon.
english: If the researchers are right, we can avoid severe injuries by avoiding patients with severe cases, and excessive exposure to patients who do not have effective PPE and similar protection.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Ang diktador ukon ang may huyog mag-diktador lang ang maluyag sina!
english: Only a dictator or a dictator would want that!

text: Sa aton Demokrasya, okey lang ina nga ma-akusaran ang isa ka independent (masami critical) nga media outlet sang iya alleged wrongdoing.
english: In our Democracy, that’s okay to accuse an independent (often critical) media outlet of its alleged wrongdoing.

text: Basta masalang lang siya sa isa ka “fair and just” trial, indi tungod lang kay luyag ini matabo sang kon sin-o nga poderoso.
english: As long as he is guilty of a “fair and just” trial, not just because someone powerful wants it to happen.

text: Of course, gin-deny ni SolGen Jose Calida nga ginatum-ok niya, nga indi matagaan sang NTC ang ABS-CBN sing “provisional authority” agud makapadayon sa pag-operate, tungod sa personal nga rason.
english: Of course, SolGen Jose Calida denied that he was suggesting that the NTC could not give ABS-CBN “provisional authority” to continue operating, for personal reasons.

text: Rason niya nga tungod amo gid ina ang husto nga interpretasyon sa kasuguan.
english: He reasons that because that is the correct interpretation of the law.

text: Well, sunu sa duha ka retirado nga Chief Justice sang Korte Suprema, wala sina nga poder ang NTC, kundi ang Kongreso lang.
english: Well, according to two retired Chief Justices of the Supreme Court, the NTC does not have that power, but only Congress.

text: Si Presidente Duterte nag-deny man nga ginagamit niya ang iya impluwensya sa Kongreso sa isyu sang pag-renew sang frankisa sang ABS-CBN sa diin may gutgut siya diri sadtong nagligad nga Mayo 2016 nga eleksyon.
english: President Duterte also denied that he is using his influence in Congress on the issue of the renewal of the ABS-CBN franchise where he had a gutgut during the last May 2016 elections.

text: Well, yara na ina sa mga pumuluyo kon patihan ukon indi si SolGen kag si Presidente Duterte sa ila denial nga wala sila personal nga rason agud kontrahon ang ABS-CBN.
english: Well, it is up to the people whether or not to believe SolGen and President Duterte in their denial that they have no personal reason to oppose ABS-CBN.

text: Bahin sang kabuhi sang Demokrasya ang isa ka independent kag critical media network agud bantayan ang pang-abuso sang isa ka administrasyon.
english: An independent and critical media network is part of the life of a democracy to monitor the abuses of an administration.

text: Tungod duha ka bahin (administration kag opposition) ang pang-gobyerno naton sa Demokrasya,  mabudlay man ang pagtagu sang kamatuoran sa panghimanwa tungod sa pagbantayanay sang isa kag isa.
english: Because there are two parts (administration and opposition) in our government in democracy, it is also difficult to hide the truth from the public because of the surveillance of each other.

text: Indi katulad sa diktadurya nga luyag lang mabatian ang mga balita kag pahayag, lakip na ang mga binutig, nga pabor sa yara sa poder.
english: Unlike a dictatorship that only wants to hear news and statements, including lies, in favor of those in power.

text: Pero, kon gusto ninyo ang diniktador nga pang-gobyerno, pwede man kita seguro mangin probinsya sang China!
english: But, if you want a dictatorial government, we can probably become a province of China!

text:
***

Pwera lahog, pero madale man lang awayon ang SARS-CoV-2, ang virus nga nagadulot sang balatian nga COVID-19.
english:
***

SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes the disease COVID-19, is easy to fight.

text: Ngaa man?
english: Why else?

text: Indi bala siling sang aton health authorities nga malatnan lang kita sang COVID-19 kon mahaklo naton ang virus sini halin sa na-infect sang COVID-19?
english: Do not our health authorities say that we can only get infected with COVID-19 if we breathe the virus from someone infected with COVID-19?

text: Kag matabo lang ini kon ang droplets halin sa pag-ubo ukon pangatsi sini masalu sang aton paginhawaan, ukon madala naton sa infected naton nga kamot sa aton ilong, baba kag mata.
english: And this only happens if the droplets from coughing or sneezing are inhaled, or we carry them on our infected hands to our nose, mouth and eyes.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: In other words, indi kita malatnan sang COVID-19 kon makalikaw kita sa “close contact” sa iban – halin sa layu nga isa ka metro ang antad – kag sa padayon nga pagpanghugas sang kamot ukon paggamit sang disinfectant katulad sang alcohol.
english: In other words, we cannot get infected with COVID-19 if we avoid close contact with others – from a distance of one meter – and by continuously washing hands or using disinfectants such as alcohol.

text: Lakip na dira syempre nga ma-isolate ang mga Infected, Probable kag Suspected nga malatnan sang COVID-19 kag ang padayon nga contact tracing.
english: This includes of course the isolation of the Infected, Probable and Suspected to be infected with COVID-19 and the continuous contact tracing.

text: Kon nagabatyag kita – bisan sa suspetso lang nga naigu kita sang trangkaso – ang mag-face mask man agud indi makapanglaton.
english: If we are feeling sick – even if we suspect we have the flu – wear a face mask to avoid infection.

text: Ti, ano ang problema dira?
english: Well, what's the problem there?

text: Daw wala man.
english: It seems like nothing.

text: Basta indi lang kita pasaway sa panugyan sang gobyerno!
english: As long as we don't disobey the government's advice!
