text: Kilalahon ang Tony Award-winning actress kag Filipina Broadway star nga si Lea Salonga sa 91st Annual Drama League Awards sa New York City.
english: Meet Tony Award-winning actress and Filipina Broadway star Lea Salonga at the 91st Annual Drama League Awards in New York City.

text: Pagabatunon sini ang Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theater Award sa Mayo 16.
english: It will accept the Distinguished Achievement in Musical Theater Award on May 16.

text: Isa ka celebrated figure si Lea sa theater community indi lamang sa Pilipinas kundi mangin sa luwas sa pungsod.
english: Lea is a celebrated figure in the theater community not only in the Philippines but also abroad.

text: Natabo ang iya Broadway debut sang 1991 nga amo man ang tuig sa iya Tony-winning performance bilang Kim sa Miss Saigon.
english: She made her Broadway debut in 1991 which was the same year as her Tony-winning performance as Kim in Miss Saigon.

text: Diri sa awards ceremony, ginaselebrar ang kaangay sini nga outstanding achievements sa teatro.
english: Here at the awards ceremony, such outstanding achievements in theater are celebrated.

text: Featured diri ang seven competitive categories magluwas pa sa special citations.
english: Featured here are seven competitive categories in addition to special citations.

text: Dugang sa sini nga pagkilala, balantayan man si Lea sa highly anticipated spring 2025 transfer sang Stephen Sondheim revue nga Old Friends.
english: In addition to this recognition, Lea will also be watched in the highly anticipated spring 2025 transfer of the Stephen Sondheim revue Old Friends.

text: Magabalik man siya bilang The Witch sa upcoming production sang Theatre Group Asia sang Into the Woods nga maga-premiere sa August sa Performing Arts Theater sa Pilipinas.
english: She will also return as The Witch in Theater Group Asia’s upcoming production of Into the Woods which premieres in August at the Performing Arts Theater in the Philippines.

text: Ini ang una nga role ni Lea sa iya pagbalik sa Philippine musical stage matapos ang anum ka tuig man nga pagpahuway.
english: This is Lea's first role in her return to the Philippine musical stage after a six-year break.

text: Ginagamit sang China ang pila ka mga Pilipino nga pulitiko diri sa Pilipinas agud nga mapaluya ang posisyon sang pungsod sa West Philippine Sea.
english: China is using some Filipino politicians here in the Philippines to weaken the country's position in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag ni Dr. Jeffrey Ordaniel, ang President kag Chief Executive Officer sang non-government, nonprofit, kag nonpartisan volunteer-based organization nga WPS Inc.
english: This was revealed by Dr. Jeffrey Ordaniel, the President and Chief Executive Officer of the non-government, nonprofit, and nonpartisan volunteer-based organization WPS Inc.

text: ukon We Protect our Seas Inc.
english: or We Protect our Seas Inc.

text: Suno kay Ordaniel, kabahin ini sang Chinese malign influence and foreign interference diri sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Ordaniel, this is part of the Chinese malign influence and foreign interference here in the Philippines.

text: Wala sang ginhambal nga pangalan si Ordaniel kun sin-o nga pulitiko ang iya ginatumod, apang gin-halimbawa sini ang ginhambal sang senador nga wala sang coordinates ang Philippine exclusive economic zone sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Ordaniel did not name the politician he was referring to, but he cited the senator's statement that the Philippine exclusive economic zone in the West Philippine Sea does not have coordinates.

text: Matandaan nga subong nga semana sang nangin mainit ang debate nanday Senador Rodante Marcoleta kag Senador Francis Pangilinan kaangot sa takos, kalaparon, kag grid coordinates sang West Philippine Sea.
english: It can be recalled that this week, Senator Rodante Marcoleta and Senator Francis Pangilinan had a heated debate over the size, width, and grid coordinates of the West Philippine Sea.

text: Natabo ang komento ni Marcoleta sa Senate plenary session sang ginadiskusyunan ang Senate Resolution 256 nga nagatukso sa Chinese officials sa ila nga mga pahayag batok sa Philippine officials.
english: Marcoleta's comments came during the Senate plenary session when Senate Resolution 256 was being discussed, which criticizes Chinese officials for their statements against Philippine officials.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2024 pa lang, ginkumpirma na sang National Intelligence Coordinating Agency (NICA) nga may yara sang Chinese malign influence and foreign interference (MIFI) activities diri sa Pilipinas kag wala sang rehiyon nga exempted sa ila nga impluwensya.
english: It can be recalled that as early as 2024, the National Intelligence Coordinating Agency (NICA) confirmed that there are Chinese malign influence and foreign interference (MIFI) activities here in the Philippines and no region is exempt from their influence.

text: Ginapahayag nga ini nga interference ang naga-target sang democratic processes, legislative bodies, kag local governance agud nga maduso ang interes sang China sa teritoryo kag seguridad.#
english: This interference allegedly targets democratic processes, legislative bodies, and local governance in order to promote China's territorial and security interests.#

text: Patay ang hindi bababa sa apat katao at sugatan ang walo matapos salakayin ng isang dating U.S. Marine ang isang simbahan sa Michigan, kung saan binangga niya ang gusali gamit ang sasakyan, namaril gamit ang assault rifle, at sinunog ang loob nito bago mapatay sa engkwentro ng pulisya.
english: At least four people were killed and eight others injured after a former U.S. Marine attacked a church in Michigan, crashing into the building with a vehicle, shooting with an assault rifle, and burning its insides before dying in a police encounter.

text: Kinilala ng mga awtoridad ang suspek bilang si Thomas Jacob Sanford, 40 anyos, mula Burton, Michigan, na dati nang nagsilbi sa U.S. Marine at beterano ng Iraq war.
english: Authorities identified the suspect as Thomas Jacob Sanford, 40, of Burton, Michigan, a former U.S. Marine and Iraq war veteran.

text: Ayon sa pulisya, sinadya nitong sunugin ang Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, na tuluyang nilamon ng apoy at usok.
english: According to police, he deliberately set fire to the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, which was completely engulfed in flames and smoke.

text: Dalawa agad ang namatay sa pamamaril habang walo ang isinugod sa ospital.
english: Two died instantly in the shooting while eight were rushed to the hospital.

text: Ilang oras matapos ang insidente, natagpuan pa ang dalawa pang bangkay sa nasunog na gusali, at sinabing maaaring mayroon pang hindi natutukoy na biktima.
english: A few hours after the incident, two more bodies were found in the burned building, and it is said that there may be more unidentified victims.

text: Sinabi ni Grand Blanc Township Police Chief William Renye na mahigit isang daan ang nasa loob ng simbahan nang mangyari ang pag-atake.
english: Grand Blanc Township Police Chief William Renye said more than one road was inside the church when the attack occurred.

text: Dalawang pulis ang agad rumesponde at nakipagpalitan ng putok, at napatay ang suspek sa paradahan walong minuto matapos magsimula ang insidente.
english: Two police officers immediately responded and exchanged fire, killing the suspect in the parking lot eight minutes after the incident began.

text: Ayon sa U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives, pinaniniwalaang gumamit si Sanford ng gasolina bilang accelerant upang mabilis kumalat ang apoy.
english: According to the U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives, Sanford is believed to have used gasoline as an accelerant to quickly spread the fire.

text: Nakarekober din ng ilang eksplosibo sa lugar.
english: Several explosives were also recovered from the scene.

text:
Itinuturing ng FBI ang kaso bilang “act of targeted violence.”

Kasabay nito, isa pang beteranong Marine na 40 anyos at nagsilbi rin sa Iraq ang nasangkot sa pamamaril sa North Carolina, 14 oras bago ang insidente sa Michigan.
english:
The FBI is treating the case as an “act of targeted violence.”

At the same time, another Marine veteran in his 40s who also served in Iraq was involved in a shooting in North Carolina, 14 hours before the incident in Michigan.

text: Kinilala ang suspek bilang si Nigel Max Edge, na umano’y namaril mula sa bangka papunta sa isang bar at ikinasawi ng tatlo habang lima ang sugatan.
english: The suspect was identified as Nigel Max Edge, who allegedly shot from a boat to a bar and killed three while wounding five others.

text: Nahaharap ito sa kasong multiple murder at attempted murder.
english: He is facing charges of multiple murder and attempted murder.

text: Ginmultahan na naman sang National Basketball Association (NBA) ang 23-anyos nga star guard sang Minnesota Timberwolves nga si Anthony Edwards.
english: The National Basketball Association (NBA) has fined 23-year-old Minnesota Timberwolves star guard Anthony Edwards.

text: $35,000 ukon P2.03-million ang gindagdag nga penalidad sa iya matapos wala gilayon nagguwa sa court sang ginpahalin ini sa hampang kag ginhaboy pa sini ang bola sa stands.
english: He was fined $35,000 or P2.03-million after he did not immediately leave the court when he was sent off and threw the ball into the stands.

text: Ini na ang iya ika-anum nga multa subong nga season.
english: It was his sixth fine this season.

text: Kun sumahon, nagdangat na sa $320,000 ukon P18.54-million ang penalty sini sa liga subong gid lamang nga season nga nagalakip man sa foul sini nga lenggwahe sa media interviews kag ang ginakabig “bastos” nga gestures samtang yara sa court.
english: In total, he has been fined $320,000 or P18.54-million in the league this season alone, which includes his foul language in media interviews and what is considered “rude” gestures while on the court.

text: Ang latest penalty sang three-time All-Star guard ang nag-ugat sa ikaduha sini nga technical foul sa hampang batok sa Los Angeles Lakers sang nagligad nga semana kag ginpahalin sang singko minutos na lang ang nabilin sa third quarter.
english: The three-time All-Star guard’s latest penalty stemmed from his second technical foul in a game against the Los Angeles Lakers last week and was sent off with five minutes left in the third quarter.

text: Bangud sa amo man nga foul, awtomatiko siya nga gin-suspend sa hampang batok sa Utah Jazz kun sa diin nalutos man ang Wolves.
english: For the same foul, he was automatically suspended for the game against the Utah Jazz where the Wolves also lost.

text: Amo man ini ang iya ika-16 na nga technical foul subong nga season.
english: It was also his 16th technical foul this season.

text: Base sa patakaran, sa kada duha ka dugang nga technical fouls, magasaka man ang iya nga suspension sa isa pa ka game.
english: According to the rules, for every two additional technical fouls, his suspension will also increase for another game.

text: Gin-ako man ni Minnesota Coach Chris Finch nga gin-istorya naman sang team si Edwards nga dapat nga kaayuhon sini ang panimuon sini sa court.
english: Minnesota coach Chris Finch also acknowledged that the team has talked to Edwards about improving his behavior on the court.

text: “He’s got to be better,” suno sa coach.
english: “He’s got to be better,” the coach said.

text: “He’s had too many outbursts.
english: “He’s had too many outbursts.

text: I think a lot of them are deserved.
english: I think a lot of them are deserved.

text: They’re going to miss some calls from time to time for sure, so he’s got to be better, and we’ve been talking to him about it.
english: They’re going to miss some calls from time to time for sure, so he’s got to be better, and we’ve been talking to him about it.

text:
So it’s on him.”

Sang nagligad nga bulan, nauna na si Edwards sa pagpromisa nga indi na ini mag-angkon sang dugang nga technical fouls.
english:
So it’s on him.”

Last month, Edwards went ahead and promised he wouldn’t pick up any more technical fouls.

text: Luyag sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga himuon sang apat kag pilo ang ila budget sa masunod nga tuig agud mapasangkad ang suporta sa mga mangunguma.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) wants to quadruple and double its budget next year to expand support to farmers.

text: Suno sa ahensya, pinaagi sa sini nga lihok, mabuhinan ang pag-import sang mga produkto.
english: According to the agency, through this move, the importation of products will be reduced.

text: Base sa Philippine Council for Agriculture and Fisheries (PCAF), ang DA-NCP nagapangayo sang masobra 300% nga pagtaas sang ila budget sa masunod nga tuig halin sa subong nga P5 billion nga alokasyon.
english: Based on the Philippine Council for Agriculture and Fisheries (PCAF), the DA-NCP is seeking a more than 300% increase in its budget next year from the current P5 billion allocation.

text: Ang mas mataas nga budget ang gamiton para pabaskugon ang mga serbisyo para sa produksyon bilang parte sang mga paghimakas sang ahensya nga mapanami ang local nga produksyon kag mabuhinan ang pag-import sang mais.
english: The higher budget will be used to strengthen services for production as part of the agency’s efforts to improve local production and reduce maize imports.

text: Suno kay Milo delos Reyes, director sang DA-NCP, ang mas mataas nga budget ang makapasigurado sa paghatag mas madamo nga mga binhi kag fertilizer sa mga mangunguma sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: According to Milo delos Reyes, director of the DA-NCP, the higher budget will ensure the provision of more seeds and fertilizers to farmers nationwide.

text: Ginpahayag ni Delos Reyes nga plano sang ahensya nga maglunsyar sang isa ka programa nga makabulig sa pagpataas sang kita sang mga mangunguma sang mais kag iban pa.
english: Delos Reyes said the agency plans to launch a program that will help increase the income of corn farmers and others.

text: Patay ang punong barangay sang Tres de Mayo, Digos City matapos gintiro samtang naka-live stream sa Facebook.
english: The barangay captain of Tres de Mayo, Digos City was shot dead while live streaming on Facebook.

text: Ang biktima amo si Oscar Bucol Jr.
english: The victim was identified as Oscar Bucol Jr.

text: ​Nakuhaan sang iya facebook live ang insidente sang pagpangluthang.
english: His facebook live captured the shooting incident.

text: Sa video, makit-an ang kapitan nga nagapungko malapit sa gate sang iya nga balay.
english: In the video, the captain is seen sitting near the gate of his house.

text: May isa ka lalaki nga nagsulod sa gate sang balay sang opisyal agud magturn-over sang nakit-an nga wallet.
english: A man entered the gate of the officer's house to turn over the found wallet.

text: Samtang nagapanawagan ini sa tag-iya sang wallet, hinali lang nga may naglupok nga pusil kag naigo ang opisyal.
english: While he was calling for the owner of the wallet, suddenly a gun went off and hit the officer.

text: Mabatian pa ang pagpangayo sini sang tabang.
english: It can still be heard asking for help.

text: Gindala pa ini sa ospital apang wala na natabangan pa.
english: He was rushed to the hospital but was not helped.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon agud matumod ang responsable sa krimen.
english: Investigation is ongoing to identify the person responsible for the crime.

text: MADAMO ang na-shock sa paglisu sang ulo sang National Telecommunications Commission sa una nga tindug “under oath” sini sa Kamara sadtong Pebrero.
english: MANY were shocked by the turning of the head of the National Telecommunications Commission in its first stand “under oath” in the House of Representatives in February.

text: Ginpasalig sang NTC sadto ang Kongreso nga tagaan sing provisional authority sa pag-broadcast ang ABS-CBN samtang indi pa ma-finalize sang Kongreso ang renewal sang frankisa sini nga nag-expire sadtong Marso 4, 2020.
english: The NTC had assured Congress that it would grant ABS-CBN provisional broadcasting authority while Congress could not finalize the renewal of its franchise that expired on March 4, 2020.

text: Ngaa ayhan naglisu ang tindug sang NTC?
english: Why might the NTC's position have changed?

text: Makatingala samtang kaugalian na sini ang maghatag sang provisional authority sa mga broadcast networks samtang nagahulat sang approval sang ila frankisa.
english: It is surprising as it is customary to give provisional authority to broadcast networks while waiting for the approval of their franchise.

text: Tungod ayhan sa sugo sang mas poderoso?
english: Is it because of the command of someone more powerful?

text: Ambot lang, pero mas importante para sa aton subong nga dalion sang Kongreso ang pag-aprubar, kon aprubahan gid man nila, ang renewal sang frankisa sang ABS-CBN.
english: I don't know, but it's more important for us now that Congress quickly approves, if they approve, the renewal of the ABS-CBN franchise.

text: Obligasyon nila nga indi pag-ibutang sa alang-alang ang kinamatarong sang mga pumuluyo sa Hilway nga Pagpahayag (Freedom of the Press) sa aton Demokrasya nga ginamando mismo sang aton Konstitusyon.
english: It is their obligation not to compromise the right of the people to Freedom of the Press in our Democracy as mandated by our Constitution itself.

text: Salamat kay naka-isip gid man ang Kamara sang medyos agud mapilit ang poder sini sa Konstitusyon sa pag-grant sang frankisa sa mga broadcast networks.
english: Thankfully, the House of Representatives has come up with a way to insist on its power in the Constitution to grant franchises to broadcast networks.

text: Isa sang mga congressman ang nagpasar sang resolusyon agud tagaan anay sing temporaryo nga frankisa ang ABS-CBN.
english: One of the congressmen passed a resolution to grant ABS-CBN a temporary franchise.

text: Ugaling tubtub pa sa Hunyo 2022.
english: But until June 2022.

text: Tani ma-aprubhan na dayon ang frankisa agud mapakita sang Kongreso nga sa matuod may iya ini sing kaugalingon nga pensar nga indi matunga-tungahan.
english: I hope the franchise will be approved immediately so that Congress can show that it really has its own mind that cannot be divided.

text: Napahayag na ninyo ang inyo luyag nga aprubahan ang frankisa sang ABS-CBN, ti ano pa ang inyo ginahulat?
english: You have already expressed your desire to approve the ABS-CBN franchise, so what are you waiting for?

text: Tani indi na maglampuwas pa sa sining tuig 2020.
english: I hope it doesn't survive this year 2020.

text: Ngaa, may gapugong pa sa inyo haw?
english: Why, is there anyone holding you back?

text: Daw wala man sing martial law.
english: There doesn’t seem to be any martial law.

text: Okey lang na ang daku (bul-og) nga itlog, indi lang puti itlog…he-he-he!
english: It's okay to have a big egg, not just a white egg...he-he-he!

text:
***

Ang mga researchers kag developers sang bulong kag vaccine ang nagasiling nga wala sing droga nga ma-develop nga makapaayo sa balatian nga COVID-19.
english:
***

Researchers and developers of drugs and vaccines say that no drug can be developed to cure the disease COVID-19.

text: Kon may makatapna man, dugang nila, ang mabakunahan lang ang isa ka tawo batok sa COVID-19 nga dala sang virus nga SARS-CoV-2, ukon basi madula lang ini katulad sang pakaisa sini nga SARS-CoV-1.
english: If there is any prevention, they added, it is only to vaccinate a person against COVID-19 caused by the virus SARS-CoV-2, or maybe it will disappear like its cousin SARS-CoV-1.

text: Ang SARS-CoV-1 nag-peak sadtong Mayo 2003 kag nadula lang sadtong Hulyo 2003 samtang wala pa sing bakuna (vaccine) nga na-producir.
english: SARS-CoV-1 peaked in May 2003 and disappeared in July 2003 while no vaccine was produced.

text: In fact, natabo man ini sa Wuhan, China sang mag-peak ang infection sang COVID-19 sadtong Pebrero 24, 2020 pagkatapos una ini nadiskubrihan sadtong Nobyembre ukon Disyembre 2019 tubtub nanaog na ina kag ginabantyan na gid lang kon basi mag-rebound samtang wala pa sing vaccine.
english: In fact, this happened in Wuhan, China when the infection of COVID-19 peaked on February 24, 2020 after it was first discovered in November or December 2019 until it went down and is being watched for a rebound while there is no vaccine.

text: So, ang pamangkot: May ma-develop bala nga vaccine batok sa virus nga SAR-CoV-2, kag, kon wala, nga madula lang bala ini katulad sang natabo sa SARS-CoV 1 nga una man nanghalit sa China?
english: So, the question is: Will a vaccine be developed against the SAR-CoV-2 virus, and, if not, will it just disappear like what happened to SARS-CoV 1 that first hit China?

text: Ang tanan nga health experts nagasiling nga lain kaayo ining SARS-CoV-2 sa SARS-CoV-1.
english: All health experts say that SARS-CoV-2 is very different from SARS-CoV-1.

text: Mas mapintas ang SARS-CoV-1 – nag-infect sang sobra 8,000 kag nagpatay sang sobra man 700 – samtang ang SARS-CoV-2 sobra-sobra naman kadasig manglaton.
english: SARS-CoV-1 is more vicious – infecting more than 8,000 and killing more than 700 – while SARS-CoV-2 is extremely contagious.

text: Symptomatic (gapakita sintoma) ang tanan nga biktima sang SARS-CoV-1 samtang may Symptomatic kag Asymptomatic (wala sintoma) nga biktima ang SARS-CoV-2, nga amo gid ang nagapabudlay sa pagtapna sini.
english: All victims of SARS-CoV-1 are symptomatic while SARS-CoV-2 has symptomatic and asymptomatic victims, which makes it very difficult to prevent.

text: Tungod lain nga strain kag bag-o ang virus ang SARS-CoV-2, may lain-lain man nga pagpati parti sini.
english: Because SARS-CoV-2 is a different strain and a new virus, there are different beliefs about it.

text: May nagapati nga wala sing ma-develop nga vaccine ukon ano man nga pang-away nga droga batok diri, katulad sang AIDS virus nga HIV nga mangin carrier na gid lang ang host sini.
english: Some believe that no vaccine or any combat drug can be developed against it, such as the AIDS virus HIV that only becomes a carrier of its host.

text: Kon may treatment man diri amo lang ang mga retroviral drugs nga makapahinay lang sang pag-progress sang AIDS samtang gabulig man sa pagsagang sang pagpanglaton sini.
english: If there is a treatment, it is only retroviral drugs that can slow the progression of AIDS while helping to prevent its spread.

text: Mas madamo ugaling ang nagapati nga may ma-develop pa nga vaccine kontra sa balatian nga COVID-19.
english: However, more people believe that a vaccine against COVID-19 can be developed.

text: Kon may pangduha-duha man sila, ginaseguro nila ini paagi sa pagpatigayon sang mga clinical trials, katulad sang ginahimo subong sa Estados Unidos, Germany kag United Kingdom, kag iban pa.
english: If they have any doubts, they make sure of it by conducting clinical trials, as is now being done in the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom, among others.

text: Ang United Kingdom nagpahayag na gani nga maka-producir na sila sang vaccine sa palaabuton nga bulan sang Setyembre.
english: The United Kingdom has even announced that it will be able to produce a vaccine by September.

text: Anyway, kon wala gid man, may ara man kita sa subong sang mga treatment agud mapaayo ang mga pasyente katulad sang “supportive care”, pagpabakud sang natural immunity sang tawo, blood plasma theraphy kag ang padayon nga mga paagi nga indi malatnan sang COVID-19./PN
english: Anyway, if not, we also have treatments to improve patients such as “supportive care”, strengthening the natural immunity of the person, blood plasma therapy and the continuous ways to prevent the spread of COVID-19./PN

text: Ginpa-Bombo ni Punong Barangay Pancho Vijuan sang Brgy.
english: Punong Barangay Pancho Vijuan of Brgy.

text: Loboc, Lapuz ang mga nagalapta nga basura sa dalan sakop sang Coastal Road.
english: Loboc, Lapuz the garbage scattered on the road under the Coastal Road.

text: Ini matapos nga makit-an nga may ara sang tinumpok nga basura kag guba nga mga appliances ang nahamtang sa lugar.
english: This was after it was found that there was a pile of garbage and broken appliances located in the area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Vijuan, iya ginpahayag nga wala man sila sang ideya kun sin-o nga mga indibiwal nga nagalapta sang basura bangud indi man nila ini ma-monitor.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Vijuan said they have no idea who the individuals are who are spreading the garbage because they cannot monitor it.

text: Apang pahayag man sang opisyal, dako ang posibilidad nga halin ini sa junkshop kag hungod nga ginabilin sa tion sang kagab-ihon agud nga wala sang makakita.
english: However, the official said there is a high possibility that it came from a junkshop and was deliberately left at night so that no one would see it.

text: Nagapati man ini nga wala naghalin ang basura sa mga residente sang barangay bangud nga may ara sila sang regular nga garbage collection kada semana kag ila man nga gina-monitor ang basura sang ila nga mga pumuluyo.
english: He also believes that the garbage did not come from the residents of the barangay because they have a regular garbage collection every week and they also monitor the garbage of their residents.

text: Dugang pa niya nga magapatigayon sila sang clean-up drive sa masunod nga semana kaupod ang isa ka pribado nga organisasyon agud nga matinluan na ini.
english: He added that they will conduct a clean-up drive next week with a private organization to clean it up.

text: Nagapangabay man ini sa kun sin-o ang nagapanag-ya sang mga basura kag iban pa nga mga gamit nga kuhaon kag tinluan nalang nila ini bangud nga magapangatubang sila sang penalidad kun sila ang madakpan.
english: He also urged those who own garbage and other items to pick them up and clean them up because they will face penalties if they are caught.

text: Ano kadamo ang ginakaon mo nga kan-on?
english: How much rice do you eat?

text: Nagpaandam ang isa ka nutritionist batuk sa mga balatian nga mahimo makuha sa tuman nga pagkaon sang kan-on.
english: A nutritionist has warned against diseases that can be caused by eating too much food.

text: Suno kay Marilou Enteria, nutrition officer IV sang National Nutrition Council, isa ka tasa sang kan-on kada magkaon lang ang ginarekomenda sa mga babaye kag isa kag tunga naman sa mga lalaki.
english: According to Marilou Enteria, nutrition officer IV of the National Nutrition Council, one cup of food per meal is recommended for women and one and a half for men.

text: Kun magsobra dira, ini ang nagapatambok kag posible nga halinan sang sakit kaangay sang diabetes, heart disease kag iban pa nga sahi sang cancer.
english: In excess, it can lead to obesity and diseases such as diabetes, heart disease and other types of cancer.

text: Apang pahayag sang eskperto, indi man pwede nga indi kana lang magkaon sang kan-on bangud diri nagakuha ang lawas sang enerhiya.
english: But according to experts, you can't just not eat food because that's where the body gets energy.

text: Magabalik sa Iloilo City si Jake Ejercito kaupod sa iban pa nga mga artista kadungan sang selebrasyon sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: Jake Ejercito will return to Iloilo City along with other artists during the celebration of Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Lakip si Jake sa caravan sa Mandurriao sa Enero 26, alas kuatro sa hapon.
english: Jake will be among the caravan in Mandurriao on January 26, 4 pm.

text: “Grabe ka kalakas sa akon, langga!
english: “You’re so hard on me, baby!

text: Indi ta ka maagwanta, kaya babalikan kita agad this Sunday!,” suno sa actor.
english: I can't stand you, so we'll be back this Sunday!,” the actor said.

text:
Yara man ang loveteam nanday Donny Pangilinan kag Belle Mariano kaupod ang content creator nga si Esnyr nga lunsay yara sa series nga “How To Spot A Red Flag.”

Matandaan nga ginbansagan na si Jake bilang “langga” sang mga Ilonggo netizens kasunod sa iya pagpasakop sa Dinagyang Marathon sang Domingo kag paglibot sa syudad agud nga tilawan ang mga pagkaon nga ginapabugal sang Iloilo bilang naga-isahanon nga UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy sa Pilipinas.
english:
There is also the loveteam of Donny Pangilinan and Belle Mariano along with content creator Esnyr who are both in the series “How To Spot A Red Flag.”

Jake has been nicknamed “langga” by Ilonggo netizens following his participation in the Dinagyang Marathon on Sunday and a tour of the city to taste the foods that Iloilo is proud of as the only UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy in the Philippines.

text: “Mga palangga ko sa Iloilo, I absolutely didn’t expect such a warm welcome.
english: “My dear ones in Iloilo, I absolutely didn’t expect such a warm welcome.

text: Whether online or in person, I didn’t come across anyone who wasn’t pleasant or gracious.
english: Whether online or in person, I didn’t come across anyone who wasn’t pleasant or gracious.

text: Your kindness matches the beauty of your city.
english: Your kindness matches the beauty of your city.

text: Madamo gid na salamat for making my first visit truly memorable.
english: Thank you so much for making my first visit truly memorable.

text: Nagalaum gid ko nga makabalik ko liwat sa dasig lang nga tion.
english: I really hope I can come back again soon.

text: Pero buot gid ako nga magpakita ka na gid sa masunod, ok?
english: But I really want you to show up next time, ok?

text: Imo palangga, Uno,” kabahin sang post ni Jake sang nagbiya ini sa Iloilo sang Enero 20.#
english: Your love, Uno,” was part of Jake's post when he left Iloilo on January 20.#

text: Nagakatunga ang mga Pilipino sa posisyon sa pagdepensa sa West Philippine Sea bangud sang mga propagandista nga ginagamit sang China agud magpalapta sang disinformation ukon mga kabutigan.
english: Filipinos are divided on the defense position in the West Philippine Sea because of the propagandists used by China to spread disinformation or lies.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Jeffrey Ordaniel, ang President kag Chief Executive Officer sang non-government, nonprofit, kag nonpartisan volunteer-based organization nga WPS ukon We Protect our Seas Inc., iya ginpahayag nga madamo ang mga pseudo-experts sa social media nga amo ang naga-impluwensya sa opinyon sang mga Pinoy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Jeffrey Ordaniel, the President and Chief Executive Officer of the non-government, nonprofit, and nonpartisan volunteer-based organization WPS or We Protect our Seas Inc., said there are many pseudo-experts on social media who influence the opinion of Filipinos.

text: Ang mga pseudo-expert amo ang mga indibidwal nga nagapakuno-kuno nga eksperto sa international law apang sa pagkamatuod suno kay Ordaniel, wala man sang credible nga background ukon madalom nga ihibalo kun ano gid ang isyu sa teritoryo nga gina-agaw sang China.
english: Pseudo-experts are individuals who pretend to be experts in international law but in reality, according to Ordaniel, have no credible background or deep knowledge of what the issue is in the territory occupied by China.

text: Partikular sini nga natuksuan ang pangalan ni Sass Rogando Sasot nga naga-eskwela sang PhD sa International Relations sa Beijing, China.
english: He particularly came across the name of Sass Rogando Sasot who is studying PhD in International Relations in Beijing, China.

text: Bangud mabudlay nga balion ang claim sang Pilipinas sa West Philipine Sea kasunod sang 2016 Arbitral Ruling, diri na suno kay Ordaniel kag gina-atake na sang mga propagandista ang mga tawo mismo.
english: Because it is difficult to break the Philippines' claim to the West Philippine Sea following the 2016 Arbitral Ruling, Ordaniel said the propagandists are attacking the people themselves.

text: Gina-atake man gani sang mga propagandista pati si Retired Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio nga amo ang leading expert sa international law kag isa ka central figure sa pagdepensa sa sovereign rights sang Pilipinas sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Propagandists are even attacking Retired Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio, a leading expert on international law and a central figure in defending the Philippines' sovereign rights in the West Philippine Sea.

text: “It’s easier for them [propagandista] to destroy the person rather than the message, because the message is very strong.
english: “It’s easier for them [propagandista] to destroy the person rather than the message, because the message is very strong.

text: The message is based on the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS),” suno kay Ordaniel.
english: The message is based on the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS),” Ordaniel said.

text:
Sa tunga sini nga disinformation campaign, importante gid suno kay Ordaniel nga mabatuan ini sang Pilipinas paagi sa mga eskwelahan kag pagpadayon sang transparency initiative sang gobyerno ukon ang pagbulgar sang mga pagka-agresibo sang China.#

(AFP/Ted Aljibe/Photo)
english:
In the midst of this disinformation campaign, Ordaniel said it is very important that the Philippines fight it through schools and continue the government's transparency initiative or expose China's aggressions.

(AFP/Ted Aljibe/Photo)

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, matunog nga ginahambalan ang isa ka ilaga nga nakit-an sang isa ka pasahero sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport.
english: The other day, there was a loud discussion about a rat that a passenger saw at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport.

text: Ini ya, didto naman sa Sri Lanka, pero sa sulod gid sang eroplano!
english: This is in Sri Lanka, but inside the plane!

text: Kag nakahibalo ka bala?
english: And did you know?

text: Sang nakit-an ang ilaga sa sulod sang SriLankan Airlines Airbus A330 flight nga halin sa syudad sang Lahore sa Pakistan, nag-desisyon ang airline management nga indi na pagpalupadon ang eroplano sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw.
english: When the rat was found inside a SriLankan Airlines Airbus A330 flight from the city of Lahore in Pakistan, the airline management decided not to fly the plane for three days.

text: Importante ini suno sa management agud nga masiguro nga wala gin-it-it sang ilaga ang mga kritikal nga parte sang eroplano.
english: Management said this was important to ensure that the rat did not bite critical parts of the plane.

text: Ginsiling man sang management nga sang tion nga nakit-an ang ilaga, wala gid ginpahalin ang eroplano tubtub nga wala nasiguro nga patay na ini.
english: Management also said that once the rat was found, the plane was not released until it was confirmed dead.

text: Antes sini, nahibaluan nga ang airline nga ginapanag-iyahan sang state ang napierde na sang masobra $1.8 bilyon sa katapusan sang Marso 2023.
english: Earlier, it was learned that the state-owned airline had already lost more than $1.8 billion by the end of March 2023.

text: Tatlo ka iban pa nga eroplano sang SriLankan Airline ang na-ground man sang masobra isa ka tuig.
english: Three other SriLankan Airline aircraft have also been grounded for more than a year.

text: Ini ang rason nga indi ini basta-basta nga problema suno sa aviation minister bangud posible nga may investors na kuntani nga interesado kuhaon ang airline nga lubong sa utang, apang posible nga mag-isol bangud sa problema sa ilaga.
english: This is the reason why this is not a simple problem according to the aviation minister because it is possible that there are investors who would have been interested in taking the airline buried in debt, but it is possible to withdraw because of the rat problem.

text: SAMTANG wala pa ang bakuna (vaccine), dapat makalikaw gid kita nga ma-infect sang “very contagious” nga COVID-19 virus.
english: WHILE there is no vaccine, we must avoid being infected with the “very contagious” COVID-19 virus.

text: Pero kon malab-ut gid man kita, indi lang kita magdula sing paglaum kag pagsalig sa Ginuo sa ining away naton sa COVID-19 virus.
english: But if we are reached, let us not lose hope and trust in the Lord in this fight against the COVID-19 virus.

text: Pabakuron man ang aton natural immunity upod ang maayo nga pagtatap sang doktor agud mapunggan ang paglala kag mapaayo pa ang aton ginabatyag.
english: Also strengthen our natural immunity with good medical care to prevent worsening and improve our condition.

text: Una gid nga hingyu agud makalikaw kita sa infection amo ang pagdumili nga makasulod ining tubu China nga virus.
english: The first request to avoid infection is to ban the entry of this Chinese-born virus.

text: In fact, ginhimu ta na ang dapat himuon sa una nga pag-atraka sini.
english: In fact, we have done what we should have done in the first attraction.

text: Apang nakasulod gid, mayormante sa Metro Manila, nga sentro sang foreign travel sa pungsod halin sa China kag sang nalatnan na nga mga pungsod.
english: But it did enter, mainly in Metro Manila, which is the center of foreign travel in the country from China and other infected countries.

text: Maayo lang kay ginpa-lockdown dayon sang aton gobyerno nasyonal ang Luzon agud mapunggan sa paglapta ining virus sa iban nga bahin sang pungsod, katulad sang siyudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Fortunately, our national government immediately locked down Luzon to prevent the spread of this virus to other parts of the country, such as the city and province of Iloilo.

text: Ugaling nakapanagil-ut gid ini kag nagdeklarar man ang Iloilo sing lockdown sadtong Marso 20, apat ka adlaw pagkatapos nga gindeklarar ang lockdown sa Luzon sadtong Marso 16.
english: However, it was too late and Iloilo also declared a lockdown on March 20, four days after the lockdown was declared in Luzon on March 16.

text: Nonetheless, nakahingagaw kita maghingyu sang mga paagi nga mapunggan ang paglapta pa sang virus.
english: Nonetheless, we have been able to ask for ways to prevent the spread of the virus.

text: Una na dira ang pagpa-untat sang tanan nga byahe sang eroplano pasulod sa Iloilo.
english: First of all, the suspension of all flights into Iloilo.

text: Ginpatuman man ang rekomendasyon sang Department of Health (DOH) sa pag-isolate ss mga Infected, pati na ang mga Probable kag Suspected nga mga kaso upod na ang community kag home quarantine, kag pati na gani ang curfew.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) recommendation for the isolation of infected persons, as well as probable and suspected cases as well as community and home quarantine, and even curfew were also implemented.

text: Apang, indi madale-dale ang pagsunod sang mga pumuluyo sang sining mga pagsulundan, una tungod gani nagapuyo kita sa isa ka Demokrasyahon nga pungsod.
english: However, the people are not quick to follow these rules, first because we live in a democratic country.

text: Indi pareho ini sa authoritarian nga pungsod nga pwersahan nga gina-lock-up ang mga pumuluyo nga indi kinahanglan maghatag pa sang ila rason.
english: This is not like an authoritarian country where citizens are forcibly locked up without having to give their reasons.

text: Ang iban nga pumuluyo sige pa gani ang pagpasaway kag wala gani gapati sa kapintas sang COVID-19 kag magsiling pa sing “depende ina ya sa tawo” kag “kon tion mo, tion mo!” May ara man nga mga natural risk-takers nga daw mga may anting-anting nga indi madutlan sang COVID-19.
english: Some residents even continue to criticize and do not even believe in the cruelty of COVID-19 and say “it depends on the person” and “if it's your time, it's your time!” There are also natural risk-takers who seem to have a charm that cannot be infected with COVID-19.

text: Apang amat-amat gid man napatuman ining mga pagsulundan sa pagpatuman na sang bagay nga mga kasuguan, nga amo lang ang paagi sa Demokrasya nga mapasunod ang mga pumuluyo.
english: But these rules were gradually implemented in the implementation of appropriate laws, which is the only way in democracy to make the people obey.

text:
***

Tungod sang madasig nga paglapta sang infection, indi pa gid mapunggan ang pagsaka sang mga kaso sa Luzon, bisan nga sa mga lokalidad naghagan-hagan na ang infection kag handa na gani ang iban, lakip na ang Iloilo, sa pagpatuman sa indi madugay sing “lockdown exit” bisan paamat-amat lang.
english:
***

Due to the rapid spread of the infection, the increase in cases in Luzon cannot be stopped, although in some localities the infection has subsided and some, including Iloilo, are ready to implement a lockdown exit soon, even if only gradually.

text: Gintugot na gani naton ang pagbaton sa mga manugpauli nga mga OFW, nga laban sini mga seaman halin sa ila destino sa iban nga pungsod.
english: We have even allowed the reception of returning OFWs, most of whom are seamen from their assignments abroad.

text: Sentimental ang mga Filipino kag kon pwede lang papaulion gid ang ila mga himata nga OFW.
english: Filipinos are sentimental and if possible, they would send their OFW relatives home.

text: Tungod sini, ginpapauli ang una nga batch nga 178 sa Iloilo City sadtong Abril 29, sa kondisyon nga negatibo sila sa COVID-19 sa ila paghalin sa Metro Manila.
english: As a result, the first batch of 178 was sent home to Iloilo City on April 29, on condition that they tested negative for COVID-19 upon their departure from Metro Manila.

text: Apang, daw natontohan kita kay ang lima sang gin-quarantine sing 14 ka adlaw nahibal-an nga positibo gali sang i-subject sila sa RT-CPR test sa pag-abot gid nila sa ila ginpadayunan nga otel diri.
english: However, we seem to have been fooled because five of those who were quarantined for 14 days were found to be positive when they were subjected to the RT-CPR test upon arrival at their hotel here.

text: Sunu sa spokesman sang Regional Inter-Agency Task Force (RIATF) ang pag-test sa ila saMetro Manila ginhimo sa Rapid Covid-19 testing machine, nga dapat ginhimo na tani sang mas masaligan nga test sang RT-CPR machine.
english: According to the spokesman of the Regional Inter-Agency Task Force (RIATF), the testing of those in Metro Manila was done with the Rapid Covid-19 testing machine, which should have been done with a more reliable test of the RT-CPR machine.

text: Sunu sa mga health experts, ang paggamit sang RT-CPR dapat man sa husto nga timing kay ang infection mauna sang 3-5 ka adlaw sa pagpakita sang sintoma.
english: According to health experts, the use of RT-CPR should also be timed properly because the infection takes 3-5 days to show symptoms.

text: Kinahanglan man ang husto nga  kadamuon sang swab specimen kag bagay nga “skills” sang specialist.
english: The right number of swab specimens and appropriate skills of the specialist are also required.

text: Dapat tani ginhimo ang pag-test nga daan sa RT-CPR didto sa Metro Manila agud i-retest lang sila diri sa Iloilo City sa pareho nga testing machine sa posibilidad na lang sang infection sa tion sang pag-biyahe.
english: The RT-CPR testing should have been done in advance in Metro Manila so that they can be retested here in Iloilo City in the same testing machine for the possibility of infection during travel.

text: Indi kay kumpirmahon ini sa Rapid test nga “inconclusive” gali.
english: Not because it will be confirmed in the Rapid test that is “inconclusive”.

text: Pasalamat na gid lang kita seguro nga ang lima nga nangin positibo, nga ang isa sini manugpauli sa Guimaras, may todo bantay kag pagpangamlig nga indi gid makagwa sa ila ginadayunan, ma-isolate sing nagakaigu, kag mabulong tubtub mag-ayo.
english: We are probably grateful that the five who tested positive, one of whom is returning to Guimaras, have full guard and protection so that they cannot leave their accommodation, are properly isolated, and are treated until they recover.

text: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)
english: (w_mateojr@yahoo.com/PN)

text: Ginalantaw nga rason sa pagluthang sa isa ka manunudlo sa Talavera, Nueva Ecija amo nga posible naluyag ang suspek sa asawa sang biktima.
english: The suspect is believed to have been in love with the victim's wife.

text: Natabo ang pagpatay sa biktima nga si Reynan Tiangco, 39-anyos, samtang yara sa ilimnan sa ila tupadbalay.
english: The victim, Reynan Tiangco, 39, was killed while at a bar next door.

text: Hinali lang nag-abot ang gunman kag gintiro ang biktima.
english: The gunman suddenly arrived and shot the victim.

text: Nagpalagyo ang mga suspek sakay sa motorsiklo.
english: The suspects fled the scene on a motorcycle.

text: Gindala pa sa ospital ang biktima apang wala na natabangan.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but was not helped.

text: Pagkasunod nga adlaw, nagsungka ang isa ka anay barangay kagawad nga gintudlo sang isa ka saksi nga isa sa mga suspek kag nasiplatan man ini malapit sa lugar kun sa diin ginpatay ang biktima.
english: The next day, a former barangay kagawad who was identified by a witness as one of the suspects surrendered and was also spotted near the place where the victim was killed.

text: Hugot naman nga ginpanginwala sang suspek ang mga akusasyon kag nanindugan nga wala ini sang sala.
english: The suspect strongly denied the charges and insisted that he was innocent.

text: Padayon naman nga ginaayam ang gunman.
english: The gunman is still being sought.

text: Na-report nga isa ka tawo ang patay samtang madamo ang nasamaran sa pagpangluthang kag pasunog sa isa ka Mormon church sa Michigan.
english: One person was reported dead and several injured in a shooting and arson at a Mormon church in Michigan.

text: Naggamit sang assault riffle ang suspek sa Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints nga nahamtang sa Grand Blanc, Michigan.
english: The suspect used an assault rifle at the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints located in Grand Blanc, Michigan.

text: Madamo man ang nasamaran sa insidente kun sa diin gilayon man sila nga gindala sa hospital.
english: Many people were injured in the incident and were rushed to the hospital.

text: Napalong naman ang sunog kag ginahibalo pa sang mga otoridad ang intension sang suspek mangin ang motibo sini.
english: The fire was extinguished and the authorities are still investigating the suspect's intention and motive.

text: Kun may bata sa inyo nga balay, posible nga pamilyar ikaw sa musika nga ginagamit sa “Peppa Pig” cartoon bangud sulit-sulit nila ini nga ginalantaw.
english: If you have children in your home, you are probably familiar with the music used in the “Peppa Pig” cartoon because they watch it over and over again.

text: Sa Jiangxi province sa China, isa ka pulis ang ginadayaw bangud sa iya nga paggamit sa sini nga musika agud nga makit-an ang isa ka missing nga bata nga may autism.
english: In China's Jiangxi province, a police officer is being praised for using this music to find a missing child with autism.

text: Isa ka adlaw, may nag-report sa pulis nga may walo ka tuig nga missing nga bata nga may apelyido nga Lu kag tuman ang kahangawa sang pamilya bangud inoras na nila ini nga ginapangita.
english: One day, someone reported to the police that an eight-year-old boy named Lu was missing and the family was very worried because they had been looking for him for hours.

text: Sang nagresponde ang otoridad, nabudlayan sila bangud guba ang surveillance cameras sa building nga nga nahamtangan sang pamilya amo man ang yara sa elevator rason nga indi sila makasigurado kun nakaguwa ang bata ukon yara lang gihapon sa residential complex.
english: When the authorities responded, they had difficulty because the surveillance cameras in the building where the family was located were also broken and in the elevator so they could not be sure if the child was out or still in the residential complex.

text: Anum ka oras ang ginlawig sang search kaupod sa pamilya kag property management tubtub nga nakalab-ot na sila sa kaagahon apang huyhuy gihapon ang abaga bangud indi makit-an ang ila nga ginapangita.
english: The search lasted six hours with the family and property management until they reached the morning but the shoulders were still shaking because they could not find what they were looking for.

text: Sa bahin sang pulis, ginpaminsar sini sang madalom nga basi kun nag-saka ang bata sa atop sang nagbalik ini sa ila balay kag wala sang may nakit-an nga tawo.
english: For the police, he thought deeply that the child might have climbed on the roof when he returned home and found no one.

text: Bangud nahibaluan sini nga may mga beses nga wala nagasabat sa kada tawag ang mga bata nga may autism, gingamit sini ang theme song sang “Peppa Pig” nga paborito gid nga lantawon sang bata.
english: Because she knew that sometimes children with autism did not answer every call, she used the theme song of “Peppa Pig” which was a favorite of the child.

text: Sang ulihi, sa dalayon nga pagpatukar sini, may nagkulas.
english: Finally, as it continued to play, someone knocked.

text: “By that time it was very dark and we were getting no response when we called him, so we started playing the music and heard a very faint sound,” suno sa police officer nga si Xu Haozhan.
english: “By that time it was very dark and we were getting no response when we called him, so we started playing the music and heard a very faint sound,” said police officer Xu Haozhan.

(Editor’s Note: This column was written and submitted before the announcement that Iloilo City will continue to be under an Enhanced Community Quarantine.)

ILOILO CITY, along with several other cities and provinces, has been downgraded to General Community Quarantine (GCQ) where people's behavior will be more relaxed than when it was under Enhanced CQ.

text: Kon ano na ang kahimtangan sang pagginawi sang mga tawo sa GCQ, ginpaathag ini ni presidential spokesperson Harry Roque.

text:
***

Nag-abot sadtong aga sang Abril 28 sa Bacolod sakay sa 2GO nga barko ang una nga batch sang mga 336 ka OFWs nga na-stranded sa Metro Manila sa sulod na sang sobra lima ka semana tubtub sa pag-abot nila diri sa Bacolod.
english:
***

The first batch of 336 OFWs who were stranded in Metro Manila for more than five weeks arrived in Bacolod on the morning of April 28 aboard the 2GO ship.

text: Ini sila tanan na-subject na sa Rapid Testing bag-o gintugtan nga makapauli pakadto sa ila mga lugar paggwa sa Metro Manila pagkatapos mahibal-an nga negatibo sila sa Covid-19 virus.
english: They were all subjected to Rapid Testing before being allowed to return to their hometowns after leaving Metro Manila after testing negative for the Covid-19 virus.

text: Ang nahibal-an nga positibo wala ginapasugtan sa pagpauli.
english: Those who are known to be positive are not allowed to return home.

text: Ining una nga batch nagadamo sing 230 nga ang 52 sa ila ginpapanaog sa Bacolod kon diin sila nagapuyo kag ukon diin man sa Negros.
english: This first batch numbers 230 of which 52 were dropped off in Bacolod where they live and or elsewhere in Negros.

text: Diri mismo ginhawidan anay sila sang Western Visayas Inter-Agency Task Force (WV-IATF) agud magtener sa pila ka dalayunan diri sing 14 ka adlaw nga pagka-quarantine agud mapihu nga negatibo gihapon sila sa pag-abot nila sa Bacolod.
english: They were first detained by the Western Visayas Inter-Agency Task Force (WV-IATF) to stay in several hotels here for 14 days of quarantine to ensure that they were still negative upon arrival in Bacolod.

text: Pagkatapos sini, nagpadulong ang barko sa Fort San Pedro sa Iloilo City sadtong Abril 29 sa diin  gindul-ong ang 178 ka OFWs sa Iloilo nga lakip diri ang 35 sa Aklan, 10 sa Antique, 15 sa Capiz, kag 15 sa Guimaras.
english: After that, the ship headed to Fort San Pedro in Iloilo City on April 29 where 178 OFWs were taken to Iloilo, including 35 from Aklan, 10 from Antique, 15 from Capiz, and 15 from Guimaras.

text: Ginsugat man ini sila sang WV-IATF agud dalhon sa ila dalayunan diri sa siyudad sang Iloilo diin magpaligad man anay sing 14 ka adlaw nga quarantine agud mapihu kon sa gihapon negatibo sila bag-o magpauli sa ila mga puluy-an diri sa Panay kag Guimaras.
english: They were also picked up by the WV-IATF to be taken to their accommodation here in Iloilo City where they will undergo 14 days of quarantine to determine if they are still negative before returning to their homes here in Panay and Guimaras.

text: Ang ikaduha nga batch sang sining na-stranded nga mga OFWs, nga mga 106 pa, ginpaabot nga mag-abot sadtong Huwebes, April 30 diri man sa Western Visayas.
english: The second batch of these stranded OFWs, about 106 more, was expected to arrive on Thursday, April 30 here in Western Visayas.

text: Sobra pa sa 50 ka OFW ang manugpauli sa Iloilo halin sa Cebu, sa diin na-stranded man sila sing sobra isa ka bulan.
english: More than 50 OFWs are returning to Iloilo from Cebu, where they were also stranded for more than a month.

text: Ang aton tiliman-an nagsiling man nga ang tanan nga gasto nila – billeting, food kag iban pa – ginsalu tanan sang Overseas Workers Welfare Administration ukon OWWA.
english: Our source also said that all their expenses – billeting, food and others – were covered by the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration or OWWA.

text:
***

Wala kita sing tul-id nga ihibalo kon ano nga metodo sang Rapid Testing ang ginhimo sa ila agud ma-determine kon bala negatibo ukon positibo sa Covid-19 ining mga OFW.
english:
***

We do not know exactly what method of Rapid Testing was done on them to determine whether these OFWs were negative or positive for Covid-19.

text: Ini bala paagi lang sa RT-CPR sa diin ginkuhaan sila sing respiratory samples paagi sa throat swab (absorbent pad) kag/ukon sputum sample, ukon paagi sa Serology ukon Antibody Testing?
english: Was it just through RT-CPR where they had respiratory samples taken via throat swab (absorbent pad) and/or sputum sample, or via Serology or Antibody Testing?

text: Paagi sa RT-CPR mahibal-an dayon ang infection halin sa makuha nga specimen sa throat swab ukon sputum sample.
english: RT-CPR can immediately detect infection from a throat swab or sputum sample.

text: Sa Serology ukon Antibody Testing, ang resulta ginakuha sa dugo.
english: In Serology or Antibody Testing, the result is taken from the blood.

text: May problema sa RT-CPR tungod ang infection mauna sing mga tatlo pa ka adlaw bag-o magpakita ang sintoma, gani pwede ang pasyente mag-negatibo bisan na-infect na siya.
english: There is a problem with RT-CPR because the infection takes about three days before symptoms appear, so the patient can test negative even if he is already infected.

text: Maproblema man kon ma-delay ang pagpadala sang swab specimen kay maga-negatibo na ini pagkaligad sang pila ka adlaw nga indi ma-subject sa testing.
english: It will also be a problem if the swab specimen is delayed because it will be negative after a few days of not being subjected to testing.

text: Ang bentaha sini amo nga mahibal-an ang resulta dayon halin sa bastante kadamo nga swab/sputum specimen.
english: The advantage of this is that the result can be determined immediately from a sufficiently large swab/sputum specimen.

text: May problema man sa Antibody Testing.
english: There is also a problem with Antibody Testing.

text: Ang resulta basi mahulat pa tubtub 28 ka adlaw pagkatapos sang initial infection.
english: The result may wait up to 28 days after the initial infection.

text: Ang bentaha sini amo nga mahibal-an nga na-infect ang pasyente sa ginpakita lang nga sablag sa antibodies sa pag-away sini batok sa virus.
english: The advantage of this is that it is possible to determine whether the patient is infected by the only obstacle shown by the antibodies in its fight against the virus.

text: In other words, maka-detect ini kon na-infect ukon wala ang isa ka Asymptomatic bisan nag-ayo na.
english: In other words, it can detect whether an Asymptomatic person is infected or not even after recovery.

text: Tungod sini, ang kumpleto nga Rapid Testing ginahimo sa combined RT-CPR/Antibody Test para sa mas masaligan gid nga resulta.
english: For this reason, complete Rapid Testing is done in combined RT-CPR/Antibody Test for a much more reliable result.

text:
DETERMINADO ang siyudad sang Iloilo – lakip ang probinsya sang Iloilo –
sa pagpatuman sang amat-amat nga pag-relax sang enhanced community quarantine
(ECQ) sa palaabuton nga Abril 30 padulong sa “New Normal” nga pangabuhi sa
padayon pa nga panalakay sang COVID-19.
english:
DETERMINED the city of Iloilo – including the province of Iloilo –
to implement the gradual relaxation of enhanced community quarantine
(ECQ) on April 30 towards the “New Normal” of life in
padayon pa nga panalakay sang COVID-19.

text:
Nagsugod ang ECQ sa siyudad sadtong Marso 20, 2020, apat ka adlaw
pagkatapos nga una gindeklarar ini sa Luzon sadtong Marso 16.
english:
The ECQ in the city began on March 20, 2020, four days
after it was first declared in Luzon on March 16.

text:
Ngaa bala ipatuman gid ining “New Normal” nga pangabuhi pagsugod sang
Abril 30, samtang ang pila ka health experts nagasiling nga kinahanglan pa ang
paghulat tubtub mga duha pa ka bulan despues?
english:
Why implement this “New Normal” lifestyle at the beginning of
April 30, while some health experts say more is needed
waiting until about two more months later?

text:
Sa bahin sang health experts, luyag lang nila seguro hulaton gid nga
ma-“flatten ang curve” tubtub mag-zero case, katulad sang experyensya sang
Wuhan, China.
english:
As for the health experts, they probably just want to wait until
flatten the curve to zero cases, similar to the experience of
Wuhan, China.

text:
Indi ta man ugaling masunod ang kaso sang Wuhan diri sa Filipinas tungod
nagsugod ang China nga wala gid sing hinalong-ong sa COVID-19 tungod bag-o ini
nga balatian.
english:
However, we cannot follow the case of Wuhan here in the Philippines because
China started off completely indifferent to COVID-19 because it was new
disease.

text:
Sa aton bahin sa Filipinas, nagsugod kita sing husto nga pag-away sa
balatian nga COVID-19 sang ginpabatyag na kita sini sa pagdeklarar man sang
aton ECQ, nga dala na ang experyensya sang China kag ang kinaalam sang iban nga
pungsod kag World Health Organization.
english:
For our part in the Philippines, we have started a right fight with
COVID-19 disease when it made us feel it in the declaration of
our ECQ, bringing with it China's experience and the wisdom of other
country and World Health Organization.

text:
Tungod sini, wala kita gapaabot nga matam-an kita sang COVID-19 samtang
ginapatuman naton ang tanan nga nahibal-an naton kag ikasarang agud mapunggan
ang pamintas sang COVID-19 sa aton klase nga kahimtangan kag exposure sa sining
balatian.
english:
Because of this, we do not expect to see a lot of COVID-19 while
we apply everything we know and can to prevent
the impact of COVID-19 on our class situation and exposure to this
disease.

text:
***

May kaugalingon nga rason ang siyudad kag ang probinsya sang Iloilo agud
ipatuman ang “New Normal” sa Abril 30, kon madayon gid man.
english:
***

The city and the province of Iloilo have their own reasons to
implement the “New Normal” on April 30, if at all.

text:
Sunu mismo kay Mayor Treñas, naluoy na siya sa mga kubos ta nga pumuluyo

pamilya nga may dignidad  kag indi lang

english:
According to Mayor Treñas, he feels sorry for our poor people
who are still unable to work and earn a living for their
family with dignity and not just
always relies on government aid, while it also counts the damage

text:
Daku nga risgo ining pag-relax sang lockdown sa subong, sunu sa mga
health experts sa ila pagpati nga basi mag-rebound sing mas lala ang virus kay
indi pa ini matapat sa subong.
english:
The relaxation of the lockdown is a big risk at the moment, according to

it is not honest at the moment.

text:
Apang nagpasugot gid man ang mga health experts sang siyudad sang ulihi

But the city's health experts eventually agreed
as long as there is proper protection.

text:

Angot sa sining desisyon sang siyudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo sa

mabungahon ini.
english:

Regarding the decision of the city and province of Iloilo to

text: UNA, seguruhon nga “controllable” ang infection sang COVID-19 virus.

in Spain, Turkey, Ukraine, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Kremlin and United

ila.

There are cases where

text:
IKA-APAT, nga “manageable” ining “New Normal” nga pangabuhi, meaning

text:

The Department of Health said
