text: Ikaw bala ang masami nga naga selfie sa imo nga smartphone?
english: Are you the one who often takes selfies with your smartphone?

text: Wala sang segundo, minuto ukon inoras ka nga malapawan bangud sa kada hulag mo, click ka lang nga click agud nga magkuha sang picture sang imo nga kaugalingon.
english: There is no second, minute or hour to miss because every time you move, you just click to take a picture of yourself.

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga mahimo mahulog sa addiction ang masami mo nga pag-selfie?
english: Did you know that taking selfies too often can become an addiction?

text: Suno kay Dr. Robyn Silverman, teen development specialist, ang mga pre-adolescents kag teens ang padayon nga nagapangita sang pamaagi agud nga kilalahon ang kaugalingon kag makilala man sang iban.
english: According to Dr. Robyn Silverman, teen development specialist, pre-adolescents and teens are constantly looking for ways to recognize themselves and be recognized by others.

text: Para naman sa mga tweens kag teens, ang mas dako nga kabahin sang ila social interaction sa isa ka adlaw ang pinaagi sa paggamit sang smartphones ukon social networking sites.
english: For tweens and teens, a larger portion of their social interaction in a day is through the use of smartphones or social networking sites.

text: Apang ang pagkuha kag pagpost sang selfies ang characteristics sang Body Dysmorphic Disorder — isa ka chronic mental illness.
english: But taking and posting selfies are characteristics of Body Dysmorphic Disorder — a chronic mental illness.

text: Suno sa doktor, ang pagkuha sang selfie nga paliwat-liwat kag makapila ka beses ang mahimo nga “harmless” lang lantawon apang kun ini ang ginahimo sa madugay na nga tion, oras-oras kag adlaw-adlaw, diri na kag nagatuga ang tuman nga self conscious, self-indulgent kag nagakaangkon sang “false sense of confidence” kag mas malala pa, nagakaangkon ikaw sang “narcissistic delusions”.
english: According to the doctor, taking selfies repeatedly and several times may seem harmless but if it is done for a long time, hour after hour and day, it creates a false sense of confidence, self-indulgence and a false sense of confidence. delusions”.

text: Kun kaisa ang pag-selfie pa ang kabangdanan sa pagka-aksidente sang isa ka tawo.
english: Sometimes taking a selfie is the cause of a person's accident.

text: Nagbilin sang lima ka patay kag linibo naman ka mga residente ang nag-evacuate halin sa ila nga mga balay bangud sa halit nga dala sang Bagyo Basyang.
english: Typhoon Basyang left five people dead and thousands of residents evacuated from their homes.

text: Tuman ka dako naman ang epekto sang bagyo sa mga pamilya sa syudad sang Cagayan de Oro, kun sa diin isa ka landslide sa Barangay Agusan ang nagpatay sa apat ka miyembro sang pamilya dala na diri ang mag-asawa kag duwa ka mga bata.
english: The typhoon also had a huge impact on families in Cagayan de Oro City, where a landslide in Barangay Agusan killed four family members including a couple and two children.

text: Sa Iligan City, Lanao del Norte, isa ka radio broadcaster ang napatay bangud sa cardiac arrest matapos ginsul-ob sang tubig-baha ang iya apartment.
english: In Iligan City, Lanao del Norte, a radio broadcaster died of cardiac arrest after flood waters engulfed his apartment.

text: Gindeklarar man ang state of calamity sa amo nga syudad agud magamit ang calamity fund para sa relief operations kag makaayo ang naguba nag mga pasilidad kasunod sang malapad nga pagbaha, landslide, kag halit sa imprastraktura.
english: A state of calamity was also declared in the city to use the calamity fund for relief operations and repair damaged facilities following widespread flooding, landslides, and infrastructure damage.

text: Suno kay Junie Castillo, spokesperson sang Office of the Civil Defense, madamo sa mga probinsya ang sa karon wala sang suplay sang kuryente kag ang iban napilitan na lang nga mag-evacuate.
english: According to Junie Castillo, spokesperson of the Office of the Civil Defense, many provinces are currently without power supply and others have been forced to evacuate.

text: Sa Misamis Oriental masobra 32,700 ka tawo ang nag-evacuate, samtang sa Camiguin naman masobra 2,100 ka tawo ang naghalalin sa ila mga balay.
english: In Misamis Oriental more than 32,700 people evacuated, while in Camiguin more than 2,100 people left their homes.

text: Mabaskog naman ang epekto sang bagyo sa Cebu nga nagbilin sang 350 ka mga pasahero nga na-stranded sa nagkalain-lain nga pantalan.
english: The typhoon hit Cebu strongly, leaving 350 passengers stranded in various ports.

text: Sa kabilugan nga probinsya sang Cebu 58 ka mga evacuation centers ang ginpahamtang agud masayluhan sang mga apektado.
english: In the entire province of Cebu, 58 evacuation centers have been set up to relocate the affected.

text: Ginkansela naman sang Police Regional Office 7 ang tanan nga leave sang mga pulis kag ginpatuman ang “heightened alert” status.
english: The Police Regional Office 7 has canceled all leaves of policemen and implemented a “heightened alert” status.

text: Isa ka bag-o ginbun-ag nga lapsag ang gin-kidnap sang isa ka nagpakuno-kuno nga nurse sa South Cotabato Provincial Hospital sa Koronadal City.
english: A newborn baby was kidnapped by a pretending nurse at the South Cotabato Provincial Hospital in Koronadal City.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, nagsulod ang suspek nga nagasuksok pa sang medical service attire sang isa ka nurse sa sulod sang ospital kag ginkuha ang baby.
english: According to the investigation, the suspect entered the hospital wearing the medical service attire of a nurse and took the baby.

text: Suno sa iloy sang bata, ginhambalan sila sang suspek nga ipaidalom sa hearing test ang bata apang wala na ginbalik.
english: According to the child's mother, the suspect told them to take the child for a hearing test but did not return it.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginsulod sang suspek ang bata sa bag pagwa sa ospital.
english: The suspect allegedly put the child in a bag out of the hospital.

text: Sa pagpangita naman sang otoridad, narekober ang bata sa sulod sang isa pa ka ospital nga amo ang Dr. Arturo Pingoy Medical Center sa Koronadal City samtang ginakugos sang isa ka babaye nga ginapahayag nagasuprir sang postpartum depression.
english: During the search, the child was recovered inside another hospital, Dr. Arturo Pingoy Medical Center in Koronadal City while being hugged by a woman who is allegedly suffering from postpartum depression.

text: Nagapangatubang subong sang kaso nga kidnapping ang babaye nga nagkidnap sa bata.
english: The woman who kidnapped the child is now facing charges of kidnapping.

text: Indi na makabalik si Jayson Castro sa nabilin nga bahin sang season matapos nakaangkon sang injury sa iya nga tuhod sa hampang sang TNT batok sa Rain or Shine sa PBA Commissioner’s Cup semifinals.
english: Jayson Castro will miss the rest of the season after suffering a knee injury in TNT's game against Rain or Shine in the PBA Commissioner's Cup semifinals.

text: Suno kay TNT team manager Jojo Lastimosa, kinahanglan sang star guard ang 10-12 ka bulan nga pahuway.
english: According to TNT team manager Jojo Lastimosa, the star guard needs 10-12 months of rest.

text: Matandaan nga sang manugtapos na ang hampang, ginpaguwa sa court ang 38-anyos nga veteran gamit ang stretcher kag gindala sa ospital.
english: It can be recalled that towards the end of the match, the 38-year-old veteran was taken off the court on a stretcher and taken to the hospital.

text: Kinahanglan man ang adjustments sa Tropang Giga nga subong may 2-0 lead sa best-of-seven series sa semis.
english: Adjustments will also be needed with Tropang Giga who now have a 2-0 lead in the best-of-seven series in the semis.

text: Sa 93-91 win sang Tropang Giga sang Biyernes, nagtapos si Castro nga may 13 pts, 5 rebounds, kag 5 assists.
english: In Tropang Giga’s 93-91 win on Friday, Castro finished with 13 pts, 5 rebounds, and 5 assists.

text: Sa Game 1 naman, naangkon sini ang team-high nga 24 pts.
english: In Game 1, he scored a team-high 24 pts.

text: Sa Governors’ Cup sang nagligad, siya man ang ginhingadlan nga Finals Most Valuable Player apisar sang iya edad.
english: In the Governors’ Cup last year, he was also named the Finals Most Valuable Player despite his age.

text: Subong nga adlaw ang Game 3 sa Araneta Coliseum kun sa diin tinguhaan sang TNT nga makuha ang 3-0 lead agud mas makapalapit sa finals.
english: Today is Game 3 at Araneta Coliseum where TNT will try to take a 3-0 lead to get closer to the finals.

text: Pinayagan ng US Supreme Court nitong Biyernes ang Trump administration na pansamantalang i-freeze ang mahigit $4 bilyong pondo para sa foreign aid na inaprobahan ng Congress.
english: The US Supreme Court on Friday allowed the Trump administration to temporarily freeze more than $4 billion in foreign aid funds approved by Congress.

text: Ayon sa conservative-dominated court, mas matimbang umano ang kapangyarihan ng pangulo sa pamamahala ng foreign affairs kaysa sa posibleng pinsala na kahaharapin ng mga nakalaang tatanggap ng nasabing pondo.
english: According to the conservative-dominated court, the president's power to manage foreign affairs is outweighed by the possible damage suffered by the intended recipients of the fund.

text: Nilinaw ng korte na ang inilabas nitong emergency order ay hindi pa pinal na desisyon sa kaso.
english: The court clarified that the emergency order issued is not a final decision on the case.

text: Sa halip, ito ay nagbubukas ng daan para pansamantalang pigilan ang paglalabas ng pondo habang nagpapatuloy pa ang pagdinig sa lower courts.
english: Instead, it opens the way to temporarily block the release of funds while the hearing continues in the lower courts.

text: Tumutol naman ang tatlong liberal justices, kabilang si Justice Elena Kagan na nagsabing mataas ang nakataya sa usaping ito.
english: Three liberal justices, including Justice Elena Kagan, objected, saying the stakes were high.

text: Iginiit niyang ang isyu ay nakatuon sa alokasyon ng kapangyarihan sa pagitan ng Executive at ng Congress pagdating sa paggastos ng pondo publiko.
english: He stressed that the issue is focused on the allocation of power between the Executive and Congress when it comes to spending public funds.

text:
Binanggit din ni Kagan na ang order ay inilabas nang may “scant briefing, walang oral argument, at walang pagkakataon para sa deliberasyon sa conference.”

Dagdag pa niya, ang naging epekto ng desisyon ay pahintulutan ang Executive branch na ihinto ang paglalaan ng $4 bilyong foreign aid na inaprobahan ng Congress, pondo na ngayon ay posibleng hindi na makarating sa mga itinalagang benepisyaryo.
english:
Kagan also noted that the order was issued with “scant briefing, no oral argument, and no opportunity for deliberation at the conference.”

He added that the effect of the decision was to allow the Executive branch to suspend the allocation of $4 billion in foreign aid approved by Congress, funds that now may not reach the designated beneficiaries.

text: Nagluya kag nahimo na lamang nga low pressure area ukon LPA ang Bagyo Basyang samtang nagahulag ini sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan sa kadagatan sang Sulu.
english: Typhoon Basyang weakened into a low pressure area or LPA as it moved westward into the Sulu Sea.

text: Sa alas singko sa kaagahon nga weather bulletin, ulihi nga nakit-an ang low pressurea area sa kalayuon nga 105 km/h Southeast sang Cuyo, Palawan.
english: In the 5:00 am weather bulletin, the low pressure area was last detected at a distance of 105 km/h Southeast of Cuyo, Palawan.

text: Ginbawi naman sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration ang wind signal sa tanan nga mga lugar sa pungsod.
english: The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration has withdrawn the wind signal in all areas of the country.

text: Apang suno pa sa ahensya, mabatyagan sa gihapon ang northeast monsoon ukon amihan kag magadala sang pagmadlos sang hangin ilabi na sa mga coastal areas sang Luzon, Western Visayas, Negros Island Region, kag Zamboanga del Norte subong nga adlaw.
english: However, the agency said the northeast monsoon will still be felt and will bring gusty winds especially in the coastal areas of Luzon, Western Visayas, Negros Island Region, and Zamboanga del Norte today.

text: Samtang mahinay ang hulag sang LPA kag bangud sa indi paborable nga kondisyon sang agyan sini, daku ang tsansa suno sa ahensya nga matunaw na ini samtang yara pa lamang sa kadagatan sang Sulu.
english: While the LPA is moving slowly and due to the unfavorable conditions of its passage, the agency said there is a high chance that it will melt while still in the waters of Sulu.

text: Antes nagluya ang bagyo, duha ka adlaw ini nga nagdala sang pag-ulan kag pagbaha sa Visayas kag Mindanao.
english: Before weakening, the typhoon brought heavy rains and flooding to the Visayas and Mindanao for two days.

text: Lima ka beses man ini nga nag-landfall samtang yara sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility.
english: It also made five landfalls while within the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility.

text: Natabo ini sa Bayabas, Surigao del Sur bilang isa ka tropical storm.
english: It happened in Bayabas, Surigao del Sur as a tropical storm.

text:
Bilang tropical depression, sunod ini nga nag-landfall sa Jagna, Bohol kahapon sang aga; saDauis, Bohol kahapon sang hapon; kag sa Alcoy, Cebu kag Ayungon, Negros Oriental kagab-i.

Si Basyang amo ang ikaduha nga bagyo sa Pilipinas subong nga 2026 kasunod kay Bagyo Ada sang Enero.
english:
As a tropical depression, it next made landfall in Jagna, Bohol yesterday morning; inDauis, Bohol yesterday afternoon; and in Alcoy, Cebu and Ayungon, Negros Oriental last night.

Basyang is the second typhoon in the Philippines in 2026 after Typhoon Ada in January.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang state weather bureau nga possible nga isa lang ka bagyo ang ma-eksperyensyahan sa bulan sang Pebrero.
english: Earlier, the state weather bureau said it was possible to experience only one typhoon in February.

text: Diri sa syudad sang Iloilo, nag-anunsyo naman si Mayor Raisa Treñas nga magabalik na ang klase para sa mga may Saturday Classes bangud nga nag-ayo naman ang kondisyon sang panahon.
english: Here in Iloilo City, Mayor Raisa Treñas announced that classes will resume for those who have Saturday classes as the weather conditions have improved.

text: Kilala mo bala ang ginabansagan nga pinaka-fertile nga babayi sa kalibutan?
english: Do you know the so-called most fertile woman in the world?

text: Ini amo si Mariam Nabatanzi apang mas kilala sa pangalan nga “Mama Uganda” nga may yara sang 44 ka mga kabataan sa edad nga 40-anyos!
english: This is Mariam Nabatanzi but better known as “Mama Uganda” who has 44 children at the age of 40-years!

text: Mahimo nga mang-apaw-apaw ka kun mabatian mo nga 13-anyos pa lamang siya sang una nga nakaangkon sang kapid nga anak.
english: You might be surprised to hear that she was only 13 years old when she first had twins.

text: Pagtungtong sa edad nga 36, may yara na siya sang 42 ka iban pa nga babies….kag sa edad nga 40, diri na kag nabun-ag ang ika-44 sa iya mga bata.
english: By the age of 36, she had 42 other babies....and at the age of 40, the 44th of her children was born.

text: Apisar daw makibot ka sa kadamuon sang iya bata, masubuan ka man kun mahibaluan mo nga ginbayaan siya sang iya bana kag isahanon niya nga ginabuhi ini nga daku nga pamilya didto sa Uganda, East Africa.
english: Although you may be surprised by the number of children she has, you will be sad to learn that her husband has abandoned her and she is raising this large family alone in Uganda, East Africa.

text: 12-anyos pa lamang si Mariam sang ginbaligya siya sang iya nga ginikanan; ginkasal sa isa ka lalaki; kag nagbusong siya sa edad nga 13.
english: Mariam was only 12 years old when her parents sold her; married to a man; and she got pregnant at 13.

text: Apat ka sets ang iya kapid nga bata; lima ka sets ang triplets; lima ka sets ang quadruplets; kag isa ka bes lamang siya nga nakabata nga isahanon lang ang bata ukon wala sang kapid.
english: She has four sets of twins; five sets were triplets; five sets were quadruplets; and she only gave birth once to an only child or without a twin.

text: Anum sa sini nga mga bata ang napatay, kag bangud nagtal-as ang iya bana dala ang ila sinuptan nga kuwarta, nagapangabuhi si Mariam nga single parent kag may yara sang 38 ka mga bata kun sa diin 20 ang lalaki kag 18 ang babayi.
english: Six of these children died, and because her husband left with their money, Mariam lives as a single parent and has 38 children, 20 of whom are boys and 18 girls.

text: Indi man kinaandan ang medical condition ni Mariam bangud natukiban nga may yara ini sang abnormal nga kadakuon sang ovaries nga nag-resulta sa kondisyon nga hyperovulation.
english: Mariam’s medical condition was also unusual as she was found to have abnormally sized ovaries which resulted in the condition hyperovulation.

text: Suno sa doktor, indi na magsaler sa iya ang birth control pills kag posible magtuga sang mas malala nga health conditions.
english: According to the doctor, the birth control pills will no longer work for her and may cause worse health conditions.

text: Bangud tuman siya ka fertile, gin-abisuhan siya sang doktor nga kinahanglan niya nga maminata agud nga mabuhinan ang fertility levels sa iya nga ovaries.
english: Because she was very fertile, the doctor advised her that she needed to have sex to reduce the fertility levels in her ovaries.

text: “Her case is a genetic predisposition to hyper-ovulate — releasing multiple eggs in one cycle – which significantly increases the chances of having multiple births,” pagpaathag ni Dr. Charles Kiggundu, isa ka gynecologist sa Mulago Hospital sa Kampala.
english: “Her case is a genetic predisposition to hyper-ovulate — releasing multiple eggs in one cycle – which significantly increases the chances of having multiple births,” explains Dr. Charles Kiggundu, a gynecologist at Mulago Hospital in Kampala.

text: Kasunod sini, kinahanglan pa nga utdon sang mga doctors ang iya nga uterus halin sa sulod agud nga makauntat na ini sa pagbata.
english: After that, doctors had to cut her uterus from the inside so that she could stop giving birth.

text: Sang nagbiya ang iya bana sang 2016, ginahimo na ni Mariam nga adlaw pati ang gab-i agud nga makatrabaho.
english: When her husband left in 2016, Mariam was working day and night to work.

text: Isa siya ka event decorator kag hairstylist kag nagahimo man sang lain-lain nga herbal medicines agud nga makahatag sang pagkaon sa iya mga bata.
english: She is an event decorator and hairstylist and also makes different herbal medicines to feed her children.

text: Magluwas diri, suportado man siya sang mga pondo halin sa fundraising kag iban nga donations.
english: In addition, he is also supported by funds from fundraising and other donations.

text:
Nahibaluan nga bisan nga may pinasahi nga medical condition si Mariam, nakaandan nga mataas gid man ang fertility rates sa Uganda kun sa diin ang average amo ang 5.6 ka mga bata sa kada babayi nga doble pa sa world average nga 2.4 ka mga kabataan sa kada babayi.# —via Times Now

(Photo: Reuters)
english:
It is known that although Mariam has a special medical condition, the fertility rates in Uganda are usually very high with an average of 5.6 children per woman which is double the world average of 2.4 children per woman.# —via Times Now

(Photo: Reuters)

text: Bangud Leap Day subong nga adlaw, espesyal ini para sa mga tawo nga natuon sa Pebrero 29 ang ila nga kaadlawan.
english: Since today is Leap Day, it is special for people who learned that February 29 is their birthday.

text:
Kun kaisa, masiling mo, “ay daw wala sila gatigulang no?”

Kaangay sa sining isa ka Lola sa Sand Springs sa Oklahoma sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kun sa diin 100-anyos na ang iya edad subong nga adlaw, nga technically… amo man ang iya nga 25th birthday!
english:
Sometimes, you say, “they don't seem to get old do they?”

Like this one grandmother in Sand Springs in Oklahoma in the United States of America where she is 100 years old today, which technically... is also her 25th birthday!

text: Bangud makaisa ka bes lamang nga nagatuhaw ang Pebrero 29 sa kada apat ka tuig, buot silingon, talagsa man ang selebrasyon ni Mary Lea Forsythe sa sulod sang isa ka siglo sini nga kabuhi.
english: Since February 29 appears only once every four years, that means that Mary Lea Forsythe's celebration was also rare during a century of her life.

text: Antes pa man ang iya nga kaadlawan subong nga adlaw, ginkilala na siya sang nonprofit organization nga Centenarians of Oklahoma.
english: Even before his birthday today, he was recognized by the nonprofit organization Centenarians of Oklahoma.

text: May birthday party man para sa iya nga ginhiwat sang Daughters of the American Revolution Osage Hills Chapter kun sa diin ginbalik-balikan ang pinanid sa iya nga kabuhi bilang isa ka centenarian.
english: There was also a birthday party for her held by the Daughters of the American Revolution Osage Hills Chapter where the pages of her life as a centenarian were reviewed.

text: Lakip sang mga matahum nga butang nga gin-enjoy ni Lola Mary sa iya bilog nga kabuhi amo ang musical bangud gusto-gusto gid sini nga nagauyat siya sang piano kag mandolin.
english: Among the beautiful things that Lola Mary enjoyed throughout her life was the musical because she loved to play the piano and mandolin.

text:
Ang iya paborito nga kanta amo ang “Sitting at the Feet of Jesus.”

Kilala man ini nga palabasa sang bibliya kag isa gid ka inspirasyon para sa tanan.
english:
Her favorite song is “Sitting at the Feet of Jesus.”

It is also known as a bible reader and is an inspiration to all.

text: Magluwas diri, may yara man siya sang duha ka anak, lima ka mga apo, kag 11 ka mga apo sa tuhod.
english: In addition, she is survived by two children, five grandchildren, and 11 great-grandchildren.

text: Naka-trabaho siya bilang secretary sa law firm, nag-pursue sang real estate license, kag naka-publish man sang iya nga kaugalingon nga libro.
english: She has worked as a secretary in a law firm, pursued a real estate license, and published her own book.

text: Trivia lang, Ka-Bombo!
english: Just trivia, Ka-Bombo!

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga ang tyansa nga mabata sa Pebrero 29 ang yara lamang sa isa sa kada 1,461 ka tawo?
english: Did you know that the chance of being born on February 29 is only one in 1,461 people?

text: Ginapahayag man nga may yara sang lima ka miyon nga mga tawo sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nabun-ag sa sini nga espesyal nga adlaw.
english: It is also stated that there are five million people around the world who were born on this special day.

text: Ginbasura sang House of Representatives ang ginfile nga impeachment complaints batok kay Presidente Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: The House of Representatives has dismissed the impeachment complaints filed against President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text:
matapos makita sang Committee on Justice nga ini indi “sufficient in form” kag labi na gid nga “insufficient in substance.”

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Janette Garin, deputy speaker sang House of the Representative, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang basehan kag wala sang ebidensya para itulod ang Presidente sa kaso.
english:
after the Committee on Justice found that it was not “sufficient in form” and especially “insufficient in substance.”

In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Janette Garin, deputy speaker of the House of Representatives, said there is no basis and no evidence to charge the President with the case.

text: Suno pa kay Garin, base sa komitiba, wala sang direkta nga ebidensya nga nagatudlo nga may personal nga kahilabtanan ang Presidente sa mga alegasyon nga ginpahayag sa reklamo.
english: Garin said that based on the committee, there is no direct evidence that the President has personal involvement in the allegations made in the complaint.

text: Dugang pa sini nga wala sang beripikado nga pruweba, kag kadam-an sang mga gin-attach nga ebidensya halin lamang sa social media posts kag pila ka online news articles.
english: He added that there is no verified proof, and most of the attached evidence is only from social media posts and some online news articles.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Garin nga ang mga alegasyon nga ginpasibangod sa Presidente nga may gingamit ini nga pondo, wala sang klaro nga pruweba kag naga-base lamang sa online claims.
english: Garin said the allegations against the President that he used funds have no clear evidence and are based only on online claims.

text: Amo man ang isyu may kaangtanan sa wala pag-veto sang Presidente, nga indi makabig nga basehan para sa impeachment.
english: The same goes for the issue with regard to the President’s absence of a veto, which cannot be considered a basis for impeachment.

text: Tungod diri, wala sang kongresista nga nag-endorso sang impeachment complaint, gani indi ini nakaabot sa masunod nga lebel sang proseso.
english: As a result, no congressman endorsed the impeachment complaint, so it did not reach the next level of the process.

text: Ang resolusyon sang kaso nagakahulugan man sang isa ka tuig nga ban sa pagfile liwat sang pareho nga impeachment complaint.
english: The resolution of the case also means a one-year ban on filing the same impeachment complaint again.

text: Suno kay Garin, pareho lamang ang iga-agyan nga proseso sang impeachment complaint batok kay Marcos sa ginfile man batok sa Bise Presidente.
english: Garin said the impeachment complaint against Marcos will go through the same process as the one filed against the Vice President.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Garin nga sa pagtapos sang resolusyon nagahatag ini sang maayo nga panugod sa administrasyon kag magapahanugot ini nga matutukan sang gobyerno ang paghatag sang serbisyo sa pungsod.
english: Garin also said that the completion of the resolution gives a good start to the administration and will allow the government to focus on providing services to the country.

text: Lakip na diri ang mga programa nga maga-uswag sang ekonomiya, magapabaskog sang trabaho, kag magapadayon sa ginatawag nga “back to work” nga direksyon sang administrasyon.
english: That includes programs that will grow the economy, boost employment, and continue the administration’s so-called “back to work” direction.

text: Daku ang tyansa nga malakip liwat ang boxing sa listahan sang sports sa Los Angeles Olympics sa 2028.
english: There is a good chance that boxing will be included again in the list of sports at the Los Angeles Olympics in 2028.

text: Ini matapos naghatag na ang International Olympic Committee (IOC) sang provisional recognition sa World Boxing, isa ka organisasyon nga ginlunsar sang 2023 kag may yara sang 78 ka mga miyembro sa lima ka mga kontinente.
english: This comes after the International Olympic Committee (IOC) has already granted provisional recognition to World Boxing, an organization launched in 2023 and has 78 members across five continents.

text: Nalakip sa mga pungsod nga sa idalom sang World Boxing amo ang United States, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Australia kag Brazil.
english: The countries under World Boxing include the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Australia and Brazil.

text: Suno sa Olympic body, nalab-ot sang World Boxing ang pila ka nagapanguna nga criteria rason nga ginhatagan ini sang provisional recognition.
english: According to the Olympic body, World Boxing met several basic criteria and was granted provisional recognition.

text: Madumduman nga naalang-alang ang paglakip sang boksing sa masunod nga Olympiada bangud ginkakasan sang IOC sang recognition ang International Boxing Association (IBA) bangud napaslawan nga magbag-o sa pagdumala, may isyu man sa finance amo man sa ethics.
english: It can be recalled that the inclusion of boxing in the next Olympics was delayed because the IOC removed the recognition of the International Boxing Association (IBA) for failing to change its management, financial and ethical issues.

text: Magluwas sa sini nga isyu, nagsumpakilay man ang Olympic body kag ang federation sang nagligad nga Olympics bangud sa partisipasyon sang duha ka mga babaye nga boksidor nga sanday Imane Khelif sang Algeria kag Lin Yu-ting sang Taiwan.
english: Aside from this issue, the Olympic body and the federation also clashed during the last Olympics over the participation of two female boxers, Imane Khelif of Algeria and Lin Yu-ting of Taiwan.

text: Gin-ban sila sang IBA sa 2023 World Championships kasunod sang chromosome test kag gin-cite ang ineligibility issues, apang gintugutan naman sila sang IOC nga mag-compete sa Paris kag pareho man nga nagdaog sang gold medals.
english: The IBA banned them from the 2023 World Championships following a chromosome test and cited ineligibility issues, but the IOC allowed them to compete in Paris and both won gold medals.

text: Kasunod sini nga mga isyu, ginduso sa national boxing federations nga maghimo sang bag-o nga global boxing body kag nagpaandam nga kun indi ini matigayon, wala sang boksing nga makit-an sa Olympics sa 2028.
english: Following these issues, the national boxing federations were pushed to create a new global boxing body and warned that if this is not achieved, there will be no boxing in the 2028 Olympics.

text: Kun dalayon nga maaprubahan para sa Olympics, maayo nga balita ini para sa Pilipinas bangud halin sa boxing team ang sunod-sunod nga medalya nga nakuha sang pungsod sa magkasunod nga edisyon sang Olympiada sa Japan kag sa France.
english: If it is approved for the Olympics, it will be good news for the Philippines because the boxing team has won consecutive medals in successive editions of the Olympiad in Japan and France.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Justice spokesperson Atty. Polo Martines nga nasumite na ang resolusyon sang reklamo nga plunder batok kay anay Ako Bicol Partylist Representative Zaldy Co nga gin-file sang Department of Justice.
english: Justice spokesperson Atty. Polo Martines said the resolution of the plunder complaint against former Ako Bicol Partylist Representative Zaldy Co filed by the Department of Justice has been submitted.

text: Sa matandaan, nag-file ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) sang plunder complaint batok sa anay mamalidha sa DOJ sang Enero 5 subong nga tuig.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) filed a plunder complaint against the former lawmaker with the DOJ on January 5 this year.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa reklamo nga mga anomaliya nga flood control project sa Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.
english: This is in connection with the complaint of anomalies flood control project in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.

text: Nadala man sa respondents ni Co ang pila ka mga opisyal sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) nga wala ginpangalanan.
english: Co's respondents also included several officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) who were not named.

text: Ginhatagan sang DOJ si Co sang extension tubtob Enero 15 para magsumite ini sang iya counter-affidavit.
english: The DOJ granted Co an extension until January 15 to submit his counter-affidavit.

text: Nangin pareho naman ini sa ginpreparar ni Co sa Korte Suprema nga petisyon nga may pareho nga petsa, kun sa diin ginpangabay sini nga mauntat na ang judicial proceeding sa mga kaso batok sa iya sa Sandiganbayan.
english: This is similar to the petition prepared by Co in the Supreme Court with the same date, where he requested that the judicial proceedings against him in the Sandiganbayan be stopped.

text: Nadala man sa petisyon ni Co ang apostille kun sa diin nakabutang nga sa Stockholm Sweden ini sang Enero 15, kabaliskaran sa una na nga ginpahayag nga sa Portugal ang anay mamalidha.
english: Co's petition also included an apostille stating that he was in Stockholm, Sweden on January 15, contrary to earlier statements that the former lawmaker was in Portugal.

text: Apisar dinekada na ang barrier lake nga na-porma anay sang landslide sa eastern Taiwan, wala sini nasarangan ang mabaskog nga daludo sang tubig sang naglaslas na si Super Typhoon Ragasa (ukon kilala man nga si Super Typhoon Nando sang diri sa Pilipinas).
english: Although the barrier lake that was formed by a landslide in eastern Taiwan is decades old, it could not withstand the strong waves of water when Super Typhoon Ragasa (or also known as Super Typhoon Nando here in the Philippines) struck.

text: Lunes kag Martes sang nagbubo ang mabaskog nga ulan sa eastern Hualien county sang amo nga isla.
english: Heavy rains fell in the eastern Hualien county of the island on Monday and Tuesday.

text: Nag-alawas ang tubig sa Mataian Creek sang alas tres sang hapon sang Martes rason nga naguba ang taytay kag naglab-ot pa ang baha sa kaiping nga banwa.
english: The water in Mataian Creek overflowed at 3 pm on Tuesday, causing the bridge to collapse and flooding to neighboring towns.

text: Sa pila ka areas, lab-ot tubtub sa ikaduha nga panalgan sang balay ang kataason sang tubig-baha.
english: In some areas, the flood waters reached up to the second floor of the house.

text: “In some places, water temporarily rose as high as the second floor of a house and was about (as high as) one floor in the town centre, where the water has been receding,” suno kay Lee Lung-sheng, deputy chief sang Hualien County Fire Department.
english: “In some places, water temporarily rose as high as the second floor of a house and was about (as high as) one floor in the town centre, where the water has been receding,” said Lee Lung-sheng, deputy chief of the Hualien County Fire Department.

text: Ginkumpirma man sini nga 263 ka mga tawo ang na-trap kag nagdali-dali sa pagsaylo sa mas mataas nga area sa ila lugar bangud sa gulpyada nga pagsaka sang tubig.
english: He also confirmed that 263 people were trapped and rushed to move to higher areas in their area due to the sudden rise in water.

text: “About 263 people were trapped and moved up to higher ground when the river suddenly rose.
english: “About 263 people were trapped and moved up to higher ground when the river suddenly rose.

text: They are not in immediate danger, but they are very worried about the high water,” suno pa sa opisyal.
english: They are not in immediate danger, but they are very worried about the high water,” the official added.

text: Duha ka mga tawo ang missing kag padayon pa nga ginapangita.
english: Two people are missing and are still being sought.

text: Sa bilog nga Taiwan, masobra 7,600 ka tawo ang ginpang-bakwit bangud sa amo nga bagyo.#
english: Across Taiwan, more than 7,600 people were evacuated as a result of the typhoon.

text: Nag-surrender kay Igbaras Mayor Juvic Elmido Escorpion kahapon nga adlaw, November 24, ang isa ka myembro sang New People’s Army (NPA).
english: A member of the New People's Army (NPA) surrendered to Igbaras Mayor Juvic Elmido Escorpion yesterday, November 24.

text: Ginkilala ang surrenderee kay alyas Patrick, 30-anyos, single, tumandok sang Igbaras, Iloilo kag myembro sang Regional Headquarters KR-Panay sa sulod sang pulo ka tuig.
english: The surrenderee was identified as Patrick, 30, single, a native of Igbaras, Iloilo and a member of the Regional Headquarters KR-Panay for ten years.

text: Suno sa surrenderee, indi na sini masarangan ang pangabuhi sa bukid kag gusto na sini nga makaupod sang hilway ang iya pamilya.
english: According to the surrenderee, he can no longer afford to live in the mountains and wants to be with his family freely.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lieutenant Colonel Jekyll Julian Dulawan, Commanding Officer sang 61st Infantry Battalion, Philippine Army, iya ginapahayag nga nagdugay man sang pila ka adlaw ang negosasyon kay alyas Patrick.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lieutenant Colonel Jekyll Julian Dulawan, Commanding Officer of the 61st Infantry Battalion, Philippine Army, said the negotiations with alias Patrick lasted for several days.

text: Si alyas Patrick ang isa sa mga nabilin nga katapo sang KR-Panay si Alyas Patrick matapos ang sunod-sunod nga nagluntad nga engkwentro sa tunga sang NPA kag mga katapo sang militar sa area sang Tapaz, Capiz.
english: Patrick is one of the remaining members of KR-Panay after a series of encounters between the NPA and military personnel in the area of ​​Tapaz, Capiz.

text: Pahayag pa niya, wala man sang samad ukon pilas si Alyas Patrick sang nag-surrender apang magapaidalom ini sa gihapon sa medical checkup.
english: He said Patrick had no injuries when he surrendered but will still undergo a medical checkup.

text: Wala man sang may narekober nga mga armas ang mga otoridad kay Alyas Patrick.
english: Authorities did not recover any weapons from Patrick.

text: Dugang pa ni Dulawan, magapabilin sa kustodiya sang 61st Infantry Battalion si Alyas Patrick agud masiguro ang iya seguridad.
english: Dulawan said Patrick will remain in the custody of the 61st Infantry Battalion to ensure his safety.

text: Samtang, nagpasalig naman si Mayor Vicente Escorpion sang Igbaras, Iloilo nga hatagan sang suporta kag proteksyon ang miyembro sang New People’s Army (NPA) nga nag-surrender sa ila banwa.
english: Meanwhile, Mayor Vicente Escorpion of Igbaras, Iloilo assured that he will give support and protection to the members of the New People's Army (NPA) who surrendered in their town.

text: Suno sa alkalde, wala sang malain nga matabo sa nagabalik sa sabak sang gobyerno kag siya mismo ang nagtanyag sang personal nga seguridad kag pagbulig.
english: The mayor said nothing bad will happen to those who return to the government and he himself offered personal security and assistance.

text: Antes pa man, ang kapitan sang barangay ang una nga nag-coordinate sa alkalde matapos magpalapit sa ila ang nagsurrender bangud sa kabudlay sang kabuhi sa kabukiran.
english: Earlier, the barangay captain was the first to coordinate with the mayor after he approached them and surrendered due to the difficulties of life in the mountains.

text: Suno pa sa alkalde, tatlo ka semana ang ila ginpatigayon nga komunikasyon kag nagikan pa ang surrenderree sa Manila tubtob nakaabot sa Guimbal antes nag-abot sa pagsurender sa Igbaras.
english: The mayor said they had been in communication for three weeks and the surrenderee traveled from Manila to Guimbal before arriving to surrender in Igbaras.

text: Ginkumpirmar man sang alkalde nga may ginhatag na nga cash assistance sa surrenderee agud mabuligan siya sa iya pagsugod liwat sang normal nga kabuhi.
english: The mayor also confirmed that cash assistance has already been given to the surrenderee to help him resume his normal life.

text: Padayon ang koordinasyon sang lokal nga gobyerno kag law enforcement agencies para sa mga gusto pa nga magbalik sa sabak sang gobyerno.
english: The local government and law enforcement agencies are continuing to coordinate for those who still want to return to the government.

text: Nagsumiter ang kampo sang negosyante nga si Charlie ”Atong” Ang sang mosyon para suspendihon ang proceedings sa mga kaso sini nga ginapangatubang kaangot sa missing sabungeros.
english: The camp of businessman Charlie ”Atong” Ang submitted a motion to suspend the proceedings in the cases he is facing in connection with the missing sabungeros.

text: Suno kay Department of Justice (DOJ) spokesperson Polo Martinez, ginsumite ini sang abogado ni Ang sa San Pablo Regional Trial Court (RTC).
english: According to Department of Justice (DOJ) spokesperson Polo Martinez, Ang's lawyer submitted the case to the San Pablo Regional Trial Court (RTC).

text: Nahanungod ini sa kaso nga kidnapping with homicide kag kidnapping with serious illegal detention.
english: This is in connection with the case of kidnapping with homicide and kidnapping with serious illegal detention.

text: Bangud diri, ginpaiway anay sang korte ang pagpaguwa sang warrant of arrest kay Ang matapos ang pagsumite sini sang mosyon.
english: The court suspended the issuance of the warrant of arrest against Ang after he filed the motion.

text: Suno naman kay Prosecutor General Richard Fadullon, ginpangabay sang korte ang mga respondent nga magsumite sang mga dokumento nahanungod sa kaso bilang counter-affidavits.
english: Prosecutor General Richard Fadullon said the court asked the respondents to submit documents regarding the case as counter-affidavits.

text: Ginsiguro naman sini nga magatuman kag maga-comply sila sa ginapangabay sang korte para mahibaluan kun san-o magapagwa sang warrant of arrest.
english: He assured that they will comply with the court's request to know when to issue a warrant of arrest.

text: Dugang pa ni Fadullon nga kun ano man nga tikang sang korte amo man ang buhaton sang DOJ.

It is a “light yellow liquid”

It also carries, by its nature, the
antibodies that provide immunity, or defense and protection, against

Apang indi tanan nga mga pathogens lubos

But not all pathogens completely

Therefore,

Katulad sang aratay sang manok, sa diin may

Like chicken liver, where there is
will always remain in their group unaffected.

Subong man sina ang nagakatabo sa madamo na

(black death), flu, cholera, kag iban pa.
english:
The same is true of many na
pandemic and epidemic that affected humans – leprosy, measles, bubonic

text:
Kag ina bag-o pa madiskubrihan ang
vaccines kag mga drug inhibitor kontra sa sining mga balatian.
english:
And that was before discovering the
vaccines and drug inhibitors against these diseases.

text:
Sa vaccination, ginapaaway ang aton lawas
sa mga napaluya (weakened) nga bacteria ukon virus agud mag-producir sang
antibodies batok mismo sa ina nga bacteria ukon virus.
english:
With vaccination, our bodies are fighting
to weakened bacteria or viruses to produce
antibodies against that bacteria or virus itself.

text:
In the process, ginatagaan sini sang
immunity (Positive Immunity) ang tawo sing malawigon tubtub lifetime nga

english:
In the process, it assigns a
immunity (Positive Immunity) the person for a long time until lifetime that
immunity against these bacteria or viruses.

text:
May ginatawag man nga Passive Immunity
(transferred immunity) nga halin sa antibodies sang isa ka immune host, katulad

halin sa iya gatas kag sa isa ka pasyente nga nag-ayo batok sa atake sang isa
ka pathogen.
english:
There is also something called Passive Immunity
(transferred immunity) derived from antibodies of an immune host, e.g.
of a mother naturally passing on this immunity to her baby

Ang Passive Immunity nagahatag lang sing

Passive Immunity only provides

Katulad man ina sa immunity nga hatag sang

That's similar to the immunity given by

“critically ill”.

The first Nobel Prize in Physiology
and Medicine was awarded in 1901 to Emil von Behring for his

In fact, a nephew of mine on the side of

english:
Behring’s treatment was
inoculation of children with Diphtheria using

He injected it into these 62

Nowadays, there are doctors however who

text: Nakarekord ang Department of Health (DOH) Region 6 sang duha ka kaso sang mga nabiktima sang palupok.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) Region 6 recorded two cases of fireworks victims.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Bea Natalaray, pinuno sang Non-Communicable Disease Sector sang DOH 6, iya ginpahayag nga ang monitoring ang nagsugod sang December 21 and as of December 27, may duha nga nalista.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Bea Natalaray, head of the Non-Communicable Disease Sector of DOH 6, said the monitoring began on December 21 and as of December 27, there are two listed.

text: Ang una nga narekord suno kay Dr. Natalaray ang halin sa Bacolod City, 12 anyos nga dalagita nga may passive case sa diin naulamid lamang sa pagpalupok sang kasilingan kag nasamaran sa tuhod.
english: The first recorded according to Dr. A 12-year-old girl from Bacolod City with a passive case was involved in a neighbor's shooting and was injured in the knee.

text: Ang ikaduha naman amo ang halin sa Batad, Iloilo, 13 anyos nga solterito nga may active case sa diin hungod nga nagpalupok pinaagi sa improvised explosive device nga boga kag nasamaran ang tuo nga mata.
english: The second is from Batad, Iloilo, a 13-year-old boy with an active case who deliberately blew himself up with an improvised explosive device and injured his right eye.

text: Nabulong naman suno kay Dr. Natalaray ang duha nga nasambit nga biktima kag nakapauli na sa ila mga balay.
english: According to Dr. The two victims were recovered and returned to their homes.

text: Samtang, nagpanugyan man ang DOH Region 6 nga likawan ang paggamit sang palupok kag mag-angkon sang alternatibo nga merry making noise tools kaangay sang musical instruments kag mga kaldero.
english: Meanwhile, DOH Region 6 also advised to avoid the use of fireworks and acquire alternative merry making noise tools such as musical instruments and pots.

text: Nagsunod na ang France sa mga kaalyado sini nga Western countries nga nagakilala sa Palestine bilang isa ka state.
english: France has already followed its Western allies in recognizing Palestine as a state.

text: Ginpahibalo ini sa world summit antes ang paghiwat sang United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) sa New York.
english: This was announced at the world summit ahead of the holding of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York.

text: “We must pave the way for peace,” suno sa summit host nga si French President Emmanuel Macron.
english: “We must pave the way for peace,” said summit host French President Emmanuel Macron.

text:
“Today, France, recognizes the state of Palestine.”

Una na nga nagkilala sa estado sang Palestine ang mga pungsod nga Australia, Britain, Canada, kag Portugal.
english:
“Today, France, recognizes the state of Palestine.”

Australia, Britain, Canada, and Portugal have already recognized the state of Palestine.

text: Nagaplano naman ang iban nga miyembro sang UN pareho sang Belgium, Luxembourg, San Marino, kag Malta nga magkilala man sa amo nga state.
english: Other UN member states such as Belgium, Luxembourg, San Marino, and Malta are also planning to recognize the state.

text: Nahibaluan nga may delegation nga naga-represent sang State of Palestine nga may observer status sa United Nations – apang wala ini sang voting rights.
english: It is known that a delegation representing the State of Palestine has observer status at the United Nations – but it has no voting rights.

text: Bisan pila ka ka pungsod ang maga-kilala sang Palestinian independence, kinahanglan sa gihapon sa full U.N. membership ang approval sang Security Council.
english: No matter how many countries recognize Palestinian independence, it is still necessary for the full U.N. to recognize Palestinian independence. membership the approval of the Security Council.

text: Myembro sa sini nga council ang US, kaalyado sang Israel, nga may yara sang veto power.
english: The US, an ally of Israel, is a member of this council, which has veto power.

text: Ginakabig sang Highway Patrol Group (HPG) nga patalang ang paggamit sang bayo sang Criminology kag may logo sang Philippine National Police (PNP) sang isa ka suspek sa kaso sang motornapping sa Quintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The Highway Patrol Group (HPG) considers the use of criminology clothing and Philippine National Police (PNP) logo by a suspect in a motornapping case in Quintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City to be misleading.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMaj.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMaj.

text: Ryan Palaran, Team Leader sang Provincial Highway Patrol Group, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang resulta sa imbestigasyon nga ginapatigayon sang ila talatapan kun sa diin nagapakig-angot man sila sa intelligence community.
english: Ryan Palaran, Team Leader of the Provincial Highway Patrol Group, said this is the result of the investigation conducted by their office where they are also in contact with the intelligence community.

text: Suno pa kay Palaran ila nga ginasundan ang mga CCTV footages nga nahamtang sa lugar, ang direksyon nga ginhalinan sang motor agud makadugang sa ila nga pag-imbestigar kag mahibaluan kun sin-o ang suspek sa likod sang motornapping.
english: Palaran said they are following the CCTV footages located in the area, the direction of the motor to add to their investigation and find out who the suspect behind the motornapping.

text: Suno pa sa iya, wala pa makilal-i ang suspek bangud indi klaro ang itsura sini kay naga-takilid sa Closed Circuit Television nga amo ang isa sa ila ginabasehan sa imbestigasyon.
english: He said the suspect has not been identified because his appearance is not clear because he is leaning against the Closed Circuit Television which is one of the basis of their investigation.

text: Suno pa kay Palaran indi buluhaton sang isa ka pulis ang kaangay sini nga pagpangawat kag isa ka criminal ang nagbuhat sini.
english: Palaran said it is not the job of a policeman to commit such a theft and a criminal committed it.

text: Dugang pa niya nga indi sila mag-untat sa ila imbestigasyon tubtob nga indi pa makilal-an kag madakpan ang suspek.
english: He added that they will not stop their investigation until the suspect is identified and arrested.

text: Nalakip ang Filipino favorite multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) games nga Mobile Legends: Bang Bang kag Honor of Kings nga i-feature sa 2026 Asian Games sa Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
english: Included are Filipino favorite multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) games Mobile Legends: Bang Bang and Honor of Kings that will be featured at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

text: Gin-anunsyo sang Olympic Council of Asia ang 11 esports titles nga mangin event sa Games nga nagalakip sang duha ka hampang nga sikat sa mga Pinoy.
english: The Olympic Council of Asia has announced 11 esports titles that will be events in the Games that include two games that are popular among Filipinos.

text: Magluwas sa MLBB kag HOK, ipresentar man sang Asian Games bilang medal games ang Pokemen Unite, League of Legends, PUBG Mobile: Asian Games Version, Identity V: Asian Games Version, Naraka: Baldepoint, Gran Turismo (7), Efootball Series, Puyo Puyo Champions, kag Competitive Martial Arts (Street Fighters Series, Tekken, and King of Fighter).
english: In addition to MLBB and HOK, the Asian Games will also present as medal games Pokemen Unite, League of Legends, PUBG Mobile: Asian Games Version, Identity V: Asian Games Version, Naraka: Baldepoint, Gran Turismo (7), Efootball Series, Puyo Puyo Champions, and Competitive Fighter Series (Technical Martial Arts Series, S Martial Arts). and King of Fighter).

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Pilipinas ang ginbansagan bilang pinaka-successful nga pungsod sa MLBB, matapos nagdaug sang lima sa ulihi nga anom nga world championships kag nangin winningest nation sa Southeast Asian Games nga may tatlo ka straight gold medals.
english: The Philippines was named the most successful country in MLBB, after winning five of the last six world championships and becoming the winningest nation in the Southeast Asian Games with three straight gold medals.

text: Ang Esports una nga gin-feature sa Asian Games sang 2018 apang bilang demonstration sports lamang.
english: Esports was first featured in the Asian Games in 2018 but only as demonstration sports.

text: Ang Esports nahatagan sang full medal status sa 2023 edition sa China.
english: Esports has been granted full medal status at the 2023 edition in China.

text: Nagpirma ang Pilipinas kaupod ang Japan sang lima ka financing agreements nga nagabalor sang P65.4 billion agud pondohan ang big-ticket infrastructure projects, amo man ang climate kag universal health-care programs sang gobyerno.
english: The Philippines signed with Japan five financing agreements worth P65.4 billion to fund big-ticket infrastructure projects, as well as the government's climate and universal health-care programs.

text: Ang loan packages ginpirmahan sang mga opisyal sang Pilipinas kag tiglawas sang Japan International Cooperation Agency (Jica).
english: The loan packages were signed by Philippine officials and representatives of the Japan International Cooperation Agency (Jica).

text: Suno kay Department of Finance (DOF) Secretary Ralph Recto, tatlo sa lima ka loans ang supplementary financing agreements para sa bypass road project sa Mindanao kag duha ka major flood control projects sa Luzon.
english: According to Department of Finance (DOF) Secretary Ralph Recto, three of the five loans are supplementary financing agreements for the bypass road project in Mindanao and two major flood control projects in Luzon.

text: Ang nabilin nga financing agreements ang para sa pag-provide sang budgetary support para sa government programs sa ikaayong lawas kag climate change mitigation.
english: The remaining financing agreements are for providing budgetary support for government programs on health and climate change mitigation.

text: Suno sa DOF,ang financing para sa Climate Change Action Program, Subprogram 2 nga nagabalor sang P13.35 billion ang maga- equip sa gobyerno sang financial capability agud mapatuman ang dugang nga climate adaptation, mitigation kag disaster preparedness initiatives.
english: According to the DOF, the financing for the Climate Change Action Program, Subprogram 2 worth P13.35 billion will equip the government with the financial capability to implement additional climate adaptation, mitigation and disaster preparedness initiatives.

text: Ang P11.44-billion loan package naman para sa Build Universal Health Care, Subprogram 2 ang magabulig sa pagpaayo pa sang access sa quality health services.
english: The P11.44-billion loan package for Build Universal Health Care, Subprogram 2 will help improve access to quality health services.

text: Nagsungka na kahapon, Nobyembre 24, sa kapulisan ang suspek nga nagpadala sang bomb threat sa Oton National High School.
english: The suspect who sent the bomb threat to Oton National High School surrendered to the police yesterday, November 24.

text: Matandaan nga nakabaton sang pagpamahog sa amo nga eskwelahan sang Nobyembre 21 nga naghatag sang kakugmat sa mga estudyante, manunudlo kag mga ginikanan.
english: It can be recalled that the school received a threat on November 21 that shocked students, teachers and parents.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), iya ginpahayag nga gin-ako mismo sang suspek nga siya ang nagpalapta sang bomb threat sa nasambit nga buluthuan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), said the suspect himself admitted that he spread the bomb threat at the school.

text: Suno sa iya, na-detect nila ang Facebook account nga gin-gamit sang suspek sa pagpanguna sang Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit (RACU).
english: He said they detected the Facebook account used by the suspect to lead the Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit (RACU).

text: Natumod nga ang tag-iya sang nasambit facebook account amo mismo ang utod nga babayi sang suspek kun sa diin deactivated na kuntani ang account apang natigayon pa niya ini nga mabuksan.
english: It was identified that the owner of the facebook account is the suspect's sister. The account was supposed to be deactivated but she managed to open it.

text: Pahayag pa ni Razalan, ginsiling sang suspek nga lango-lango lang kuntani kag wala sang intensyon ini nga malain bangud wala man siya sang kaakig sa buluthuan sa diin anay ini naga-eskwela.
english: Razalan said the suspect said he was just drunk and had no bad intentions because he had no anger against the school where he used to study.

text: Sulod sa prestihiyoso nga Berlin International Film Festival ang Filipino film nga ‘Sunshine’ kun sa diin bida si Maris Racal.
english: The Filipino film 'Sunshine' starring Maris Racal is in the prestigious Berlin International Film Festival.

text: Suno kay Director Antoinette Jadaone, napilian ang pelikula sa idalom sang Generation 14plus category sa 75th edition sang amo nga festival.
english: According to Director Antoinette Jadaone, the film was selected under the Generation 14plus category in the 75th edition of the festival.

text: Ang Generation 14plus isa ka program sa Berlinale nga naga-feature sang mga istorya sang kabataan kag teenagers.
english: Generation 14plus is a program at the Berlinale that features stories of children and teenagers.

text: Natuon diri ang Sunshine bangud istorya ini sang bataon nga gymnast nga nakahibalo nga nagabusong siya sa semana mismo nga nag-umpisa na ang national team tryouts.
english: Sunshine learned from this because it is the story of a young gymnast who finds out she is pregnant the very week the national team tryouts begin.

text: Wala pa ginpaguwa kun san-o ang screening dates.
english: Screening dates have not been released.

text: Sang damlag lang, nangin kabahin man ini nga film sa Palm Springs International Film Festival sa idalom sang World Cinema Now section.
english: Recently, this film was also a part of the Palm Springs International Film Festival under the World Cinema Now section.

text: Sang Oktubre, nakabaton man ini sang nominasyon para sa Best Youth Film sa 17th Asia Pacific Screen Awards matapos ang premiere sa Toronto International Film Festival.
english: In October, it also received a nomination for Best Youth Film at the 17th Asia Pacific Screen Awards after premiering at the Toronto International Film Festival.

text: Ini nga anunsyo sa panibag-o nga achievement sang ‘Sunshine’ ang natabo man kadungan sang pagbalik ni Maris sa social media.
english: This announcement of the new achievement of 'Sunshine' also happened in conjunction with Maris' return to social media.

text: Ginpaguwa man sang actress-recording artist ang iya newest single nga may titulo nga “Perpektong Tao”.
english: The actress-recording artist also released her newest single titled “Perpektong Tao”.

text: Ini ang una sini nga engagement sa social media matapos nangin kontrobersyal sang Disyembre bangud sa cheating controversy kaupod sa iya onscreen partner nga si Anthony Jennings.
english: This is her first engagement on social media after becoming controversial in December over a cheating controversy with her onscreen partner Anthony Jennings.

text: Nagpagwa ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) sang memorandum para sa mga BSP-supervised financial institutions (BSFIs) agud pabaskugon ang ila surveillance kag monitoring systems kontra sa pagbakal kag pagbaligya sang boto, ilabi na sa nagahilapit nga eleksyon.
english: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has issued a memorandum for BSP-supervised financial institutions (BSFIs) to strengthen their surveillance and monitoring systems against vote buying and selling, especially in the upcoming elections.

text: Ang BSP Memorandum No.
english: The BSP Memorandum No.

text: M-2025-006, nga ginpirmahan sang Marso 23, 2025, ang nagamando nga maghimo sang tikang sa mga institusyon para kontrahon ang indi insakto nga pag-gamit sang mga digital channels, kaangay sang online banking kag mobile wallet applications, para sa pagbakal kag baligya sang boto.
english: M-2025-006, signed on March 23, 2025, directs institutions to take measures to counter the improper use of digital channels, such as online banking and mobile wallet applications, for vote buying and selling.

text: Ginpasalig sang BSP nga bantayan ang anomaliya, kaangay sang gulpi nga pagtaas sang registration nga account sa mga lugar nga kilala sa pagbakal kag baligya sang boto nga may mga dalagko nga cash transactions sa tion sang eleksyon.
english: The BSP assured to monitor anomalies, such as the sudden increase in registration accounts in areas known for buying and selling votes with large cash transactions during elections.

text: Ang memorandum sang BSP, nga kapareho sang mga nauna nga memorandum sang mga nagliligad nga eleksyon ang sabat sa panawagan sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) pamaagi sa Resolution No.
english: The BSP memorandum, which like previous memoranda of previous elections is a response to the call of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) through Resolution No.

text: 11104, nga ginpagwa sang Enero 28, 2025, para sa mas hugot nga tikang batok sa pagbakal kag pagbaligya sang boto.
english: 11104, issued on January 28, 2025, for stricter measures against vote buying and selling.

text: Kaupod sang BSP ang COMELEC kag Philippine National Police (PNP) sa pagtutok sa election-related cases ilabi na sa pagbakal kag pagbaligya sang mga boto gamit ang mga financial platforms.
english: The BSP is working with the COMELEC and the Philippine National Police (PNP) to focus on election-related cases especially the buying and selling of votes using financial platforms.

text: Nahimo nga kalaham-utan sa atubang sang iya nga mga kasilingan ang isa ka lalaki nga nagpangawat sang kabayo kag nagtuyo nga taguon ang sapat sa sulod sang iya apartment!
english: A man who stole a horse and tried to hide the animal inside his apartment became a laughingstock in front of his neighbors!

text: Natabo ini sa Wejherowo, Poland kun sa diin nakabaton ang pulis sang tawag nga nagapangayo sang bulig bangud may lalaki kuno nga may dala nga kabayo kag ginapasaka ini sa ikatatlo nga panalgan sang ila nga apartment building.
english: This happened in Wejherowo, Poland where police received a call asking for help because there was a man with a horse and it was being climbed to the third floor of their apartment building.

text: Sa una, daw indi pa magpati ang pulis kag nasal-an pa nga prank lamang ang tawag… bangud ano abi ang himuon sang kabayo sa sulod sang kuwarto sa apartment?
english: At first, the policeman didn't seem to believe it and thought it was just a prank... because what would a horse do inside the apartment room?

text: Apang wala gid nagakadlaw ang caller rason nga nagpadala sang personnel ang pulis agud hibaluon kun ano ka matuod ang report.
english: But the caller did not laugh so the police sent personnel to find out how true the report is.

text: Naabtan sa area ang isa ka 19-anyos nga lalaki nga may dala matuod nga kabayo kag ginapasaka sa hagdan apang daw may eskandalo pa nga nagakatabo bangud ginabais sini ang mga tawo nga nagapugong sa iya.
english: A 19-year-old man was caught in the area with a real horse and was being taken up the stairs but it seems that there is still a scandal going on because he is arguing with the people who are stopping him.

text: Suno sa District Police Headquarters sa Wejherowo, natukiban sang ulihi nga kinawatan gali ang kabayo kag gusto sang lalaki nga taguon ini anay sa iya nga kuwarto.

text: Padayon nga tinguhaan sang Gilas Pilipinas nga maka-adjust nga wala ang presensya ni Kai Sotto ilabi na samtang nagapreparar para sa 2025 FIBA Asia Cup sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia sa Agusto.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will continue to try to adjust without the presence of Kai Sotto especially while preparing for the 2025 FIBA ​​Asia Cup in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia in August.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Coach Tim Cone matapos nalutos sa duha ka sunod-sunod nga hampang sa third and final window sang qualifiers, apang kuwalipikado man gihapon sa tournament proper.
english: Coach Tim Cone said this after losing two consecutive games in the third and final window of the qualifiers, but still qualified for the tournament proper.

text: Kahapon, sa rematch batok sa New Zealand, gintambakan sang Tall Blacks ang Gilas, 87-70.
english: Yesterday, in the rematch against New Zealand, the Tall Blacks piled on the Gilas, 87-70.

text: Suno kay Cone, nadulaan sila sang isa ka key player sang nakaangkon sang injury si Sotto, kag isa ini sa mga bagay nga ila padalman samtang nga nagahinampot ang Asia Cup.
english: Cone said they lost a key player when Sotto got injured, and this is one of the things they will look into as the Asia Cup approaches.

text: “We lost obviously a key, key player for a year in terms of Kai Sotto,” suno sa coach.
english: “We lost obviously a key, key player for a year in terms of Kai Sotto,” said the coach.

text:
“We’re still trying to adjust how to play without him… That is [one of] the things we’re going to be talking about and thinking about as we go into the FIBA Asia Cup.”

Nahibaluan nga sa lima ka hampang, apat ka beses nga nalutos ang Gilas halin sang wala nakaupod sa ila ang 7-foot-3 star.
english:
“We’re still trying to adjust how to play without him… That is [one of] the things we’re going to be talking about and thinking about as we go into the FIBA ​​Asia Cup.”

It is known that in five games, the Gilas have lost four times since the 7-foot-3 star was out.

text: Naangkon sini ang knee injury sa Japan B. League sang Enero, nagpaidalom sa operasyon kag ginalauman nga magapahuway sa sulod sang anum ka bulan para sa full recovery.
english: He suffered a knee injury in the Japan B. League in January, underwent surgery and is expected to rest for six months for full recovery.

text: Nalakip sa kalutusan sang Gilas amo ang duha ka friendly games sa Doha International Cup sa Qatar kag ang duha ka magkasunod nga hampang batok sa Taiwan kag New Zealand sa final window sang Asia Cup qualifiers nga amo ang naghigko sa ila 4-0 run.
english: The Gilas' losses included two friendly games at the Doha International Cup in Qatar and two consecutive games against Taiwan and New Zealand in the final window of the Asia Cup qualifiers that tarnished their 4-0 run.

text: Gin-ako man ni Cone nga sa baylo nga mabuligan sila sang ila friendly games sa Qatar antes ang qualifiers, wala ini nagpabor sa players.
english: Cone also admitted that instead of helping them with their friendly games in Qatar before the qualifiers, it did not favor the players.

text: “These windows are so short.
english: “These windows are so short.

text: We’re together so little.
english: We’re together so little.

text: We were able to do a Doha trip before we came here just to try to get more time together and play more games,” suno kay Cone.
english: We were able to do a Doha trip before we came here just to try to get more time together and play more games,” according to Cone.

text:
“It probably hurt us more than it helped us in terms of being ready for Taiwan and New Zealand.”

“But we’re trying to look at it at a bigger picture in terms of the FIBA Asia coming up, because we know we’re not going to have much time, maybe eight, 10 days at most to come together and prepare for that tournament.”

Ang iban pa nga mga kuwalikado nga teams sa Asia Cup amo ang Australia, Korea, New Zealand, China, Japan, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Iran, Qatar, kag Lebanon.
english:
“It probably hurt us more than it helped us in terms of being ready for Taiwan and New Zealand.”

“But we’re trying to look at it at a bigger picture in terms of the FIBA ​​Asia coming up, because we know we’re not going to have much time, maybe eight, 10 days at most to come together and prepare for that tournament.”

Other qualified teams in the Asia Cup are Australia, Korea, New Zealand, China, Japan, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Iran, Qatar, and Lebanon.

text: Sa panibagong hakbang kontra sa labis na paggamit ng immigration program, nilagdaan ni US President Donald Trump ang isang executive action na nagtatakda ng $100,000 application fee para sa H-1B visas.
english: In a new step against the overuse of the immigration program, US President Donald Trump signed an executive action setting a $100,000 application fee for H-1B visas.

text: Ayon sa paliwanag mula sa Oval Office, sinabi ng administrasyon na layunin ng patakaran na hikayatin ang mga kumpanya na mas bigyang-prayoridad ang American workers habang nananatiling bukas ang posibilidad sa pagkuha ng highly skilled foreign workers.
english: According to an explanation from the Oval Office, the administration said the policy aims to encourage companies to give more priority to American workers while leaving open the possibility of hiring highly skilled foreign workers.

text: Ipinaliwanag din na hindi papayagang makapasok sa ilalim ng programa ang mga aplikante kung hindi mababayaran ang itinakdang halaga.
english: It was also explained that applicants will not be allowed to enter the program if they do not pay the prescribed amount.

text: Bukod dito, ipinag-utos din ni Trump ang pagbubuo ng tinatawag na “gold card” pathway, na magpapabilis sa pagkuha ng visa kapalit ng $1 milyon mula sa isang aplikante o $2 milyon mula sa isang kumpanyang nais magsponsor ng foreign worker.
english: In addition, Trump also ordered the creation of a so-called “gold card” pathway, which will speed up the process of obtaining a visa in exchange for $1 million from an applicant or $2 million from a company that wants to sponsor a foreign worker.

text: Ayon kay Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, pinag-uusapan pa kung sisingilin ang $300,000 nang buo o hati-hati sa $100,000 kada taon sa loob ng tatlong taon.
english: According to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, it is still being discussed whether to charge the $300,000 in full or in part at $100,000 per year for three years.

text: Ang H-1B visa ay tatlong taon ang bisa at maaaring i-renew ng karagdagang tatlong taon.
english: The H-1B visa is valid for three years and can be renewed for an additional three years.

text: Taun-taon, 65,000 slots ang ibinibigay, bukod pa sa 20,000 para sa mga may advanced degrees mula sa mga unibersidad sa US.
english: Every year, 65,000 slots are allocated, in addition to 20,000 for those with advanced degrees from US universities.

text: Mga eksperto ang nagsasabing nakakatulong ang programang ito para manatiling kompetitibo ang mga kompanya at makalikha ng mas maraming trabaho sa Amerika.
english: Experts say the program helps companies stay competitive and create more jobs in America.

text: Nangin tuman ka daku ang selebrasyon sang basketball fans sa Japan matapos nga nalutos na gid man sang ila pungsod ang China sa isa ka major international basketball competition sa labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang halos siyam ka dekada!
english: Basketball fans in Japan celebrated after their country finally defeated China in a major international basketball competition for the first time in nearly nine decades!

text: Ini paagi sa pagpangibabaw sang Akatsuki Five batok sa Chinese team nga Team Dragon, 76-73, nga amo man ang rason nga nagsaka sa 2-0 ang ila nga rekord sa Group C sa una nga window sang FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers.
english: This is through the victory of the Akatsuki Five against the Chinese team Team Dragon, 76-73, which is also the reason why their record in Group C rose to 2-0 in the first window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers.

text: Si Yudai Baba nga nakahampang anay sa Texas Legends sa NBA G League ang nakabubo sang 24 points kag amo ang nagpanguna sa Japanese team agud nga lutuson ang China sa labing-una nga tion halin sang natabo ang 1936 Olympics sa Berlin, Germany — ukon 88 ka tuig na ang nakaligad.
english: Yudai Baba who once played with the Texas Legends in the NBA G League poured in 24 points and led the Japanese team to defeat China for the first time since the 1936 Olympics took place in Berlin, Germany — or 88 years ago.

text: Ang 41-anyos nga si Kosen ang nagataas sang 8 ka tapak kag duha ka pulgada, samtang si Amge, 30, ang nagataas lamang sang 2 ka tapak kag pito ka pulgada.
english: The 41-year-old Kosen stands at 8 feet and two inches tall, while Amge, 30, is just 2 feet seven inches tall.

text: Husto!
english: Proper!

text: Daw kaangay nga mataas-taas lang si Ms. Amge sa sapatos ni Mr. Kosen!
english: It seems that Ms. Amge in the shoes of Mr. Kosen!

text: Nakahibalo ka pa gid bala?
english: Do you even know?

text: Si Kosen amo man ang naga-uyat sang rekord sang nagakabuhi nga lalaki nga may pinamalaba nga kamot.
english: Kosen also holds the record for the living male with the longest arm.

text: Nagatakos ini sang 28.5 sentimetros (11.22 ka pulgada), gani ma-imagine mo kun daw ano siya ka-higante tulukon!
english: It measures 28.5 centimeters (11.22 inches), so you can imagine how giant he looks!

text: Indi pa maathag kun ano ang proyekto sang duha apang ginpahayag nga didto sila sa Los Angeles, California, USA ginpakadto kasunod sang imbitasyon sang wala pa ginhingadlan nga American producer.
english: It is not clear what the project of the two but it is said that they were sent to Los Angeles, California, USA following the invitation of an unnamed American producer.

text: Sang 2018 sang una nga nagkit-anay ang duha sa Egypt, nagkuha sang picture sa Great Sphinx of Giza nga isa man ka Guinness World Record holder bilang largest monolithic sculpture sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: In 2018, the two first met in Egypt, taking a picture at the Great Sphinx of Giza, which is also a Guinness World Record holder as the largest monolithic sculpture in the world.

text: Nakuha ni Kosen ang record bilang world’s tallest man living sang 2009 bilang resulta sang iya nga medical condition nga ginatawag nga pituitary gigantism nga rason sang madasig nga pagtubo sang iya tul-an kag iban nga parte sang lawas sang mas madasig ipaanggid sa iban nga tawo.
english: Kosen won the record as the world's tallest man living in 2009 as a result of a medical condition called pituitary gigantism that causes his bones and other parts of the body to grow faster than other people.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, 2011 naman sang nauyatan ni Amge ang rekord sang world’s shortest woman.
english: On the other hand, in 2011, Amge held the record of the world's shortest woman.

text: Resulta ini sang isa ka sahi sang dwarfism nga ginatawag nga achondroplasia.
english: It is the result of a form of dwarfism called achondroplasia.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagkulob sa kalalawran nga sakop sang Carles, Iloilo ang isa ka tourist boat nga may sakay nga malapit 20 ka mga tawo.
english: A tourist boat carrying nearly 20 people reportedly capsized in the waters of Carles, Iloilo.

text: Base sa impormasyon, ginhampak sang tuman ka dalagko nga balod ang amo nga tourist boat nga rason kun ngaa nagkapan ini antes amat-amat nga nagkulob.
english: According to reports, the tourist boat was hit by huge waves which caused it to capsize before slowly sinking.

text: Na-rescue naman ang tanan nga sakay sini nga kalabanan sa ila ang mga lokal nga turista.
english: All passengers, most of them local tourists, were rescued.

text: Naangkon sang Gilas Pilipinas ang una nga kapaslawan sa FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers inadlaw matapos ang duha ka asud-asud nga kalutusan nga naagyan sa friendly games.
english: Gilas Pilipinas suffered its first failure in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers yesterday after two consecutive defeats in friendly games.

text: Ginlutos sang Chinese Taipei ang Gilas, 91-84, sa ila home court sa Taipei Heping Basketball Gymnasium sa Taiwan sa imbukada nga hampang sa third and final window sang qualifiers, Pebrero 20.
english: Chinese Taipei defeated the Gilas, 91-84, on their home court at the Taipei Heping Basketball Gymnasium in Taiwan in the opening game of the third and final window of the qualifiers, February 20.

text: Maragtason ini nga kadalag-an para sa Taiwan bangud ini ang una nga tion halin sang 2013 Asian Cup nga napierde nila ang Pilipinas.
english: It was a historic victory for Taiwan as it was the first time since the 2013 Asian Cup that they defeated the Philippines.

text: Na-usik ang 39 points, 8 assists, kag 6 rebounds nga nahimo ni Justin Brownlee sa kamot sang kasumpong nga ginapangunahan sang ila naturalized big man nga si Brandon Gilbeck kag Mohammad Gadiaga.
english: Justin Brownlee’s 39 points, 8 assists, and 6 rebounds were wasted at the hands of an opponent led by their naturalized big man Brandon Gilbeck and Mohammad Gadiaga.

text: Balos man ini para sa Taiwanese matapos ginkamasaan sila sang Gilas paagi sa 53-puntos nga abanse sa first window sang ila una nga pag-atubangay isa ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: It was also revenge for the Taiwanese after the Gilas mashed them with a 53-point lead in the first window of their first meeting a year ago.

text: Sa bahin sang Filipinos, nagsunod kay Brownlee sa puntos sanday Dwight Ramos nga may 15 points kag AJ Edu nga may 10 points.
english: On the Filipino side, Brownlee was followed by Dwight Ramos with 15 points and AJ Edu with 10 points.

text: Bangud napanas na ang undefeated record sang Gilas, patas na ini subong sa New Zealand nga may 4-1 win-loss record sa Group B. Magakit-anay ang New Zealand kag Pilipinas para sa rematch 10:00 sa aga sa Domingi, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: With the Gilas' undefeated record erased, they are now tied with New Zealand with a 4-1 win-loss record in Group B. New Zealand and the Philippines will meet for a rematch at 10:00 am on Sunday, Philippine time.

text: Natukiban sang team sang independent experts nga gin-komisyon ang Human Rights Council sang United Nations nga nagakomiter ang Israel sang genocide sa Gaza.
english: A team of independent experts commissioned by the Human Rights Council of the United Nations has found that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.

text: Ini ang pinakaulihi nga akusasyon batok sa gobyerno ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu kag sa gyera sini sa Gaza nga nag-umpisa sadtong Oktubre 2023.
english: This is the latest accusation against the government of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and its war in Gaza that began in October 2023.

text: Lakip sa gin-report sang mga nag-imbestigar amo ang pagpamatay sa mga Palestinians kag paghatag sang pisikal kag mental nga halit sa ila.
english: Among those reported by the investigators were the killing of Palestinians and the infliction of physical and mental harm on them.

text: Halos 65,000 na nga mga Palestinians ang napatay halin sang gyera sang Oktubre 7 santo sa record sang Palestinian health ministry sa Gaza.
english: Nearly 65,000 Palestinians have been killed since the war began on October 7, according to records from the Palestinian health ministry in Gaza.

text: Ini nga komisyon kag mangin ang UN-HRC ang indi makahulag batok sa Israel bisan pa ano man ang ila nadiskubrehan, apang ang ila nga report ang mahimo magamit sang mga prosecutors sa International Criminal Court (ICC) ukon sa International Court of Justice sang UN.
english: This commission and even the UN-HRC cannot take action against Israel no matter what they find, but their report can be used by prosecutors in the International Criminal Court (ICC) or the International Court of Justice of the UN.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala man naga-kooperar ang Israel sa komisyon kag ginapasibangdan pa sini ang HRC nga biased ukon indi patas sa ila.
english: Israel is also not cooperating with the commission and accuses the HRC of being biased or unfair to them.

text: Subong nga tuig, ang Trump administration sang USA nga kaalyado sang Israel ang nag-withdraw man sa amo nga council.#
english: This year, the Trump administration of the USA, an ally of Israel, also withdrew from the council.

english: Beneficiaries of the P29 per kilo rice program can now buy up to 30 kilos of rice per month, according to the Department of Agriculture after the monthly allocation was tripled.
