text: Ginklaro sang City Engineer’s Office (CEO) nga wala sang dako nga deterioration ukon seryoso nga guba nga nakita sa mga pasilidad sang Iloilo City Community College (ICCC) sa distrito sang Molo.

text: Samtang, ginbalikan man ang isyu nga isa sa ginhalinan sang rason sa pag-apruba sang Iloilo City Council sa loan agreement nga P300 million sa Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) amo ang pagpakay-o sang building sa Iloilo City Community College sa distrito sang Molo kag ang plano nga proposed expansion sang Unibersidad sa Fort San Pedro, City Proper.

text: Sa pihak sang military action sang Israel batok sa Qatar, nagapabilin nga safe ang sitwasyon sang mga overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) sa Middle East.

text: Suno kay Bombo Joseph Timothy Rivera, international news correspondent sa Qatar, kasunod ini sang Emergency Arab-Islamic Summit sa Doha kun sa diin 57 member states sang Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) ang nag-isyu sang communiqué nga nagapakamalaot sang strike sang Israel.
english: According to Bombo Joseph Timothy Rivera, international news correspondent in Qatar, this follows the Emergency Arab-Islamic Summit in Doha where 57 member states of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) issued a communiqué condemning Israel's strike.

text: Ang 25-point action plan sa summit ang nagalakip sang masunod:• Full support for any steps Qatar may take to defend its sovereignty and security;• Calls to suspend Israel from the United Nations and for the International Criminal Court to arrest Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu;• Proposals for economic sanctions, arms embargoes, and legal measures against Israel;• Demands for urgent humanitarian aid entry into Gaza;• A unified Arab regional defense framework;• Backing for the UN’s “New York Declaration” on the two-state solution, paving the way for an independent Palestinian state.
english: The 25-point action plan at the summit includes the following:• Full support for any steps Qatar may take to defend its sovereignty and security;• Calls to suspend Israel from the United Nations and for the International Criminal Court to arrest Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu;• Proposals for economic sanctions, arms embargoes, and legal measures against Israel; entry into Gaza;• A unified Arab regional defense framework;• Backing for the UN’s “New York Declaration” on the two-state solution, paving the way for an independent Palestinian state.

text: Ini ang kaundan sang ginaduso nga Heartbreak Recovery and Resilience Act ukon House Bill 9931 nga gin-file ni Cagayan de Oro City Rep.
english: This is the content of the proposed Heartbreak Recovery and Resilience Act or House Bill 9931 filed by Cagayan de Oro City Rep.

text: Lordan Suan.
english: Lord Swan.

text: Suno kay Suan, ini nga hagna ang maga-address sa importante (apang masami indi masapakan) nga factor kun sa diin may daku gid nga impact sa performance sang empleyado amo man sa iya nga pagpakig-angot sa iban nga mga tawo.
english: According to Suan, this bill will address an important (but often overlooked) factor that has a huge impact on an employee's performance as well as his or her interactions with other people.

text: Gintawag ini sa hagna nga “emotional turmoil” nga naangot sa natabo nga “breakup”.
english: The bill called this “emotional turmoil” linked to the breakup.

text: Sa idalom sang sini nga bill, ang kuwalipikado nga mga empleyado nga wala pa naka-25 anyos ang mahimo mahatagan sang isa ka adlaw nga heartbreak leave kada tuig apang wala lang sang bayad.
english: Under this bill, eligible employees under the age of 25 could be granted one day of heartbreak leave per year but only without pay.

text: Sa mga empleyado naman edad 25-35 anyos, mahimo ma-avail ang maximum nga duha ka adlaw nga wala sang bayad nga heartbreak leave kada tuig.
english: For employees aged 25-35 years old, a maximum of two days of unpaid heartbreak leave per year can be availed.

text: Sa mga nagaedad naman 36-anyos pasaka, mahimo ma-avail ang tatlo ka adlaw nga unpaid heartbreak leave.
english: For those aged 36 and above, three days of unpaid heartbreak leave can be availed.

text: Ngaa isa lang ka adlaw ang para sa mga bataon pa nga empleyado?
english: Why only one day for younger employees?

text: Rason ni Suan, ang mga mas tigulang ang nagapangatubang sang complex nga family dynamics ukon financial dependencies kun sa diin mas malawig-lawig nga tion ang kinahanglan.
english: Suan reasoned that the older ones face complex family dynamics or financial dependencies where more time is needed.

text: Agud mangin kuwalipikado para sa heartbreak leave, dapat nga maghatag ang employee sa iya employer sang pirmado nga statement kun sa diin nakasaad nga may problema sa romantic relationship sa nagligad nga isa ka bulan.
english: To qualify for heartbreak leave, an employee must provide his or her employer with a signed statement stating that there has been a problem in a romantic relationship in the past month.

text: Dapat man nga may ihatag ang empleyado nga written notice sang intensyon nga i-avail ang heartbreak leave at least 48 ka oras antes ang adlaw sang pag-avail magluwas lamang kun may yara sang mga sirkumstansya nga matabo.
english: The employee must also provide written notice of intention to avail heartbreak leave at least 48 hours before the day of availability unless certain circumstances arise.

text: Mangin mandato naman sang Department of Labor and Employment kag Civil Service Commission kaupod sa mental health professionals nga mag-develop kag magpalapta sang evidence-based resource materials sa pag-navigate sang heartbreak kag emotional well-being sa government offices, employers, kag employees.
english: It will be the mandate of the Department of Labor and Employment and the Civil Service Commission together with mental health professionals to develop and disseminate evidence-based resource materials on navigating heartbreak and emotional well-being in government offices, employers, and employees.

text: ILOILO CITY- Handa na ang Iloilo City Government sa pagsugod sang simbang gabi.
english: ILOILO CITY- The Iloilo City Government is ready for the start of simbang gabi.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jeck Conlu, spokesperson sang COVID-19 team sang syudad, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang ipangdeploy sa simbahan nga mga katapo sang Public Safety and Transportation Management Office, Philippine National Police kag mga volunteer groups.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jeck Conlu, spokesperson of the city's COVID-19 team, said members of the Public Safety and Transportation Management Office, Philippine National Police and volunteer groups will be deployed to the church.

text: Suno kay Conlu, magluwas sa paghatag sang seguridad, katungdanan sang deployment team nga ipatuman ang minimum health protocol sa mga sumilimba kaangay sang social distancing kag pagsuksok sang facemasks agud malikawan ang paglapta sang coronavirus disease 2019.
english: According to Conlu, besides providing security, it is the duty of the deployment team to implement minimum health protocols for worshipers such as social distancing and wearing facemasks to prevent the spread of coronavirus disease 2019.

text: May kaangtanan naman sa ginapatuman nga curfew humalin alas otso sa gab-i tubtob alas kwatro sa kaagahon para sa mga menor de edad, gin-athag ni Conlu nga mahimo maggwa ang mga ini sa balay sa tion sang curfew hours agud magtambong sa misa sa kondisyon nga may upod sila nga ginikanan ukon guardian.
english: Regarding the curfew from 8 pm to 4 am for minors, Conlu explained that they can leave their homes during curfew hours to attend mass provided they are accompanied by a parent or guardian.

text: Sa bahin naman sang Probinsya sang Iloilo, gin-adjust man paagi sa isa ka ordinansa ang curfew hours.
english: In the Province of Iloilo, the curfew hours were also adjusted through an ordinance.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., iya ginpahayag nga sa baylo nga alas nuebe sa gab-i tubtob alas kwarto sa kaagahon ang curfew, ini ang magasugod na sa alas-dies sa gab-i kaga magatakop sa alas-kwatro sa kaagahon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. said that instead of 9 pm to 4 am curfew, it will start at 10 pm and end at 4 am.

text: Suno kay Governor Defensor, katuyuan sini nga mahatagan sang ligwa ang oras sang pagpauli sang mga tawo ilabi na ang mga empleyado bangud ginalauman ang pag-extend sang mga ini sa trabaho subong nga holiday season.
english: According to Governor Defensor, the purpose of this is to give relief to the people especially the employees because they are expected to extend their work this holiday season.

text: Magluwas diri, gin- adjust man ang curfew para sa simbang gabi agud mas malawig ang oras sang mga tawo nga nagapauli pagkatapos sang ila pagtambong sa misa.
english: In addition, the curfew for simbang gabi was also adjusted to extend the time of people returning home after attending mass.

text: Ari kay buligan ka sang resulta sang national survey nga ginpatigayon sang Social Weather Stations (SWS) kag ginsapubliko kahapon nga adlaw, Pebrero 11.

text: Ini nga survey ang ginhimo face-to-face sa 1,200 ka mga adults nationwide: tag-300 sa Metro Manila, Balance Luzon (ukon Luzon sa guwa sang Metro Manila), Visayas, kag Mindanao.
english: This survey was conducted face-to-face with 1,200 adults nationwide: 300 each in Metro Manila, Balance Luzon (or Luzon outside Metro Manila), Visayas, and Mindanao.

text: Liwat nga ginsuspende sang Kamara si Cavite 4th District Representative Kiko Barzaga matapos makakuha ini sang 238 nga boto pabor sa mosyon.
english: The House of Representatives once again suspended Cavite 4th District Representative Kiko Barzaga after he received 238 votes in favor of the motion.

text: Ini bangud sa liwat-liwat nga nagalala sini nga misconduct samtang ini ang sa una nga suspension halin Disyembre 1, 2025 tubtob Enero 30, 2026.
english: This is due to his repeatedly escalating misconduct while he is on initial suspension from December 1, 2025 to January 30, 2026.

text: Dugang pa diri ang Committee on Ethics and Privileges ang naghatag man sang rekomendasyon nga suspendihon si Barzaga matapos nga wala ini nagtambong sa mga committee hearing nahanungod sa mga bag-o nga akusasyon batok sa iya.
english: The Committee on Ethics and Privileges also recommended that Barzaga be suspended after he failed to attend committee hearings regarding the new charges against him.

text: Samtang, suno kay House Committee on Ethics and Privileges Chair JC Abalos nagakaaapekto sa reputasyon sang Kamara ang mga ginabuhat ni Barzaga.Sa pareho man nga sesyon, nagpahayag man si 1st District Representative Janette Garin sang iya boto nga pabor sa suspension nga suno sa iya gindesisyunan sini nga mabug-at sa iya tagipusuon.
english: Meanwhile, House Committee on Ethics and Privileges Chair JC Abalos said Barzaga's actions are affecting the reputation of the House. In the same session, 1st District Representative Janette Garin also expressed her vote in favor of the suspension which she said she decided was heavy on her heart.

text: Suno pa sa kongresista nga pila na ka beses nga gintagaan sini sang dako nga pasensya nga buligan kuntani ang anak sang iya anay upod sa trabaho nga si Congressman Pidi Barzaga, apang tuman kabudlay ini paintindihon.
english: The congressman said he has given several times a lot of patience to help the son of his former colleague Congressman Pidi Barzaga, but it is very difficult to understand.

text: Ginkadlawan lamang ini ni Barzaga kag gintawag pa sini bilang isa ka dramatic ang pahayag ni Garin.
english: Barzaga laughed at Garin's statement and called it dramatic.

text: Apisar nga madamo sang pabor sa suspension ni Barzaga, pila naman ka mga mamalidha ang nagpahayag sang ila suporta sa suspended congressman.
english: Although many are in favor of Barzaga's suspension, several lawmakers have expressed their support for the suspended congressman.

text: Ginpunto man ni Barzaga nga dapat mas nakatuon ang Kongreso sa mga urgent concerns sang mga Pilipino kag indi sa iya.
english: Barzaga also pointed out that Congress should be more focused on the urgent concerns of the Filipinos and not on him.

text: Pagkaguba sang mata ang epekto sang Ultraviolet (UV) Light kag Blue Light suno sa medical eye expert.
english: Eye damage is caused by ultraviolet (UV) light and blue light, according to medical eye experts.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Jere Ledesma Cejar, isa ka Optometrist, iya ginpahayag nga kun matam-an ang mata sang isa ka tawo sang ultraviolet light kag blue light, ini ang nagaresulta sang insomnia ukon indi dali makatulog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Jere Ledesma Cejar, an optometrist, said that if a person's eyes are exposed to too much ultraviolet light and blue light, it results in insomnia.

text: Suno kay Dr. Cejar, kun tuman ka exposed ang aton mata sang UV light sa diin makuha sa mga computer, cellphone kag iban pa nga gadget, ginapahina sini ang aton immune system pinaagi sa pagkakulang sa pagtulog sa diin delikado bangud sa pandemya nga nagakatabo subong nga panahon.
english: According to Dr. Cejar, if our eyes are too exposed to UV light from computers, cellphones and other gadgets, it weakens our immune system through lack of sleep which is dangerous due to the pandemic that is happening now.

text: Ginrekomenda naman sang natungdan nga mahimo magamit sang mga eyeglasses sa diin may optical filters nga makaprotekta sa mata.
english: He also recommended that eyeglasses with optical filters can be used to protect the eyes.

text: Nagahilapit na naman ang Olympiada kag pat-od nga kadamo naman sang mga espesyal nga hitabo ang aton bantayan!
english: The Olympiad is fast approaching again and there are sure to be many more special events to look forward to!

text: Isa diri amo ang oldest living French Olympic medalist nga amo ang magadala sang sulu sa Paris Olympics subong nga tuig.
english: One of them is the oldest living French Olympic medalist who will carry the torch at the Paris Olympics this year.

text: Ini amo si Charles Coste, isa ka cyclist nga nagtungtong na sa edad nga 100-anyos sang nagligad lamang nga Pebrero 8.
english: This is Charles Coste, a cyclist who turned 100 years old on February 8th.

text: Nabun-ag siya sang 1924 ukon ang tuig nga katapusan nga nangin host ang Paris sa Summer Olympics.
english: He was born in 1924 or the year that Paris last hosted the Summer Olympics.

text: Kilala si Coste nga nagdaog sang track cycling Olympic gold kaupod sa tatlo ka iban pa nga sanday Pierre Adam, Serge Blusson kag Fernand Decanali sang 1948 Summer Games nga ginpatigayon sa London, United Kingdom.
english: Coste is best known for winning track cycling Olympic gold alongside three others Pierre Adam, Serge Blusson and Fernand Decanali at the 1948 Summer Games held in London, United Kingdom.

text: Malawig ang lista sang mga medalya nga naangkon sini nga nakuha pagkatapos sang Olympiada lakip na ang medalya nga hatag mismo ni anay President Vincent Auriol.
english: The list of medals he won after the Olympics is long, including a medal given by former President Vincent Auriol himself.

text: Apang para kay Charles, ang pinaka-malahalon nga medalya nga iya nabaton amo ang halin sa Olympics.
english: But for Charles, the most valuable medal he ever received was from the Olympics.

text: Ginsiling sini nga sang nagkampyon sila sang 1948, gamay lamang ang podium, nabutang pa ang medalya sa box kag wala ginpasuksok sa ila liog, kag indi kaangay sa nakaandan nga iga-play ang national anthem sang pungsod nga ginhalinan sang winner, wala man na-play ang national anthem sang France sang amo nga tion bangud indi makit-an sang organizers ang disc.
english: He said that when they won in 1948, the podium was small, the medal was placed in a box and not worn around their necks, and unlike the usual national anthem of the country of origin of the winner, the national anthem of France was not played at that time because the organizers could not find the disc.

text: Labaw sa tanan, ginakabig man nila nga break ang Olympiada sang amo nga tuig bangud amo ini ang tion kun sa diin may food ration tickets pa sila kasunod sang World War II.
english: Above all, they also consider the Olympics as a break that year because it was the time when they still had food ration tickets after World War II.

text: Bugal man para kay Charles kag sa iya mga kaupdanan nga irepresentar ang France sang 1948 nga lima ka tuig pa lamang nga nahilway gikan sa German occupation.
english: It was also a matter of pride for Charles and his teammates to represent France in 1948 which was only five years removed from German occupation.

text:
Sa maabot nga Summer Games, may gamay nga pagpangduha-duha ang amo nga cycling legend bangud nagapalanakit ang iya tuhod, apang isa lang ang iya sigurado: bugal para sa iya nga himuon ini kag handurawon ang nagligad sang sila pa ang naga-compete para sa ila pinalangga nga nasyon.#



Photo: Reuters
english:
In the upcoming Summer Games, the cycling legend has a little hesitation because his knee hurts, but he is sure of one thing: it is a pride for him to do it and imagine the past when they were competing for their beloved country.



Photo: Reuters

text: Plano sang Department of Health (DOH) nga himuon nga “strategic area” para sa cold storage sang maabot nga mga COVID-19 vaccine ang pila ka mga probinsya sa gwa sang National Capital Region (NCR).
english: The Department of Health (DOH) plans to make some provinces outside the National Capital Region (NCR) “strategic areas” for cold storage of future COVID-19 vaccines.

text: Suno kay Health Undersecretary Maria Rosario Vergeire, magaserbe nga central hub sang storage sang mga bakuna ang NCR.
english: According to Health Undersecretary Maria Rosario Vergeire, the NCR will serve as the central hub for the storage of vaccines.

text:
“Ang ating plano ay magkaroon ng four cold storage rooms, and two walk-in freezers dito sa Metro Manila, because this will be the central hub of all vaccines.”

Lakip sa mga lugar sa gwa sang NCR nga target sang ahensya nga taguan sang COVID-19 vaccines amo ang Bicol region, Cebu, kag Zamboanga Peninsula.
english:
“Our plan is to have four cold storage rooms, and two walk-in freezers here in Metro Manila, because this will be the central hub of all vaccines.”

Among the areas outside the NCR targeted by the agency to store COVID-19 vaccines are the Bicol region, Cebu, and the Zamboanga Peninsula.

text: Magluwas sa natumod nga mga rehiyon kag probinsya, ginatun-an man sang ahensya ang iban pa nga mga lugar nga mahimo mangin cold storage hub sang vaccines sa gwa sang Metro Manila.
english: Besides the identified regions and provinces, the agency is also studying other areas that could become cold storage hubs of vaccines outside Metro Manila.

text:
“Doon ibabagsak before it gets to be distributed in specific facilities.”

Nahibaluan nga pila ka mga bakuna ang nagakinahanglan sang malamig nga temperatura agud mangin epektibo sa tawo.
english:
“Doon will be dropped before it gets to be distributed in specific facilities.”

It is known that several vaccines require cold temperatures to be effective in humans.

text: “Itong sub-zero o ultra cold storage depende sa type ng vaccine at ilang bakuna ang makukuha natin from these different sources.
english: “This sub-zero or ultra cold storage depends on the type of vaccine and how many vaccines we get from these different sources.

text:
Doon natin maitatalaga kung anong klaseng storage facilities ang maisasama natin.”

Sa subong, padayon pa nga nagapakighinun-anon ang gobyerno sa pribado nga sektor para sa bulig nga mahimo nila ipalab-ot kaagot sa cold storage.
english:
There we can determine what kind of storage facilities we can include.”

Meanwhile, the government is still in talks with the private sector for assistance that they can provide regarding cold storage.

text:
“Humahanap pa tayo kung ito ay magiging appropriate sa isang government facility o ito ay magiging appropriate sa private na makakapag-kontrata tayo with them.”

“Pero ang tinitingnan pa lang natin ay location para makita natin kung strategic enough at makakabawas enough at magiging efficient ang ating gobyerno sa pagdi-distribute.”
english:
“We are still looking at whether it will be appropriate for a government facility or it will be appropriate for a private one that we can contract with.”

“But what we are looking at is location to see if it is strategic enough and can reduce enough and make our government efficient in distribution.”

text: Nagbalik na sa pungsod sanday Dwight Ramos kag AJ Edu agud updan ang Gilas Pilipinas sa preparasyon sini para sa 2025 FIBA Asia Cup Qualifiers February window.
english: Dwight Ramos and AJ Edu have returned to the country to accompany Gilas Pilipinas in its preparation for the 2025 FIBA ​​Asia Cup Qualifiers February window.

text: Halin sa ila masako nga schedule sa Japan B.League, nag-upod sanday Ramos kag Edu sa Nationals para sa madasig nga training sa Inspire Sports Academy sa Laguna antes sila maglupad sa Qatar para sa serye sang tuneup games.
english: From their busy schedules in the Japan B.League, Ramos and Edu joined the Nationals for a quick training session at the Inspire Sports Academy in Laguna before they flew to Qatar for a series of tuneup games.

text: Magluwas kanday Ramos kag Edu, nag-upod man sa training sanday Scottie Thompson, Calvin Oftana, kag Jamie Malonzo.
english: In addition to Ramos and Edu, Scottie Thompson, Calvin Oftana, and Jamie Malonzo also joined the training.

text: Ang iban naman nga Gilas’ players ang magabyahe diretso sa Qatar agud mag-upod sa ila didto sa Pebrero 13.
english: The rest of the Gilas’ players will fly straight to Qatar to join them there on February 13.

text: Magatinir didto ang Nationals humalin sa 13 tubtob sa 16th agud atubangon nila ang Doha, Lebanon, kag Egypt, kag magalupad balik sa Pilipinas sa 17.
english: The Nationals will stay there from the 13th to the 16th to face Doha, Lebanon, and Egypt, and fly back to the Philippines on the 17th.

text: Sa gab-i man sang Pebrero 17, magalupad ang Gilas padulong sa Taipei para sa ila matchup batok sa Taiwan sa Pebrero 20, para sa ulihi nga window sang Qualifiers.
english: Also on the night of Feb. 17, the Gilas will fly to Taipei for their matchup against Taiwan on Feb. 20, for the late window of the Qualifiers.

text: Ang Gilas, nga assured na sang ticket sa Saudi Asia Cup sa Agusto, ang magatapos sang ila assignments sa Pebrero 23 sa ginahulat- hulat nga rematch batok sa New Zealand.
english: The Gilas, who are already assured of a ticket to the Saudi Asia Cup in August, will complete their assignments on February 23 in the much-awaited rematch against New Zealand.

text: Nagaplano ang kadam-an sa senado nga himuon nga Senate President si Senator Loren Legarda bag-o matapos ang 20th Congress.
english: The majority in the Senate plans to make Senator Loren Legarda Senate President before the end of the 20th Congress.

text: Suno kay Senate President Vicente Sotto III nga wala sang kasugtanan nga tung-on ang termino para sa Senate Presidency apang ginbunyag sini nga plano sang kadam-an nga himuon ini nga Senate President bag-o matapos ang 20th Congress si Legarda.
english: Senate President Vicente Sotto III said there is no agreement to extend the term for the Senate Presidency but he revealed that it is the plan of the majority to make Legarda Senate President before the end of the 20th Congress.

text: Ang 20th Congress magatapos sa Hunyo 30, 2028 kag sin-o man nga senador nga makakuha sang 13 ka boto mangin Senate President.
english: The 20th Congress ends on June 30, 2028 and whichever senator gets 13 votes becomes Senate President.

text:
Sa natabo sa plenary session sang Senado kahapon nga adlaw nag-adjourn ang sesyon nga si Legarda ang nagdumala kag gintawag siya ni Senate Majority Leader Miguel Zubiri nga “Madame President.”

Ini natabo matapos ang malawig nga break sa plenary session kag kadungan man sa nagapadayon nga huring huring nga plano nga coup sa Senado.
english:
In the plenary session of the Senate yesterday, the session was adjourned with Legarda presiding and Senate Majority Leader Miguel Zubiri called her “Madame President.”

This happened after a long break in the plenary session and also coincided with the ongoing rumors of a coup plan in the Senate.

text: Sang nag-resume na ang sesyon, nagbulos sa floor si Zubiri samtang si Legarda naman ang nagpwesto sa podium nga pirme ginahamtangan nanday Senate President Vicente Sotto III ukon Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson bilang presiding officer.
english: When the session resumed, Zubiri took the floor while Legarda took the podium that is always occupied by Senate President Vicente Sotto III or Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson as the presiding officer.

text: Samtang, nagpost naman si Sen.
english: Meanwhile, Sen.

text: Francis Pangilinan sang ila laragway kaupod sanday Legarda, Zubiri, Sotto, Lacson, kag mga senador nga sanday JV Ejercito, Win Gatchalian, Bam Aquino kag Risa Hontiveros nga nagahatagay sang pagkaon sa isa ka conference room.
english: Francis Pangilinan of their picture with Legarda, Zubiri, Sotto, Lacson, and senators JV Ejercito, Win Gatchalian, Bam Aquino and Risa Hontiveros sharing food in a conference room.

text:
Ginbutangan man sini sang caption nga ”#Powersharing.”

Sang ginpamangkot kun matuod ini nagsabat lamang si Sen.
english:
She also captioned it ”#Powersharing.”

When asked if this was true, Sen.

Pangilinan nga ”joke lang ato.”

Samtang, suno naman kay Senator JV Ejercito nga nagka-tyempo lang sila nga maka-estoryahanay nga gintawag sini nga lounge talk lamang kag wala sang formal talk nahanungod diri.
english:
Pangilinan said, “It's just a joke.”

Meanwhile, Senator JV Ejercito said they only had time to talk which he called a lounge talk and no formal talk about it.

text: Suno kay Sotto ang kadam-an permi ang nagadesisyon sa liderato kag suno sa iya nga permi ini ongoing.
english: Sotto said the majority always decides on leadership and he said it is always ongoing.

text: Dugang pa sini nga ginbalibadan man ni Legarda ang ini nga posisyon.
english: He added that Legarda also rejected this position.

text: Nagsungka na si Rufa Mae Quinto sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) kasunod sang arrest warrant nga gindagdag sang Pasay court batok sa iya bangud sa ginaalegar involvement sa investment scam nga naangot sa skin care company nga gin-flag na anay sang Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
english: Rufa Mae Quinto has surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) following the arrest warrant issued by the Pasay court against him for alleged involvement in an investment scam linked to a skin care company that was previously flagged by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).

text: Kahapon, sang nag-abot si Rufa Mae halin sa Los Angeles, California, USA, gin-detain siya sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 1 paagi sa mga operatiba sang NBI-International Airport Investigation Division (IAID).
english: Yesterday, when Rufa Mae arrived from Los Angeles, California, USA, she was detained at Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 1 by NBI-International Airport Investigation Division (IAID) operatives.

text: Suno sa NBI, gin-escort si Rufa pakadto sa Bureau of Immigration kag sunod nga gintugyan sa ila bangud sa alert list order nga naangot sa iya nga warrant of arrest.
english: According to the NBI, Rufa was escorted to the Bureau of Immigration and subsequently handed over to them due to an alert list order attached to his warrant of arrest.

text: Ginbasahan ini sang Miranda rights, pormal nga gin-aresto, kag sunod nga ginpaidalom sa booking procedures.
english: He was read Miranda rights, formally arrested, and subsequently subjected to booking procedures.

text: Base sa kampo sang aktres, ang iya abogado ang pormal nga nagpakig-angot sa NBI para sa voluntary surrender.
english: According to the actress' camp, her lawyer formally contacted the NBI for voluntary surrender.

text: Ginpaidalom man siya sa medico-legal examination antes gindala sa Pasay court.
english: He was also subjected to a medico-legal examination before being brought to the Pasay court.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, P1.7-million ang piyansa sang aktres para sa temporaryo nga kahilwayan.
english: According to initial information, the actress' bail was P1.7-million for her temporary release.

text: Nagapangatubang siya sang 14 counts sang violation sang Section 8 sang Securities Regulation Code bangud sa kontrobersiya nga ginakaulamiran sang kumpaniya sang Dermacare.
english: He is facing 14 counts of violation of Section 8 of the Securities Regulation Code over the controversy involving Dermacare.

text: Una na anay ginplastar ni Rufa nga biktima man siya sang sitwasyon.
english: Earlier, Rufa said he was also a victim of the situation.

text: Wala ini sang ginapangatubang nga large-scale estafa complaint bangud nangin endorser lamang siya sang kumpaniya kag wala nag-intra sa solicitation investments.
english: He is not facing any large-scale estafa complaint because he was only an endorser of the company and did not participate in the solicitation of investments.

text: Ini man nga kumpaniya amo ang rason sa pagkadakop sa actress-entrepreneur nga si Neri Naig nga asawa ni Chito Miranda sang 2024 nga nag-endorso man sa produkto.
english: This same company was responsible for the arrest of actress-entrepreneur Neri Naig wife of Chito Miranda in 2024 who also endorsed the product.

text: Ang 2020 ang ginakabig nga indi maayo nga tuig para sa pagtulog.
english: 2020 is considered a bad year for sleep.

text: Humalin sa COVID-19 pandemic tubtob sa mga obligasyon sa eskwelahan kag trabaho, makatulog ka pa ayhan sang insakto sa walo ka oras?
english: From the COVID-19 pandemic to school and work obligations, can you still get a proper eight hours of sleep?

text: Isa sa factors nga makaapekto sa pagtulog amo ang imo mga ginakaon.
english: One of the factors that can affect sleep is what you eat.

text: Suno kay Marie-Pierre St-Onge, associate professor sa nutritional medicine sa Columbia University Irving Medical Center kag director sang Sleep Center of Excellence sa Columbia, ang mga pagkaon nga may mataas nga lebel sang kalamay, saturated fat kag processed carbohydrates ang makaguba sang imo manami nga tulog.
english: According to Marie-Pierre St-Onge, associate professor of nutritional medicine at Columbia University Irving Medical Center and director of the Sleep Center of Excellence at Columbia, foods with high levels of sugar, saturated fat and processed carbohydrates can ruin your good night’s sleep.

text: Mas maayo suno sa eksperto nga magkaon sang mga pagkaon nga manggaron sa fiber, unsaturated fat kaangay sang mani, olive oil, isda kag utan bangud makabulig ini agud maangkon mo ang bastante kag mahamuok nga tulog.
english: Experts say it is better to eat foods rich in fiber, unsaturated fat such as peanuts, olive oil, fish and vegetables because they will help you get enough and restful sleep.
